instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, keeping your torso upright and your arms by your sides.
2. Slowly bend your knees and lean back, allowing your heels to rise off the ground while keeping your knees forward.
3. Lower your body until your thighs are almost parallel to the floor, maintaining a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
4. Push through the balls of your feet to return to the starting position and repeat.
00057cf1-d9e3-47ba-b0a9-082a45b49430.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Avoid letting your knees collapse inward during the movement.
3. Breathe in as you lower down and exhale as you return to standing.
00057cf1-d9e3-47ba-b0a9-082a45b49430.name: Sissy Squat Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides.
2. Lower into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up.
3. As you rise from the squat, lift your right leg out to the side, keeping it straight.
4. Return your right leg to the starting position and repeat the squat, alternating the side leg lift with each repetition.
00703a47-e926-4c07-bd7a-f894cdc6d364.tips:
1. Keep your weight on your heels during the squat to protect your knees.
2. Engage your core to maintain balance during the side leg lift.
3. Inhale as you squat down and exhale as you stand and lift your leg.
00703a47-e926-4c07-bd7a-f894cdc6d364.name: Bodyweight Squat to Side Leg

instructions: 1. Attach a rope to the sled and stand facing it with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Bend your knees slightly and lean forward, gripping the rope with both hands.
3. Walk backward, dragging the sled while pulling the rope towards your torso in a rowing motion.
4. Continue the drag and row for the desired distance, maintaining a steady pace.
00a17803-e8c0-4492-9671-210f06f58cb2.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and core engaged to prevent strain.
2. Use your legs to drive the movement and your upper back to pull the rope.
3. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you pull the rope.
00a17803-e8c0-4492-9671-210f06f58cb2.name: Sled Drag and Row

instructions: 1. Position yourself under the Smith machine bar with your feet shoulder-width apart and the balls of your feet on a raised platform.
2. Place the bar across your shoulders and stand tall, keeping your legs straight but not locked.
3. Raise your heels as high as possible by pushing through the balls of your feet, engaging your calf muscles.
4. Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position and repeat.
00f077d6-d6a7-4231-b2d4-dd91c73e67d0.tips:
1. Keep your knees slightly bent to avoid locking them during the exercise.
2. Focus on a full range of motion for maximum calf engagement.
3. Inhale as you lower your heels and exhale as you lift them.
00f077d6-d6a7-4231-b2d4-dd91c73e67d0.name: Standing Calf Raises Smith Machine

instructions: 1. Anchor the resistance band under your left foot and hold the other end in your right hand.
2. Stand in a split stance with your right foot forward and left foot back, bending both knees slightly.
3. Lower your hips into a lunge position, keeping your chest upright and core engaged.
4. Push through your right foot to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired repetitions before switching sides.
0145838b-9234-49f6-a132-7881f27371e4.tips:
1. Ensure the resistance band is securely anchored under your foot to prevent slipping.
2. Keep your front knee aligned over your ankle to protect your joints.
3. Breathe in as you lower into the lunge and exhale as you return to standing.
0145838b-9234-49f6-a132-7881f27371e4.name: Band Single Leg Split Squat

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with a kettlebell in your right hand, arm extended towards the ceiling, and your right knee bent.
2. Roll onto your left side, propping yourself up on your left elbow, keeping the kettlebell stable above you.
3. Push through your left hand and right foot to lift your hips off the ground, transitioning to a kneeling position.
4. Stand up fully, keeping the kettlebell overhead, then reverse the steps to return to the starting position.
017bfc0c-09fc-442f-b305-ee5b2e97ddb6.tips:
1. Keep your eyes on the kettlebell throughout the movement for stability.
2. Engage your core to maintain balance and control.
3. Breathe steadily, exhaling as you rise and inhaling as you lower.
017bfc0c-09fc-442f-b305-ee5b2e97ddb6.name: Kettlebell Turkish Get Up

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.
2. Step back with your right foot into a reverse lunge, lowering your hips until your left thigh is parallel to the floor.
3. Push through your left foot to return to standing, driving your right knee up towards your chest.
4. Lower your right foot back to the starting position and repeat for the desired repetitions.
01eab0c2-1f17-4e09-92f5-decd11f93576.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned over your ankle during the lunge.
2. Engage your core to maintain balance during the knee drive.
3. Inhale as you step back into the lunge and exhale as you drive your knee up.
01eab0c2-1f17-4e09-92f5-decd11f93576.name: Lunge to Knee Drive Right Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Sit or lie down with your legs extended and feet relaxed.
2. Flex your ankles by pulling your toes towards your shins, engaging the muscles in your lower legs.
3. Point your toes away from your shins, extending your ankles fully.
4. Continue alternating between flexing and pointing your toes for the desired number of repetitions.
02092ac7-7a1e-4d2a-864e-c088e740c265.tips:
1. Keep the movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle engagement.
2. Focus on a full range of motion to enhance flexibility.
3. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, maintaining a relaxed upper body.
02092ac7-7a1e-4d2a-864e-c088e740c265.name: Ankle Pumps

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in your right hand overhead.
2. Rotate your torso to the left and slide your left hand down your left leg, keeping your right arm extended.
3. Bend at the hips and lower your torso until your left hand reaches your left foot, keeping your right arm vertical.
4. Return to the starting position by reversing the movement, keeping the kettlebell stable overhead.
021b89c7-8a91-4adf-99ab-66065f89777d.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control.
2. Ensure your right arm remains straight and aligned with your shoulder.
3. Breathe in as you lower and exhale as you return to standing.
021b89c7-8a91-4adf-99ab-66065f89777d.name: Kettlebell Windmill

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up.
3. Hold the bottom position for 2 seconds, maintaining tension in your quadriceps.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position and repeat.
02bd49f0-f846-411c-a8ad-bfd2ab07ff7a.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to prevent injury.
2. Engage your core throughout the movement for stability.
3. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you rise.
02bd49f0-f846-411c-a8ad-bfd2ab07ff7a.name: Barbell Squat With 2 Sec Hold

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
2. Jump into a squat position with your feet shoulder-width apart, lowering your hips back and down.
3. Explode upwards, bringing your feet back together as you jump.
4. Land softly and immediately repeat the movement, alternating between in and out squats.
0316a873-5739-45a2-a88f-2ab87d5b11f9.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged to maintain proper form.
2. Land softly on the balls of your feet to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Breathe steadily, exhaling as you jump and inhaling as you land.
0316a873-5739-45a2-a88f-2ab87d5b11f9.name: In and Out Squats Jump Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet staggered, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended in front of your thighs.
2. Hinge at the hips, lowering the dumbbells towards the floor while keeping your back straight.
3. Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to return to standing.
4. Repeat the movement, maintaining the staggered stance throughout the exercise.
03397c1b-1e3c-4119-80b9-2671b6f02c07.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Ensure your front knee remains slightly bent to avoid locking it.
3. Inhale as you lower the dumbbells and exhale as you return to standing.
03397c1b-1e3c-4119-80b9-2671b6f02c07.name: Dumbbell Staggered Deadlift

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate in each hand with arms extended in front of you.
2. Bend forward slightly at the hips, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
3. Raise the plates out to the sides, keeping your elbows slightly bent, until your arms are parallel to the floor.
4. Lower the plates back to the starting position with control and repeat.
03bdcc8d-664e-4129-9c19-eb01877dca89.tips:
1. Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
2. Avoid swinging the plates; use controlled movements.
3. Breathe out as you lift the plates and inhale as you lower them.
03bdcc8d-664e-4129-9c19-eb01877dca89.name: Plate Rear Delt Fly

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding the barbell attached to the landmine in one hand at shoulder height.
2. Press the barbell overhead until your arm is fully extended, keeping your core engaged.
3. Lower the barbell back to shoulder height with control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching arms.
047a4b8a-239e-4349-a198-3271e371116f.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to maintain stability and prevent leaning.
2. Ensure your wrist stays straight and aligned with your forearm.
3. Exhale as you press the barbell up and inhale as you lower it.
047a4b8a-239e-4349-a198-3271e371116f.name: Landmine Seated Single Arm Overhead Press

instructions: 1. Stand in a split stance with your right foot forward and left foot back, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Lower your hips into a lunge position, keeping your chest upright and core engaged.
3. Push through your right foot to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired repetitions before switching legs.
0502ee34-6a44-49c2-85c8-c0481f037a39.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned over your ankle to protect your joints.
2. Engage your core to maintain balance and stability.
3. Inhale as you lower into the lunge and exhale as you return to standing.
0502ee34-6a44-49c2-85c8-c0481f037a39.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Split Squat

instructions: 1. Begin in a kneeling position on the floor with your knees hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.
2. Engage your core and use your quadriceps to explosively jump forward, landing softly in a squat position with your feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Immediately push through your heels to return to the starting kneeling position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
0621511e-bc76-497e-9f94-b2ef186e7338.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to maintain balance during the jump.
2. Land softly to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Use your arms to help generate momentum during the jump.
0621511e-bc76-497e-9f94-b2ef186e7338.name: Kneeling Squat Jumps Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Stand at the side of an agility ladder with your feet together, facing down the length of the ladder.
2. Step into the first square with your right foot, followed by your left foot, then step out to the side with your right foot, followed by your left foot.
3. Move laterally to the next square, repeating the in-in-out-out pattern.
4. Continue this pattern for the length of the ladder, maintaining a quick and controlled pace.
064b29b1-7401-404a-8161-5daafd16660f.tips:
1. Keep your knees slightly bent and stay on the balls of your feet for quick movements.
2. Focus on maintaining a steady rhythm and speed.
3. Avoid crossing your feet to maintain balance and control.
064b29b1-7401-404a-8161-5daafd16660f.name: Agility Ladder in in Out Out Moving Laterally

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward, and arms at your sides.
2. Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight, until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
3. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
064ce219-2f77-4c3e-a930-b79f72e78192.tips:
1. Keep your weight distributed evenly across your feet.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Avoid letting your knees cave inward during the squat.
064ce219-2f77-4c3e-a930-b79f72e78192.name: Bodyweight Squats

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding your arms extended in front of you at shoulder height.
2. Lower your body into a full squat, keeping your arms extended and parallel to the floor.
3. Push through your heels to return to the standing position, maintaining your arms in the overhead position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
06ffaa05-2af2-447a-a63c-eefdb6a85a66.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you rise.
3. Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not extend past them.
06ffaa05-2af2-447a-a63c-eefdb6a85a66.name: Bodyweight Full Squat With Overhead Front Raise

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a bench, feet flat on the floor, and a barbell positioned over your hips, holding it with both hands.
2. Engage your glutes and lift your hips towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
3. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, ensuring the barbell remains stable.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
070d3a42-fc0d-46e1-98f5-17de69cb8f0d.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to prevent arching your lower back.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure the barbell is securely positioned to prevent rolling.
070d3a42-fc0d-46e1-98f5-17de69cb8f0d.name: Barbell Glute Bridge (Hands on Bar)

instructions: 1. Begin on your hands and knees in a tabletop position, with your wrists aligned under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
2. Slowly sit back onto your heels, extending your arms forward and lowering your chest towards the floor.
3. Relax your forehead onto the mat and breathe deeply, feeling the stretch in your lower back.
4. Hold the position for the desired duration, focusing on deep, even breaths.
077bf9c0-d6c0-4476-b15d-9485d7f35b6f.tips:
1. Keep your arms extended and relaxed to enhance the stretch.
2. Breathe deeply to help release tension in your lower back.
3. Avoid forcing your hips down if you feel discomfort.
077bf9c0-d6c0-4476-b15d-9485d7f35b6f.name: Child Pose Lower Back Stretch

instructions: 1. Kneel on the floor with your knees hip-width apart, holding the end of a barbell secured in a landmine attachment with both hands at shoulder height.
2. Engage your core and press the barbell overhead until your arms are fully extended.
3. Slowly lower the barbell back to shoulder height with control.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
08597e9b-5658-4ba8-96c2-820b5bbad07b.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent arching your back.
2. Exhale as you press the barbell overhead and inhale as you lower it.
3. Ensure the barbell moves in a straight line to maintain balance.
08597e9b-5658-4ba8-96c2-820b5bbad07b.name: Landmine Kneeling Overhead Press

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands at chest level.
2. Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. While holding the squat, perform a biceps curl by bending your elbows and bringing the plate towards your shoulders.
4. Lower the plate back to the starting position and stand up to complete the repetition.
0864b841-b987-47b9-9483-97e3d3a25e69.tips:
1. Keep your elbows close to your body during the curl.
2. Maintain a strong core to support your lower back.
3. Avoid letting your knees cave inward during the squat.
0864b841-b987-47b9-9483-97e3d3a25e69.name: Plate Squat Hold Biceps Curl

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a bench with your back to it, placing your right foot on the bench behind you.
2. Lower your body into a lunge position by bending your left knee, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
094e6da3-943c-4db4-941a-b5c418253cec.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
2. Maintain a straight back and engaged core throughout the exercise.
3. Ensure the bench is stable to prevent slipping.
094e6da3-943c-4db4-941a-b5c418253cec.name: Bench Bulgarian Split Squats Right

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a bench with your back to it, placing your right foot on the bench behind you.
2. Lower your body into a lunge position by bending your left knee, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
097bf372-4f02-437a-a7f0-01e876a57958.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
2. Maintain a straight back and engaged core throughout the exercise.
3. Ensure the bench is stable to prevent slipping.
097bf372-4f02-437a-a7f0-01e876a57958.name: Bulgarian Split Squat Bodyweight Right

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet together, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
09d5cbc1-efd4-44cf-b91f-6efc8b1953db.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you rise.
3. Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not extend past them.
09d5cbc1-efd4-44cf-b91f-6efc8b1953db.name: Feet Together Barbell Squats

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with your palms facing forward.
2. Step forward with your right foot into a lunge position, lowering your body until your right thigh is parallel to the floor.
3. As you lunge, press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
4. Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height as you push through your right heel to return to the starting position. Repeat on the opposite side.
0afc41f6-d1a6-4810-9ec5-035a56c28ca9.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance during the lunge.
2. Exhale as you press the dumbbells overhead and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes during the lunge.
0afc41f6-d1a6-4810-9ec5-035a56c28ca9.name: Dumbbell Lunge to Overhead Press

instructions: 1. Lie on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a weight plate with both hands at chest level.
2. Press the plate upward until your arms are fully extended above your chest.
3. Slowly lower the plate back to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
0ba0fdd2-f8fa-4b83-ad6e-e66b41f188b6.tips:
1. Keep your wrists straight to avoid strain.
2. Exhale as you press the plate up and inhale as you lower it.
3. Maintain a stable core to support your back during the exercise.
0ba0fdd2-f8fa-4b83-ad6e-e66b41f188b6.name: Plate Press

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) at your sides.
2. Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are parallel to the floor.
3. Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
0c3dd158-4642-409a-a95d-ec9c1aa99d83.tips:
1. Keep your shoulders down and back to avoid shrugging.
2. Exhale as you lift the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
3. Avoid swinging the weights to maintain control and focus on the shoulder muscles.
0c3dd158-4642-409a-a95d-ec9c1aa99d83.name: Seated Dumbbell Neutral Grip Side Raises

instructions: 1. Lie on your side with your knees bent at a 90-degree angle and a resistance band looped just above your knees.
2. Keeping your feet together, lift your top knee as high as possible while keeping your hips stacked.
3. Slowly lower your knee back to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
0c4d2dbc-dfc0-4b63-8a95-deef4ce60914.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and prevent rolling backward.
2. Exhale as you lift your knee and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on controlled movements to maximize hip engagement.
0c4d2dbc-dfc0-4b63-8a95-deef4ce60914.name: Resistance Band Lying Bent Knee Hip Abduction

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, stepping onto the resistance band and holding the ends at shoulder height with your palms facing forward.
2. Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
3. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your legs.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
0c7cc26b-265c-446f-bc5b-60507d2a244c.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to avoid inward collapse.
2. Exhale as you push up from the squat and inhale as you lower down.
3. Maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise to protect your back.
0c7cc26b-265c-446f-bc5b-60507d2a244c.name: Resistance Band Squat

instructions: 1. Stand near a wall for support, holding a dumbbell in your right hand and placing your left hand on the wall.
2. Lift your right foot off the ground, balancing on your left leg with your heel hanging off the edge of a step or platform.
3. Raise your left heel as high as possible, contracting your calf muscle.
4. Slowly lower your heel back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
0cc70c22-25d9-444a-a11a-31c3dd6a98d5.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Exhale as you lift your heel and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid locking your knee to ensure the calf muscle is doing the work.
0cc70c22-25d9-444a-a11a-31c3dd6a98d5.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise Wall Support

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand between your legs.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips to lower the kettlebell between your legs.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees, swinging the kettlebell overhead while keeping your arm straight.
4. Control the kettlebell back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching arms.
0cf2c572-f176-4323-b961-3f11b4438ec4.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to protect your lower back.
2. Use your hips to generate momentum, not your arm.
3. Ensure a firm grip on the kettlebell to maintain control.
0cf2c572-f176-4323-b961-3f11b4438ec4.name: Kettlebell Snatch

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip just outside your knees.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips to lower the barbell to mid-shin level.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees, pulling the barbell up and catching it at shoulder height with your elbows forward.
4. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0d429d6a-db6b-416c-8177-ab8f73522fbc.tips:
1. Keep the barbell close to your body throughout the movement.
2. Engage your core to maintain a stable spine.
3. Avoid using your arms to lift the bar; focus on the power from your hips and legs.
0d429d6a-db6b-416c-8177-ab8f73522fbc.name: Barbell Muscle Clean

instructions: 1. Begin in a plank position with your forearms on the ground and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
2. Lift your right arm off the ground and extend it forward, then return it to the starting position.
3. Lift your right arm again, moving it out to the side, then return to the starting position.
4. Continue the pattern by lifting your right arm diagonally upward, then downward, before switching to the left arm.
0e528ecb-0c30-402e-b5a3-73dc7903cc09.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent your hips from sagging.
2. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise to maintain stability.
3. Avoid rotating your hips as you lift your arms.
0e528ecb-0c30-402e-b5a3-73dc7903cc09.name: Plank Iytw

instructions: 1. Position yourself on the hack squat machine with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the shoulder pads.
2. Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform, toes slightly pointed out.
3. Lower your body by bending your knees and hips until your thighs are parallel to the platform.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your legs.
0e99475b-ec0e-4f38-9252-7ee533544aab.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to prevent injury.
2. Exhale as you push up and inhale as you lower down.
3. Maintain a firm grip on the handles for stability.
0e99475b-ec0e-4f38-9252-7ee533544aab.name: Hack Squat Machine Squat

instructions: 1. Lie on your right side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
2. Rest your head on your right arm and place your left hand on the floor in front of you for support.
3. Lift your left leg as high as possible without rotating your hips, keeping your toes pointed forward.
4. Lower your leg back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
0ea629e7-3ddd-4e79-8bf2-010f941fab6d.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
2. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise.
3. Avoid swinging your leg; lift and lower it with control.
0ea629e7-3ddd-4e79-8bf2-010f941fab6d.name: Side Lying Leg Lift Left

instructions: 1. Sit on the ground with your upper back against a bench and your feet flat on the floor, knees bent.
2. Position your feet shoulder-width apart and extend your arms out to your sides for balance.
3. Drive through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0f1309db-10d5-4a5d-b2d5-80e112b1ac23.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent your lower back from arching.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure your shoulders remain in contact with the bench throughout the movement.
0f1309db-10d5-4a5d-b2d5-80e112b1ac23.name: Bodyweight Hip Thrust

instructions: 1. Position a box behind you and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, sitting back onto the box.
3. Pause briefly on the box without relaxing your muscles.
4. Push through your heels to stand back up to the starting position, fully extending your legs.
0f537097-c87b-44dd-a1c7-808ab07038a2.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged to maintain a neutral spine.
2. Exhale as you stand up and inhale as you lower down.
3. Avoid bouncing off the box; use a controlled movement.
0f537097-c87b-44dd-a1c7-808ab07038a2.name: Barbell Box Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, securing a resistance band around your ankles.
2. Shift your weight onto your left leg and slightly bend your knee.
3. Extend your right leg straight back, keeping your foot flexed and squeezing your glutes.
4. Return your right leg to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
0fa2f510-4a90-48e0-af24-a4d958c742e9.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Exhale as you kick back and inhale as you return to the start.
3. Avoid arching your back; focus on the glute contraction.
0fa2f510-4a90-48e0-af24-a4d958c742e9.name: Resistance Band Standing Balance Glute Kickback

instructions: 1. Stand at the end of an agility ladder, balancing on your right leg.
2. Hop forward into the first square on your right foot, maintaining balance.
3. Continue hopping forward through each square, keeping your movements quick and controlled.
4. Complete the ladder on your right foot, then switch to your left foot and repeat.
104913cb-8684-4f47-a659-af7722e618ab.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
2. Focus on soft landings to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Keep your eyes forward to maintain balance and coordination.
104913cb-8684-4f47-a659-af7722e618ab.name: Agility Ladder Advanced Single-Leg

instructions: 1. Begin on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
2. Lift your right leg out to the side, keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees.
3. Lower your leg back to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the left leg.
10a5c094-4934-473f-b214-4e3e9d7f9757.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent your back from arching.
2. Exhale as you lift your leg and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid rotating your hips; keep them level throughout the movement.
10a5c094-4934-473f-b214-4e3e9d7f9757.name: Fire Hydrant Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Stand facing a chair with a resistance band secured under your right foot and held in both hands.
2. Step your left foot back into a lunge position, keeping your right knee over your ankle.
3. Lower your body into a lunge by bending both knees, keeping your chest up.
4. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
10b98fb2-9f91-4fa7-823e-ce4a7a6bde54.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Exhale as you push up from the lunge and inhale as you lower down.
3. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
10b98fb2-9f91-4fa7-823e-ce4a7a6bde54.name: Chair Back Lunge Right Resistance Band

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, stepping forward with your right foot into a lunge position.
2. Lower your body by bending both knees, keeping your front knee over your ankle.
3. Pulse up and down slightly in the lunge position, maintaining tension in your quadriceps.
4. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
10d238d8-be24-4f9f-bb34-f3dad6f5a000.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Exhale as you push up from the lunge and inhale as you lower down.
3. Avoid allowing your front knee to extend past your toes.
10d238d8-be24-4f9f-bb34-f3dad6f5a000.name: Bodyweight Pulse Forward Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand behind a sled with your hands placed on the handles, feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Lean forward slightly, engaging your core and keeping your back straight.
3. Drive through your legs to push the sled forward, maintaining a steady pace.
4. Continue pushing the sled for the desired distance or time.
10d9f7f6-8f18-4223-9f4e-e093c3036285.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to support your lower back.
2. Maintain a steady breathing pattern to ensure consistent effort.
3. Avoid rounding your back; keep your spine neutral throughout the movement.
10d9f7f6-8f18-4223-9f4e-e093c3036285.name: Box Sled Push

instructions: 1. Begin in a high plank position with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
2. Jump your feet forward towards your hands, lifting your hips into a pike position.
3. Quickly jump your feet back to the starting position, maintaining a strong core and stable shoulders.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, keeping a steady pace.
1126d4f5-d7bb-42c3-87e0-9a73b72a7a69.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to protect your lower back.
2. Land softly on the balls of your feet to reduce impact.
3. Maintain a steady breathing pattern to support endurance.
1126d4f5-d7bb-42c3-87e0-9a73b72a7a69.name: Pike Jacks Feet Kicking in and Out

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your shoulders on the floor and your feet elevated on a bench, holding a barbell across your hips.
2. Position one foot slightly ahead of the other in a staggered stance, keeping both feet flat on the bench.
3. Engage your glutes and lift your hips towards the ceiling, creating a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
4. Lower your hips back down with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching the staggered stance.
11b884fa-ceee-4d82-ab3b-b7492531f679.tips:
1. Ensure the barbell is securely positioned on your hips to avoid discomfort.
2. Engage your core to maintain stability throughout the movement.
3. Avoid arching your lower back by focusing on glute activation.
11b884fa-ceee-4d82-ab3b-b7492531f679.name: Barbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step one foot forward into a split stance, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees.
3. Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the other leg.
124a3343-d185-4589-b4b9-6e27e57ce248.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and shoulders back to maintain good posture.
2. Engage your core for balance and stability.
3. Ensure your front knee does not extend beyond your toes to protect your joints.
124a3343-d185-4589-b4b9-6e27e57ce248.name: Dumbbell Split Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a resistance band under your feet and the handles in each hand.
2. Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and knees slightly bent.
3. Extend your hips forward, straightening your body to an upright position while maintaining tension in the band.
4. Return to the bent-over position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
129d8357-28ad-4cee-88ff-53386a92f089.tips:
1. Keep your back straight throughout the movement to avoid strain.
2. Engage your core to support your lower back.
3. Control the movement to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
129d8357-28ad-4cee-88ff-53386a92f089.name: Band Bent-Over Hip Extension

instructions: 1. Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the floor.
2. Extend one leg out in front of you, keeping your foot flexed.
3. Lift your leg until it is parallel to the floor, engaging your quadriceps.
4. Lower your leg back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
12b5619a-98da-416a-8b71-d7ceaa0cc2a9.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid leaning forward.
2. Engage your core to maintain stability.
3. Perform the movement slowly to enhance muscle activation.
12b5619a-98da-416a-8b71-d7ceaa0cc2a9.name: Seated Leg Extension Single Leg

instructions: 1. Adjust the seat and handlebars of the spin bike to fit your body, ensuring a comfortable position.
2. Begin pedaling at a steady pace, keeping your core engaged and back straight.
3. Gradually increase your speed or resistance as desired, maintaining a smooth pedaling motion.
4. Cool down by reducing your pace and resistance before coming to a stop.
12d5ceba-b9f3-459d-a083-97dfc82241fd.tips:
1. Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid gripping the handlebars too tightly.
2. Maintain a steady breathing pattern to support endurance.
3. Adjust resistance gradually to avoid sudden strain on your muscles.
12d5ceba-b9f3-459d-a083-97dfc82241fd.name: Indoor Cycling Spinbike

instructions: 1. Begin in a high plank position with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
2. Lift your hips into a pike position, reaching one hand to tap the opposite hip.
3. Return your hand to the starting position and repeat the movement with the opposite hand.
4. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
1392e380-7b03-4c92-9e1d-382fbdff430f.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
2. Move with control to avoid shifting your weight excessively.
3. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise to support endurance.
1392e380-7b03-4c92-9e1d-382fbdff430f.name: Pike Alternating Opposite Hip Taps

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.
2. Rise onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels as high as possible.
3. Clap your hands above your head as you reach the top of the calf raise.
4. Lower your heels back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
1395dbf4-5738-4795-8431-e0f3aade404d.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Avoid locking your knees to prevent strain.
3. Perform the movement slowly to enhance muscle activation.
1395dbf4-5738-4795-8431-e0f3aade404d.name: Calf Raise Clap

instructions: 1. Stand between two benches with a dumbbell in each hand, feet wider than shoulder-width apart.
2. Lower your hips into a squat position, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Push through your heels to return to a standing position, squeezing your glutes at the top.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
13e815a1-c94d-4151-9e53-2b7b362947ea.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
2. Engage your core for stability throughout the movement.
3. Avoid leaning forward to maintain good posture.
13e815a1-c94d-4151-9e53-2b7b362947ea.name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat Off Benches

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip just outside your knees.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips to lower the barbell to mid-shin level.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees to pull the barbell upwards, keeping it close to your body.
4. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
14eec4ff-1d87-43f9-ad06-a00f69238827.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to protect your lower back.
2. Focus on using your hips and legs to generate power.
3. Avoid rounding your back by maintaining a neutral spine.
14eec4ff-1d87-43f9-ad06-a00f69238827.name: Barbell Clean Pull

instructions: 1. Attach a battle rope to a sled and stand facing the sled with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold one end of the rope in each hand, bending your knees slightly.
3. Pull the sled towards you by alternately pulling the ropes, engaging your core and upper body.
4. Continue pulling until the sled reaches you, then reset for the next repetition.
1529cf10-3627-44f7-ad7d-7ebe6e0c1152.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
2. Use your whole body to generate power, not just your arms.
3. Maintain a steady breathing pattern to support endurance.
1529cf10-3627-44f7-ad7d-7ebe6e0c1152.name: Sled Battle Rope Pull

instructions: 1. Kneel on the floor with your partner holding your ankles securely.
2. Slowly lower your torso towards the floor, keeping your back straight and engaging your hamstrings.
3. Use your hamstrings to control the descent and push back up to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, focusing on controlled movement.
15624f4b-59e7-4399-9e6e-e63de1b56555.tips:
1. Engage your core to support your lower back.
2. Avoid bending at the hips to maintain proper form.
3. Communicate with your partner to ensure they provide adequate support.
15624f4b-59e7-4399-9e6e-e63de1b56555.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl With Partner

instructions: 1. Stand at the beginning of the agility ladder with your feet together.
2. Jump forward, landing with both feet in the first square, then immediately jump to the next square.
3. Continue this pattern, touching each square twice with both feet before moving to the next.
4. Complete the ladder, maintaining a quick and controlled pace.
1600642e-e24b-4762-a5e3-6198a81cfac5.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Use your arms to help propel your jumps.
3. Focus on quick, light footwork to improve agility.
1600642e-e24b-4762-a5e3-6198a81cfac5.name: Agility Ladder Skipping 2 Touches

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, securing a resistance band around one ankle and anchoring the other end to a low point.
2. Shift your weight onto the non-banded leg and slightly bend your knee.
3. Curl the banded leg backwards, bringing your heel towards your glutes while keeping your upper body stable.
4. Return your leg to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
16916fa4-55ef-42eb-938d-6c0ba14f5394.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Avoid swinging your leg to ensure controlled movement.
3. Focus on squeezing your hamstrings at the top of the curl.
16916fa4-55ef-42eb-938d-6c0ba14f5394.name: Band Standing Leg Curl

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a sturdy box or platform with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Bend your knees and swing your arms back, then explosively jump onto the box, landing softly with both feet.
3. Stand up fully on the box, engaging your core and glutes.
4. Step or jump back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
16b6e4ec-5173-4e92-8fe3-c0db95fab608.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
2. Land softly to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Use your arms to help generate momentum for the jump.
16b6e4ec-5173-4e92-8fe3-c0db95fab608.name: Box Jump

instructions: 1. Stand on one leg with the other leg extended forward, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
2. Lower your body into a squat position on the supporting leg, keeping the extended leg off the ground.
3. Explosively jump upwards, using your arms for momentum, and land softly back into the squat position on the same leg.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the other leg.
1718f8d2-5840-4be9-aafc-27004b5ad978.tips:
1. Focus on maintaining balance and control throughout the movement.
2. Land softly to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Keep your knee aligned with your toes to prevent injury.
1718f8d2-5840-4be9-aafc-27004b5ad978.name: Jumping Pistol Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips or in front of your chest.
2. Step out to the side with your right foot, bending your right knee and keeping your left leg straight.
3. Lower your hips back and down into a lunge position, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
4. Push through your right foot to return to the starting position and repeat on the left side.
180abc2f-4db2-4de5-86e0-293753e05e26.tips:
1. Keep your chest lifted and back straight throughout the movement.
2. Ensure your knee does not extend beyond your toes during the lunge.
3. Engage your core for stability and balance.
180abc2f-4db2-4de5-86e0-293753e05e26.name: Side Lunges Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
2. Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
3. Press through your heels to return to the starting position, maintaining a wide stance.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
18123885-577e-415e-8480-ef26f00870b3.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to prevent strain on your joints.
2. Maintain a neutral spine and avoid rounding your back.
3. Engage your core to support your lower back throughout the exercise.
18123885-577e-415e-8480-ef26f00870b3.name: Leg Press Wide High Stance

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a sandbag on the floor in front of you.
2. Bend at your hips and knees to lower into a squat position, grasping the sandbag with both hands.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees to lift the sandbag to shoulder height, catching it in a squat position.
4. Stand up straight, then lower the sandbag back to the starting position and repeat.
19340d22-99ab-417f-bf9d-53a4056e4da0.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Use your legs and hips to generate power, not just your arms.
3. Ensure a firm grip on the sandbag to maintain control.
19340d22-99ab-417f-bf9d-53a4056e4da0.name: Sandbag Cleans

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step forward with your right foot into a lunge position, bending both knees to 90 degrees.
3. Pulse up and down slightly in the lunge position, maintaining tension in your quadriceps.
4. Push through your right foot to return to the starting position and repeat on the left side.
193c51ad-00fd-42f9-ac3b-7b544976253b.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and shoulders back throughout the exercise.
2. Ensure your front knee stays aligned with your toes.
3. Engage your core for balance and stability.
193c51ad-00fd-42f9-ac3b-7b544976253b.name: Dumbbell Lunge Pulse

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball with both hands.
2. Lower into a quarter squat, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
3. Rotate your torso to the left, bringing the medicine ball across your body to the left side.
4. Rotate back to the right, bringing the medicine ball across your body to the right side, and repeat.
198c88b4-165c-498c-a59d-a0e91c6d19b5.tips:
1. Keep your movements controlled and avoid jerking the medicine ball.
2. Engage your core to support your lower back and enhance rotational power.
3. Maintain a slight bend in your knees to protect your joints.
198c88b4-165c-498c-a59d-a0e91c6d19b5.name: Low Rotational Med Ball Chops (Quarter Squat, Rotating Med Ball Left and Ride Across Core)

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
2. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture as you begin walking forward.
3. Keep your shoulders level and avoid leaning to one side as you walk.
4. Continue walking for the desired distance or time, then switch hands and repeat.
1a1135a4-5370-4ce3-94b6-d2643581066c.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Avoid swinging the dumbbell or leaning to one side.
3. Focus on maintaining a steady and controlled pace.
1a1135a4-5370-4ce3-94b6-d2643581066c.name: Dumbbell Suitcase Carry

instructions: 1. Stand on a step or platform with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step back with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position with both knees bent at 90 degrees.
3. Push through your left foot to return to the starting position on the step.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
1a64c9e1-2c16-4d69-997f-e6763e92998a.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and shoulders back throughout the exercise.
2. Ensure your front knee stays aligned with your toes.
3. Engage your core for balance and stability.
1a64c9e1-2c16-4d69-997f-e6763e92998a.name: Dumbbell Rear Lunge From Step

instructions: 1. Position yourself under the Smith machine bar with the balls of your feet on a raised platform and your heels hanging off.
2. Unrack the bar and stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, keeping your core engaged.
3. Raise your heels as high as possible by contracting your calf muscles, keeping your knees straight but not locked.
4. Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position and repeat.
1a823fb6-cedd-4508-9b75-d8024e368809.tips:
1. Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize calf engagement.
2. Avoid bouncing at the bottom of the movement to prevent injury.
3. Maintain a slight bend in your knees to reduce strain on your joints.
1a823fb6-cedd-4508-9b75-d8024e368809.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
3. Explosively jump upwards, extending your legs and swinging the dumbbells forward for momentum.
4. Land softly back into the squat position and repeat the jump for the desired number of repetitions.
1ab8f255-9aa2-4c0c-8850-7ba76b08a5fe.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance during the jump.
2. Land softly to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Use the momentum from the dumbbells to assist in the jump, but maintain control.
1ab8f255-9aa2-4c0c-8850-7ba76b08a5fe.name: Dumbbell Frog Jumps

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, holding a barbell across your hips.
2. Plant your feet flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart, and engage your core.
3. Drive through your heels to lift your hips towards the ceiling, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat.
1ae1dc19-ad4f-426d-b934-5bffa0717369.tips:
1. Keep your chin tucked to maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise.
2. Engage your core to support your lower back.
3. Focus on squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement for maximum activation.
1ae1dc19-ad4f-426d-b934-5bffa0717369.name: Barbell Kas Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a weight plate in each hand at your sides.
2. Engage your core and sit up straight, keeping your shoulders back.
3. Raise the plates out to the sides until your arms are parallel to the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
4. Lower the plates back to the starting position with control and repeat.
1aeca623-3337-4f65-b866-033dc1405ed5.tips:
1. Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize shoulder engagement.
2. Avoid swinging the plates to prevent momentum from taking over.
3. Maintain a slight bend in your elbows to reduce strain on your joints.
1aeca623-3337-4f65-b866-033dc1405ed5.name: Seated Plate Side Raises

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms at your sides.
2. Lower your body into a squat position, placing your hands on the floor in front of you.
3. Jump your feet back into a plank position, keeping your body in a straight line.
4. Jump your feet back towards your hands, then explosively jump into the air, reaching your arms overhead. Repeat.
1b381baa-011c-4927-ba4c-4a00ff53c138.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the movement to support your lower back.
2. Land softly to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Maintain a steady pace to ensure proper form and avoid fatigue.
1b381baa-011c-4927-ba4c-4a00ff53c138.name: Burpees

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand, resting them on your shoulders.
2. Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
3. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, maintaining the dumbbells over your shoulders.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
1bd6e266-9408-426a-b46b-71db0b27cd40.tips:
1. Keep your elbows pointed forward to maintain stability of the dumbbells.
2. Ensure your knees stay aligned with your toes throughout the squat.
3. Engage your core to support your lower back and maintain balance.
1bd6e266-9408-426a-b46b-71db0b27cd40.name: Front Squats Dumbbell Over Shoulders

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands at chest level.
2. Step forward with your right foot into a lunge position, bending both knees to 90 degrees.
3. Push through your right foot to return to the starting position, keeping the dumbbell at chest level.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
1be31ff6-38fa-42d9-9995-a4d2eede82bd.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and shoulders back throughout the exercise.
2. Ensure your front knee stays aligned with your toes.
3. Engage your core for balance and stability.
1be31ff6-38fa-42d9-9995-a4d2eede82bd.name: Dumbbell Goblet Forward Lunge

instructions: 1. Position a stability ball on a flat bench and lie face down on it, with your hips on the ball and your legs extended behind you.
2. Secure a resistance band around your ankles and anchor it to a stable point in front of you.
3. Keeping your legs straight, lift them upward against the resistance of the band, engaging your quadriceps and glutes.
4. Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
1c6a2f22-3697-4345-9f69-32acbbbcda84.tips:
1. Ensure the resistance band is securely anchored to prevent slipping.
2. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability on the ball.
3. Avoid arching your back excessively during the movement.
1c6a2f22-3697-4345-9f69-32acbbbcda84.name: Resistance Band Reverse Hyper With Stability Ball on Flat Bench

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
2. Keeping your back straight and knees slightly bent, hinge at the hips to lower the barbell towards the floor.
3. Lower the barbell until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then return to the starting position by extending your hips.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
1c9fe1cd-217e-4b2e-b46e-4587a03d3889.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
2. Engage your core throughout the movement for stability.
3. Exhale as you lift the barbell and inhale as you lower it.
1c9fe1cd-217e-4b2e-b46e-4587a03d3889.name: Barbell Straight Leg Deadlift

instructions: 1. Kneel on the floor with a resistance band looped around your hips and anchored behind you.
2. Sit back onto your heels, then thrust your hips forward against the resistance of the band, engaging your glutes and hips.
3. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, ensuring your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
1cfaa9e8-950d-445c-bafb-4fb9115b0dff.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and protect your lower back.
2. Ensure the resistance band is securely anchored to prevent slipping.
3. Avoid arching your back at the top of the movement.
1cfaa9e8-950d-445c-bafb-4fb9115b0dff.name: Resistance Band Hip Thrusts on Knees

instructions: 1. Begin in a side plank position with your elbow directly under your shoulder and a resistance band looped around your thighs.
2. Lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line from head to feet, engaging your core and glutes.
3. Keeping your body stable, raise your top leg against the resistance of the band, focusing on your glutes.
4. Lower your leg back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
1d81bed9-add9-4bd6-96ae-887976e128b0.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to maintain balance and stability.
2. Ensure your elbow is directly under your shoulder to support your body weight.
3. Perform the leg raise slowly and with control to maximize glute engagement.
1d81bed9-add9-4bd6-96ae-887976e128b0.name: Resistance Band Side Plank Glute Raise

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand, resting them on your knees.
2. Position the balls of your feet on a raised platform or block, allowing your heels to hang off.
3. Raise your heels as high as possible by contracting your calves, lifting the dumbbells with your knees.
4. Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
1dd8add3-26fe-40e5-80f9-4f812d9f2d35.tips:
1. Keep your movements slow and controlled to engage the calves fully.
2. Avoid bouncing at the bottom of the movement to prevent strain.
3. Exhale as you lift your heels and inhale as you lower them.
1dd8add3-26fe-40e5-80f9-4f812d9f2d35.name: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise

instructions: 1. Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of a step, holding a dumbbell in each hand by your sides.
2. Lower your heels below the level of the step to feel a stretch in your calves.
3. Raise your heels as high as possible by contracting your calves, keeping your knees straight.
4. Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
1de600c1-313f-43c0-b69b-e6e4b72549fb.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Avoid locking your knees during the exercise.
3. Exhale as you lift your heels and inhale as you lower them.
1de600c1-313f-43c0-b69b-e6e4b72549fb.name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise on Step

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a low box or step with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Quickly alternate tapping your feet on the box, moving as fast as possible while maintaining control.
3. Keep your knees slightly bent and your core engaged throughout the movement.
4. Continue for the desired duration, focusing on speed and agility.
1dee55f2-313a-4d33-b030-f8f15211ac94.tips:
1. Keep your movements light and quick to improve agility.
2. Maintain a slight bend in your knees to absorb impact.
3. Focus on controlled breathing to sustain your pace.
1dee55f2-313a-4d33-b030-f8f15211ac94.name: Low Box Quick Feet

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band in both hands, with one end anchored to a stable point at hip height.
2. Step away from the anchor point to create tension in the band, positioning it across your body.
3. Pull the band diagonally across your body, engaging your quadriceps and core.
4. Return to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
1ea1f013-81b7-4016-9466-21681ccb83bc.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability throughout the movement.
2. Ensure the resistance band is securely anchored to prevent slipping.
3. Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement.
1ea1f013-81b7-4016-9466-21681ccb83bc.name: Band Cross Abduction

instructions: 1. Stand facing a wall, placing your hands on it for support, with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Raise your heels as high as possible by contracting your calves, keeping your knees straight.
3. Hold the top position briefly, then slowly lower your heels back to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
1f1351b9-05fe-47f9-9a43-e6965d7520dc.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Avoid leaning too heavily on the wall for support.
3. Exhale as you lift your heels and inhale as you lower them.
1f1351b9-05fe-47f9-9a43-e6965d7520dc.name: Calf Raise With Wall Support

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, hands on your hips or holding onto a stable surface for balance.
2. Shift your weight onto one leg and lift the other leg out to the side, keeping it straight and engaging your hip muscles.
3. Slowly lower your leg back to the starting position, maintaining control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the other leg.
1f2b3669-f63c-4752-9b68-9bc86be46463.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Avoid leaning to the side as you lift your leg.
3. Perform the movement slowly to maximize muscle engagement.
1f2b3669-f63c-4752-9b68-9bc86be46463.name: Multi Hip Adduction

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Position the balls of your feet on a raised platform or block, allowing your heels to hang off.
3. Raise your heels as high as possible by contracting your calves, keeping your knees straight.
4. Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
20ace88c-1983-4e60-ba55-8db1286bb410.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Avoid locking your knees during the exercise.
3. Exhale as you lift your heels and inhale as you lower them.
20ace88c-1983-4e60-ba55-8db1286bb410.name: Barbell Standing Leg Calf Raises

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across the front of your shoulders with your elbows pointing forward.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
213dd59a-f39b-4c41-a00f-a6b4ca4b6456.tips:
1. Keep your elbows up to maintain the barbell's position on your shoulders.
2. Engage your core to support your lower back throughout the squat.
3. Exhale as you push up from the squat and inhale as you lower down.
213dd59a-f39b-4c41-a00f-a6b4ca4b6456.name: Barbell Front Squat

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your legs extended and a foam roller under your calves.
2. Place your hands on the floor behind you for support, lifting your hips slightly off the ground.
3. Roll back and forth over the foam roller, focusing on the calf muscles, from the ankles to just below the knees.
4. Continue rolling for the desired duration, adjusting pressure as needed.
215f219f-2164-4eab-a4bf-7cbf4bc0a623.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Use your arms to control the pressure and speed of the rolling.
3. Avoid rolling directly over any bony areas or joints.
215f219f-2164-4eab-a4bf-7cbf4bc0a623.name: Foam Roller Calves

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell loaded into a landmine attachment.
2. Position the balls of your feet on a raised platform or block, allowing your heels to hang off.
3. Raise your heels as high as possible by contracting your calves, keeping your knees straight and the barbell steady.
4. Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
21fb7f36-6f31-4aa1-8825-189ea90c52ba.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control the barbell.
2. Avoid locking your knees during the exercise.
3. Exhale as you lift your heels and inhale as you lower them.
21fb7f36-6f31-4aa1-8825-189ea90c52ba.name: Landmine Calf Raise

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate in both hands overhead with arms fully extended.
2. Shrug your shoulders upward, lifting the weight plate as high as possible while keeping your arms straight.
3. Hold the top position briefly, then slowly lower your shoulders back to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
225a104e-4511-4c3c-9eba-2bd2ea92d5fc.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Avoid bending your elbows during the movement to focus on the trapezius.
3. Exhale as you shrug your shoulders and inhale as you lower them.
225a104e-4511-4c3c-9eba-2bd2ea92d5fc.name: Plate Overhead Shrug

instructions: 1. Begin in a kneeling position with your knees hip-width apart and your torso upright.
2. Engage your core and hinge at your hips to lower your torso forward, keeping your back straight.
3. Flex your knees to curl your legs towards your glutes, engaging your hamstrings.
4. Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2265d9e7-9636-45a4-ac78-500e0336d9ee.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control.
2. Avoid arching your back as you perform the curl.
3. Focus on a controlled movement to maximize hamstring activation.
2265d9e7-9636-45a4-ac78-500e0336d9ee.name: Mts Iso-Lateral Kneeling Leg Curl

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a bench, feet flat on the ground, and a barbell positioned over your hips.
2. Engage your core and glutes, then drive through your heels to lift your hips towards the ceiling.
3. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, ensuring your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
231cf500-1e98-4244-81ef-ad76444725f9.tips:
1. Keep your feet flat and drive through your heels for maximum glute engagement.
2. Avoid overarching your lower back at the top of the movement.
3. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
231cf500-1e98-4244-81ef-ad76444725f9.name: Barbell Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in the crook of your elbows, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, ensuring your knees track over your toes.
3. Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, maintaining an upright torso.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2326585e-a93b-4336-ac58-6145abbbfad3.tips:
1. Keep your elbows tucked in and the barbell close to your body throughout the movement.
2. Maintain a neutral spine and avoid leaning forward excessively.
3. Inhale as you descend and exhale as you push back up.
2326585e-a93b-4336-ac58-6145abbbfad3.name: Barbell Full Zercher Squat

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, feet flat on the ground, and a kettlebell resting on your hips.
2. Engage your core and glutes, then drive through your heels to lift your hips towards the ceiling.
3. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, ensuring your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2366af73-5628-49c5-b3b0-0323b3a709ae.tips:
1. Keep your feet flat and drive through your heels for maximum hip engagement.
2. Avoid overarching your lower back at the top of the movement.
3. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
2366af73-5628-49c5-b3b0-0323b3a709ae.name: Kettlebell Hip Thrusts

instructions: 1. Stand on one leg with a slight bend in your knee and your other leg lifted behind you.
2. Hinge at your hips to lower your torso forward while extending your lifted leg behind you for balance.
3. Keep your back straight and your core engaged as you lower your torso until it is parallel to the floor.
4. Return to the starting position by driving through your standing heel and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
24cc6ed4-47e0-4d96-a0e9-2fb4caa63f85.tips:
1. Maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.
2. Focus on a slow and controlled descent to enhance balance and stability.
3. Keep your core engaged to prevent any rotation of the hips.
24cc6ed4-47e0-4d96-a0e9-2fb4caa63f85.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Deadlift

instructions: 1. Begin in a plank position with your forearms on the ground and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
2. Shift your weight onto one forearm and lift the opposite arm off the ground, extending it in front of you.
3. Hold this position, keeping your core tight and hips level.
4. Return your arm to the starting position and switch sides, repeating for the desired duration.
24f82803-56e5-4988-9544-17aea0eed274.tips:
1. Keep your hips level and avoid rotating your torso.
2. Engage your core to maintain stability throughout the exercise.
3. Breathe steadily and avoid holding your breath.
24f82803-56e5-4988-9544-17aea0eed274.name: Unilateral Front Plank

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding the end of a barbell secured in a landmine attachment with both hands at chest level.
2. Step forward into a lunge with one leg, bending both knees to lower your hips.
3. As you lunge, twist your torso towards the front leg, keeping the barbell close to your chest.
4. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position and switch legs, repeating for the desired number of repetitions.
269ae0b3-71c3-4f31-b3e8-84c3eb36175f.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support the twist and maintain balance.
2. Ensure your front knee stays aligned with your toes during the lunge.
3. Exhale as you twist and lunge, and inhale as you return to the starting position.
269ae0b3-71c3-4f31-b3e8-84c3eb36175f.name: Landmine Alternating Lunge and Twist

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
2. Bend your knees slightly and prepare to jump by engaging your calves and core.
3. Explosively jump upwards, extending your ankles, knees, and hips fully.
4. Land softly with your knees slightly bent and immediately prepare for the next jump.
2721f62a-15ad-41f4-8301-361f8f9c78fc.tips:
1. Keep the barbell secure across your back to maintain balance.
2. Focus on a soft landing to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Exhale as you jump and inhale as you land.
2721f62a-15ad-41f4-8301-361f8f9c78fc.name: Barbell Calf Jump

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your heels on an exercise ball and your arms by your sides for stability.
2. Lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line from your shoulders to your heels.
3. Bend one knee to roll the ball towards your glutes while keeping the other leg extended diagonally.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
279416d2-bc8d-4047-9ac2-f49f986c4071.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability throughout the exercise.
2. Avoid letting your hips sag as you roll the ball.
3. Perform the movement slowly to maximize hamstring engagement.
279416d2-bc8d-4047-9ac2-f49f986c4071.name: Exercise Ball One Legged Diagonal Kick Hamstring Curl

instructions: 1. Begin in a kneeling position with your knees hip-width apart and your torso upright.
2. Engage your core and glutes, then shift your weight forward to rise to a standing position.
3. Maintain balance as you stand tall, keeping your core engaged.
4. Slowly lower yourself back to the kneeling position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2796991f-4e8a-46a4-a1cf-ad79f2aab1aa.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control.
2. Avoid using momentum to rise; focus on controlled movements.
3. Exhale as you stand and inhale as you kneel back down.
2796991f-4e8a-46a4-a1cf-ad79f2aab1aa.name: Bodyweight Kneeling Hold to Stand

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
2. Hinge at your hips and lower the barbell towards the floor, keeping your back straight and knees slightly bent.
3. Lower the barbell until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, keeping it close to your body.
4. Engage your glutes and hamstrings to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
27a2e956-4ae9-47e4-924d-b64f26311bc1.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
2. Focus on hinging at the hips rather than bending at the waist.
3. Inhale as you lower the barbell and exhale as you lift it back up.
27a2e956-4ae9-47e4-924d-b64f26311bc1.name: Barbell Sumo Romanian Deadlift

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands in front of your thighs.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge at your hips to lean forward, keeping your back straight.
3. Pull the plate towards your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
4. Lower the plate back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
27d55927-8043-4080-a2f3-e5155b62574b.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Avoid using momentum to lift the plate; focus on controlled movements.
3. Exhale as you row the plate towards your chest and inhale as you lower it.
27d55927-8043-4080-a2f3-e5155b62574b.name: Plate Pinch Grip Row

instructions: 1. Stand at the start of a set of monkey bars, reaching up to grasp the first bar with both hands.
2. Engage your core and swing your body to reach the next bar with one hand, then the other.
3. Continue swinging from bar to bar, maintaining a steady rhythm.
4. Reach the end of the bars and carefully dismount to the ground.
286116d8-5503-4de3-b0e9-6901aec7b244.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your swinging motion.
2. Use a controlled swing to prevent excessive momentum.
3. Focus on a firm grip to avoid slipping from the bars.
286116d8-5503-4de3-b0e9-6901aec7b244.name: Monkey Bar Swings

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball with both hands at chest level.
2. Engage your core and raise the ball overhead with both hands.
3. Throw the ball forcefully towards the ground in front of you, using your entire body.
4. Catch the ball on the rebound or pick it up and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
29210b68-6615-4b20-b92d-0978b3e4274c.tips:
1. Use your legs and core to generate power for the throw.
2. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
3. Exhale as you throw the ball and inhale as you reset.
29210b68-6615-4b20-b92d-0978b3e4274c.name: Overhead Med Ball Throw

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides.
2. Shift your weight onto one leg and lift the other leg out to the side, keeping it straight.
3. Raise your leg as high as comfortable while maintaining balance.
4. Lower your leg back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
29725f95-7e84-4128-b694-4f464bb620c1.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Avoid leaning to the side as you lift your leg.
3. Perform the movement slowly to enhance muscle control and activation.
29725f95-7e84-4128-b694-4f464bb620c1.name: Standing Side Leg Raises

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes slightly pointed out, and position a barbell across your upper back, gripping it with both hands wider than shoulder-width.
2. Engage your core and keep your chest up as you bend your knees and hips to lower your body into a squat, ensuring your knees track over your toes.
3. Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, maintaining a neutral spine throughout the movement.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
29f3f661-1e0e-4638-a0b7-1cf3d5ede035.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Avoid letting your knees collapse inward during the squat.
29f3f661-1e0e-4638-a0b7-1cf3d5ede035.name: Barbell Full Squat Wide

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand with an overhand grip, arms extended in front of your thighs.
2. Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lift the kettlebells vertically, leading with your elbows until they reach shoulder height.
3. Keep the kettlebells close to your body throughout the movement, ensuring your elbows remain higher than your wrists.
4. Slowly lower the kettlebells back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
29fd3aa9-13c3-490c-ba23-8720db0f53cb.tips:
1. Maintain a straight back and avoid shrugging your shoulders.
2. Exhale as you lift the kettlebells and inhale as you lower them.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on controlled movements.
29fd3aa9-13c3-490c-ba23-8720db0f53cb.name: Kettlebell Upright Row

instructions: 1. Sit on the seated row machine with your feet securely placed on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
2. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, keeping your arms extended and your back straight.
3. Pull the handles towards your torso by retracting your shoulder blades and bending your elbows, keeping your elbows close to your body.
4. Slowly extend your arms to return to the starting position, maintaining control throughout. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2b42184a-59d0-4c22-b9a6-c0dd0f0861e9.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid leaning too far back.
2. Exhale as you pull the handles towards you and inhale as you extend your arms.
3. Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together during the pull.
2b42184a-59d0-4c22-b9a6-c0dd0f0861e9.name: Seated Row Machine Rows

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. As you return to standing, press the dumbbells overhead by extending your arms fully.
4. Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height as you descend into the next squat. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2bca6c50-12ca-4349-911e-45f42f67ff25.tips:
1. Engage your core throughout the movement to maintain stability.
2. Inhale as you squat down and exhale as you press the dumbbells overhead.
3. Avoid arching your back during the shoulder press.
2bca6c50-12ca-4349-911e-45f42f67ff25.name: Dumbbell Squats to Shoulder Press

instructions: 1. Lie on your right side with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other, supporting your head with your right arm.
2. Engage your core and lift your left leg upwards while keeping it straight, leading with your heel.
3. Raise your leg as high as comfortable without rotating your hips, then pause briefly at the top.
4. Lower your leg back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2bef1e10-d795-4b1b-a10f-67b9cc25b28f.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent your hips from rotating.
2. Exhale as you lift your leg and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid swinging your leg; focus on controlled movements.
2bef1e10-d795-4b1b-a10f-67b9cc25b28f.name: Side Lying Leg Lift Right

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with a wide grip, palms facing up.
2. Keep your elbows close to your body as you curl the barbell towards your shoulders, squeezing your biceps at the top of the movement.
3. Avoid swinging your body or using momentum as you lift the barbell.
4. Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2cbe26d3-3a2c-4868-a70d-727fc9039b25.tips:
1. Keep your upper arms stationary and focus on using your biceps to lift the barbell.
2. Exhale as you curl the barbell up and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid using your back to lift the weight; maintain a stable posture.
2cbe26d3-3a2c-4868-a70d-727fc9039b25.name: Barbell Biceps Curl Wide Grip

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band with both hands, and position it over your shoulders.
2. Lower your body into a sumo squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Ensure your knees track over your toes as you descend, going as low as comfortable.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2d4687dd-eb08-4872-a8f6-9c55bfdefc5c.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
