3. Avoid letting your knees collapse inward during the squat.
2d4687dd-eb08-4872-a8f6-9c55bfdefc5c.name: Sumo Squat Over Shoulder Resistance Band

instructions: 1. Stand facing away from a cable pulley machine, feet shoulder-width apart, and grasp the rope attachment with both hands between your legs.
2. Bend at the hips and knees slightly, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
3. Pull the rope through your legs by extending your hips forward, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
4. Slowly return to the starting position by bending at the hips. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2d5dae38-26d6-4627-af88-79ac6efcec87.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
2. Exhale as you pull the rope through and inhale as you return to the starting position.
3. Focus on using your glutes and hamstrings to drive the movement.
2d5dae38-26d6-4627-af88-79ac6efcec87.name: Cable Pull Through

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides.
2. Step back with your right foot into a lunge, bending both knees to lower your body, while simultaneously raising your arms in front of you to shoulder height.
3. Keep your front knee over your ankle and your back knee hovering above the floor.
4. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position, lowering your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
2d728df0-8de3-48ae-8cb3-c5c47fe4f49f.tips:
1. Maintain a straight back and engage your core throughout the movement.
2. Inhale as you step back into the lunge and exhale as you return to standing.
3. Avoid letting your front knee extend past your toes.
2d728df0-8de3-48ae-8cb3-c5c47fe4f49f.name: Bodyweight Rear Lunge Front Raise

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a bench, holding a barbell across your upper back with a shoulder-width grip.
2. Place your right foot on the bench behind you, ensuring your left foot is firmly planted on the ground.
3. Lower your body into a split squat by bending your left knee, keeping your chest up and back straight.
4. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
2dce7bba-da1d-44e1-adf3-f75676f5b1cd.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes.
2dce7bba-da1d-44e1-adf3-f75676f5b1cd.name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding the end of a barbell in a landmine attachment with both hands at chest height.
2. Step your right foot back and across your left leg into a curtsy lunge, bending both knees.
3. Keep your chest up and core engaged as you lower your body, ensuring your front knee tracks over your toes.
4. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
2de71a74-a150-4e00-a1f0-160999d8b10f.tips:
1. Maintain a straight back and avoid leaning forward.
2. Inhale as you lower into the lunge and exhale as you return to standing.
3. Focus on keeping your movements controlled and your core engaged.
2de71a74-a150-4e00-a1f0-160999d8b10f.name: Landmine Goblet Curtsy Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand on one leg with a kettlebell in the same side hand, allowing it to hang by your side.
2. Engage your core and raise your heel off the ground, balancing on the ball of your foot.
3. Hold the top position briefly, focusing on contracting your calf muscle.
4. Lower your heel back to the ground with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
2df813ec-ff53-48f5-b28b-15bd0491f25e.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Exhale as you lift your heel and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid leaning to the side; keep your upper body upright.
2df813ec-ff53-48f5-b28b-15bd0491f25e.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Calf Raise

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band under your feet and the handles in each hand with a neutral grip.
2. Keep your elbows close to your body as you curl one handle towards your shoulder, squeezing your biceps at the top.
3. Lower the handle back to the starting position with control while simultaneously curling the opposite handle.
4. Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
2df8b865-3f4a-491b-984c-ef65bb095700.tips:
1. Keep your upper arms stationary and focus on using your biceps to lift the band.
2. Exhale as you curl the band up and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid swinging your body; maintain a stable posture.
2df8b865-3f4a-491b-984c-ef65bb095700.name: Alternating Biceps Hammer Curl Resistance Band

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Explode upwards into a jump, extending your legs fully and swinging your arms overhead.
4. Land softly, immediately lowering into another squat to repeat the jump. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2e484214-bf19-4fcd-90dd-2c38ea3b1186.tips:
1. Engage your core to maintain stability during the jumps.
2. Exhale as you jump and inhale as you land and lower into the squat.
3. Focus on landing softly to reduce impact on your joints.
2e484214-bf19-4fcd-90dd-2c38ea3b1186.name: Double Jump Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, extend one arm overhead, and grasp your opposite wrist with your other hand.
2. Gently pull your extended arm across your body, feeling a stretch in your biceps and shoulder.
3. Hold the stretch for a comfortable duration, keeping your core engaged and back straight.
4. Release the stretch and switch arms, repeating on the opposite side.
2e60ceee-dbb5-48ed-84e8-e1ace95af462.tips:
1. Avoid pulling too hard; the stretch should be gentle and comfortable.
2. Breathe deeply and evenly throughout the stretch.
3. Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid hunching them.
2e60ceee-dbb5-48ed-84e8-e1ace95af462.name: Single Arm Extended Pull Downwards Biceps Stretch

instructions: 1. Stand upright holding a weight plate with both hands at chest level, feet hip-width apart.
2. Step forward with your right leg, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at about a 90-degree angle.
3. Push through the heel of your right foot to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement with the left leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
2eb69e78-2284-44de-a4c5-0745fefcfd5c.tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and core engaged throughout the exercise.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
3. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you step forward.
2eb69e78-2284-44de-a4c5-0745fefcfd5c.name: Plate Forward Lunge

instructions: 1. Sit on the leg press machine with your back flat against the pad and one foot on the platform, the other foot resting on the floor.
2. Extend your leg to push the platform away, keeping your foot flat and your knee slightly bent at the end of the movement.
3. Slowly bend your knee to lower the platform back to the starting position with control.
4. Complete the desired number of repetitions before switching to the other leg.
2ffb0996-fe81-4369-977b-b5bd847ed64a.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Avoid locking your knee at the top of the movement to prevent joint strain.
3. Exhale as you press the platform away and inhale as you lower it back.
2ffb0996-fe81-4369-977b-b5bd847ed64a.name: Horizontal Leg Press Single Leg

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with a wide grip in front of your thighs.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips to lower the barbell to just above your knees.
3. Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles to lift the barbell overhead in one fluid motion, catching it with your arms fully extended.
4. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control, ready for the next repetition.
305f97e6-2c2c-4b17-a032-5427c232289b.tips:
1. Keep the barbell close to your body throughout the movement to maintain control.
2. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine to protect your back.
3. Exhale as you lift the barbell and inhale as you lower it back down.
305f97e6-2c2c-4b17-a032-5427c232289b.name: Barbell Power Snatch

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Step forward with your right leg, lowering your hips until your right thigh is parallel to the floor and your left knee nearly touches the ground.
3. Push through the heel of your right foot to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement with the left leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
30d70f09-eaf0-4c07-9df4-45b99e5a4db2.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
3. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you step forward.
30d70f09-eaf0-4c07-9df4-45b99e5a4db2.name: Barbell Split Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Position your left foot forward and your right foot back, lowering your hips into a lunge position with your left thigh parallel to the floor.
3. Push through the heel of your left foot to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
30fd9884-6db8-4a1d-b56f-1e5dc9c1e4db.tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
3. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you lower into the lunge.
30fd9884-6db8-4a1d-b56f-1e5dc9c1e4db.name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat Left Front-Back View

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a weight plate with both hands above your chest.
2. Lift your hips off the floor to form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees, engaging your glutes and core.
3. Simultaneously lower the plate over your head towards the floor while maintaining the bridge position.
4. Return the plate to the starting position above your chest and lower your hips back to the floor.
31158952-9b7d-466d-80cd-f0ac66d075ca.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Ensure your hips remain elevated and level throughout the exercise.
3. Exhale as you lower the plate and inhale as you bring it back to the starting position.
31158952-9b7d-466d-80cd-f0ac66d075ca.name: Plate Glute Bridge to Pullover

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand between your legs.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips to lower the dumbbell towards the floor.
3. Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles to lift the dumbbell overhead in one fluid motion, catching it with your arm fully extended.
4. Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control, ready for the next repetition.
31dd7dc6-27a3-4645-8e3b-4ce0b0836925.tips:
1. Keep the dumbbell close to your body throughout the movement to maintain control.
2. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine to protect your back.
3. Exhale as you lift the dumbbell and inhale as you lower it back down.
31dd7dc6-27a3-4645-8e3b-4ce0b0836925.name: Dumbbell One Arm Snatch

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a weight plate with both hands in front of your thighs.
2. Keeping your arms straight, raise the plate in front of you to shoulder height.
3. Lower the plate back to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
3202de6a-2b5a-46cd-b629-d56b5b7700e0.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and prevent leaning back.
2. Avoid locking your elbows to reduce strain on the joints.
3. Exhale as you raise the plate and inhale as you lower it back down.
3202de6a-2b5a-46cd-b629-d56b5b7700e0.name: Seated Plate Front Raises

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands at chest level.
2. Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Hold the squat position for the desired duration, maintaining tension in your quadriceps.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat as needed.
3242bbf9-8977-492e-9fc4-0e89f34d55f5.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
3. Breathe steadily throughout the hold, avoiding holding your breath.
3242bbf9-8977-492e-9fc4-0e89f34d55f5.name: Plate Squat Hold

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Step to the side with your right leg, lowering your hips into a lateral lunge while keeping your left leg straight.
3. Push through the heel of your right foot to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement with the left leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
326d3a16-735e-44a7-95b1-1e98500f61a6.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Ensure your lunging knee does not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
3. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you step to the side.
326d3a16-735e-44a7-95b1-1e98500f61a6.name: Barbell Lateral Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
2. Extend one leg forward, keeping it straight, and hinge at the hips to lower your torso towards the extended leg.
3. Reach towards your toes with your hands, maintaining a straight back.
4. Hold the stretch for the desired duration before switching to the other leg.
32aca155-c9a9-4ee1-9a5a-8ce3389e379a.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back during the stretch.
2. Avoid bouncing or jerking movements to prevent injury.
3. Breathe deeply and steadily to enhance the stretch and relaxation.
32aca155-c9a9-4ee1-9a5a-8ce3389e379a.name: Standing Straight-Leg Hamstring Stretch

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands at chest level.
2. Step backward with your right leg, lowering your hips until your left thigh is parallel to the floor and your right knee nearly touches the ground.
3. Push through the heel of your left foot to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement with the right leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
33ad7d5a-04c7-40d6-9ed0-b2f4c7a48874.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
3. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you step backward.
33ad7d5a-04c7-40d6-9ed0-b2f4c7a48874.name: Dumbbell Goblet Reverse Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands in front of your thighs.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips to lower the plate towards the floor.
3. Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles to lift the plate to shoulder height, catching it with your arms bent.
4. Lower the plate back to the starting position with control, ready for the next repetition.
34404c04-1698-48e4-9125-8a5a1942a2d1.tips:
1. Keep the plate close to your body throughout the movement to maintain control.
2. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine to protect your back.
3. Exhale as you lift the plate and inhale as you lower it back down.
34404c04-1698-48e4-9125-8a5a1942a2d1.name: Plate Clean

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the end of a barbell attached to a landmine attachment with one hand.
2. Keeping your arm straight, lift the barbell laterally to shoulder height.
3. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching arms.
34b916ea-c189-4820-96ef-3064770721d0.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and prevent leaning.
2. Avoid locking your elbow to reduce strain on the joint.
3. Exhale as you lift the barbell and inhale as you lower it back down.
34b916ea-c189-4820-96ef-3064770721d0.name: Landmine Lateral Raise

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides.
2. Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Explosively jump upward, extending your legs fully and swinging your arms overhead.
4. Land softly back into the squat position and immediately repeat the jump for the desired number of repetitions.
34fcd4bf-d337-42b2-aa4b-3760378da1bb.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Land softly with your knees slightly bent to absorb impact and protect your joints.
3. Exhale as you jump and inhale as you land back into the squat.
34fcd4bf-d337-42b2-aa4b-3760378da1bb.name: Jump Squats Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward, and arms extended in front of you or crossed over your chest.
2. Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight, until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
3. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your legs.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
3542473c-a708-46cf-bcec-b78d41f25c68.tips:
1. Keep your weight on your heels to maintain balance and prevent knee strain.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Avoid letting your knees cave inward during the squat.
3542473c-a708-46cf-bcec-b78d41f25c68.name: Bodyweight Squat

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a bench or elevated surface with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
2. Place the top of your left foot on the bench behind you, keeping your right foot firmly planted on the ground.
3. Lower your body by bending your right knee, keeping your torso upright, until your right thigh is parallel to the floor.
4. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
363a6fab-00c0-435a-8721-43a081351803.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance throughout the movement.
2. Inhale as you lower your body and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
363a6fab-00c0-435a-8721-43a081351803.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat

instructions: 1. Stand behind the sled with your feet shoulder-width apart, gripping the low handles firmly.
2. Lean forward slightly, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
3. Drive through your legs to push the sled forward, maintaining a steady pace.
4. Continue pushing for the desired distance or time, then carefully stop and return to the starting position.
363f111c-2758-4b00-b746-05dae7a32832.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to stabilize your body and prevent lower back strain.
2. Maintain a steady breathing pattern, exhaling as you push forward.
3. Avoid rounding your back; keep your spine neutral throughout the exercise.
363f111c-2758-4b00-b746-05dae7a32832.name: Low Sled Push

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Lift your heels off the ground to stand on your toes, keeping your core engaged and knees slightly bent.
3. Hold the top position briefly, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
3714c5a4-3280-490c-b14d-b9d30e92f1c1.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to maintain balance and control.
2. Exhale as you lift your heels and inhale as you lower them.
3. Avoid locking your knees; keep them slightly bent throughout the exercise.
3714c5a4-3280-490c-b14d-b9d30e92f1c1.name: Barbell Standing Leg Calf Raise

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding the end of a barbell secured in a landmine attachment with both hands.
2. Hinge at your hips and slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
3. Lower the barbell towards the floor by bending at the hips, maintaining a slight bend in your knees.
4. Return to the starting position by extending your hips and standing upright. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
373d9902-3085-4852-a85e-5a7b5534be8e.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders throughout the movement.
2. Inhale as you lower the barbell and exhale as you return to the starting position.
3. Focus on hinging at the hips rather than bending at the waist to protect your lower back.
373d9902-3085-4852-a85e-5a7b5534be8e.name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your knees bent, feet flat, and lean back slightly while keeping your back straight.
2. Extend your arms in front of you with your palms together.
3. Rotate your torso to the right, bringing your arms across your body, then return to the center.
4. Rotate to the left and return to the center. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
37e756b7-605e-41b7-948e-d6ef544181a1.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to support your lower back.
2. Exhale as you twist and inhale as you return to the center.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on controlled movements to engage your core effectively.
37e756b7-605e-41b7-948e-d6ef544181a1.name: Seated Twist

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your legs straight and a resistance band looped around your ankles.
2. Place your arms by your sides for support and engage your core.
3. Lift your legs towards the ceiling, keeping them straight and together, until your hips are off the ground.
4. Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3882dce1-df59-4bf0-8813-1391205e0a8b.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent your lower back from arching off the floor.
2. Exhale as you lift your legs and inhale as you lower them.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on slow, controlled movements to maximize muscle engagement.
3882dce1-df59-4bf0-8813-1391205e0a8b.name: Resistance Band Lying Leg Raise

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet together and hands at your sides.
2. Jump into a squat position with your feet shoulder-width apart, lowering your hips back and down.
3. Jump back to the starting position with your feet together.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
38843e8c-4a5a-42ed-b859-28080795f1f6.tips:
1. Land softly on the balls of your feet to reduce impact on your joints.
2. Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the exercise.
3. Avoid letting your knees cave inward during the squat phase.
38843e8c-4a5a-42ed-b859-28080795f1f6.name: In and Out Squats

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with a wide grip.
2. Perform a partial squat to lower your body slightly, then explosively extend your legs while simultaneously pressing the barbell overhead.
3. Drop into a full squat position as you catch the barbell overhead, keeping your core engaged and back straight.
4. Stand up from the squat position with the barbell overhead, then lower it back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
38d32bf5-f03f-4001-a138-741370744ea8.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to stabilize your body during the movement.
2. Exhale as you press the barbell overhead and inhale as you lower it.
3. Focus on a smooth transition between the squat and overhead press to maintain control.
38d32bf5-f03f-4001-a138-741370744ea8.name: Barbell Snatch Balance

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward, and arms at your sides.
2. Lower your body into a squat position, placing your hands on the ground in front of you.
3. Explosively jump forward, extending your arms overhead as you leap.
4. Land softly and immediately lower back into the squat position to repeat the jump. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
38d41f0e-8bce-4a79-937f-135a8dbed3be.tips:
1. Land softly on the balls of your feet to minimize impact on your joints.
2. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control during the jumps.
3. Avoid letting your knees cave inward during the landing phase.
38d41f0e-8bce-4a79-937f-135a8dbed3be.name: Frog Jumps

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your feet elevated on a bench or box, knees bent, and a dumbbell resting on your hips.
2. Cross your right ankle over your left knee to form a figure four position.
3. Engage your glutes and lift your hips towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
3921174f-0c79-4e9d-a5ac-63e891ec29a6.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back throughout the exercise.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure your hips remain level and avoid twisting during the movement.
3921174f-0c79-4e9d-a5ac-63e891ec29a6.name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Lie on your side with your legs straight and a resistance band looped around your ankles.
2. Rest your head on your lower arm and place your top hand on the floor for support.
3. Lift your top leg upwards against the resistance of the band, keeping your leg straight.
4. Lower your leg back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
3968de2b-a25c-4cb6-bdd8-8ab579f7654e.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and prevent your body from rolling forward or backward.
2. Exhale as you lift your leg and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on slow, controlled movements to maximize muscle engagement.
3968de2b-a25c-4cb6-bdd8-8ab579f7654e.name: Resistance Band Lying Abduction

instructions: 1. Stand on a stepbox with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell with both hands.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your legs.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
3a0bd773-74d0-43de-bccc-e6a0109c8065.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control throughout the exercise.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure your knees track over your toes to avoid strain.
3a0bd773-74d0-43de-bccc-e6a0109c8065.name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat Off Stepbox

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward, and hands at your sides.
2. Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Perform small pulses by raising and lowering your body a few inches while maintaining the squat position.
4. Repeat the pulsing movement for the desired number of repetitions.
3a36ef4e-63d9-4bb0-9716-66a2b44e7559.tips:
1. Keep your weight on your heels to maintain balance and prevent knee strain.
2. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling during the pulses.
3. Avoid letting your knees cave inward during the squat.
3a36ef4e-63d9-4bb0-9716-66a2b44e7559.name: Bodyweight Pulse Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms at your sides.
2. Curl one dumbbell towards your shoulder by bending your elbow, keeping your upper arm stationary.
3. Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control, then curl the other dumbbell towards your shoulder.
4. Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
3a86f643-3952-4216-85d7-e66c53513464.tips:
1. Keep your elbows close to your body to maximize bicep engagement.
2. Exhale as you curl the dumbbell upwards and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid swinging your arms or using momentum; focus on controlled movements.
3a86f643-3952-4216-85d7-e66c53513464.name: Dumbbell Curl Alternating

instructions: 1. Sit on the ground with your upper back resting against a bench, and place a kettlebell on your hip. Bend one knee and keep the foot flat on the floor while extending the other leg straight out.
2. Engage your core and drive through the heel of the bent leg to lift your hips towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knee.
3. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your hips back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
3b5a466f-3212-4848-870c-03c3721601ab.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout to maintain stability.
2. Avoid arching your lower back; focus on the glute contraction.
3. Ensure the kettlebell is securely positioned to prevent slipping.
3b5a466f-3212-4848-870c-03c3721601ab.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Hip Thrust

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip just outside your knees.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge at your hips to lower the barbell to just above your knees.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees, pulling the barbell up towards your chest while keeping your elbows high and out.
4. Lower the barbell back to the starting position in a controlled manner and repeat.
3bcb1bd0-70bc-49f5-aac9-9abd3e15a87c.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Focus on a powerful hip extension to generate momentum.
3. Avoid using your arms to lift the bar; the power should come from your hips and legs.
3bcb1bd0-70bc-49f5-aac9-9abd3e15a87c.name: Barbell Snatch Pull

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and step one foot back into a lunge position, lowering your back knee towards the floor.
2. Hold the lunge position and perform small pulses by slightly raising and lowering your body.
3. Maintain the lunge position throughout the pulses, keeping your front knee aligned over your ankle.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
3bf8bbf8-031f-43ed-9f1a-396c0aa9295c.tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes.
3. Perform the pulses with control to avoid any jerky movements.
3bf8bbf8-031f-43ed-9f1a-396c0aa9295c.name: Lunge Pulses Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Begin in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
2. Quickly drive one knee towards your chest, then switch legs in a jumping motion, bringing the opposite knee forward.
3. Continue alternating legs in a fast-paced, controlled manner, keeping your hips low and core engaged.
4. Maintain the plank position throughout the exercise and repeat for the desired duration.
3ce0448b-9102-44a0-aa2c-f66fa3b47f66.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to prevent your hips from sagging.
2. Land softly on the balls of your feet to reduce impact.
3. Focus on maintaining a steady rhythm and controlled breathing.
3ce0448b-9102-44a0-aa2c-f66fa3b47f66.name: Mountain Climber Jumps

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands at chest level.
2. Lift the plate overhead and begin to rotate it around your head in a circular motion, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
3. Complete a full circle in one direction, then reverse the motion to circle the plate in the opposite direction.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, alternating directions.
3d7e1ed8-218b-41a3-b3de-87b9e0329821.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to stabilize your torso during the movement.
2. Avoid moving your head; the motion should come from your shoulders.
3. Maintain a firm grip on the plate to ensure control throughout the exercise.
3d7e1ed8-218b-41a3-b3de-87b9e0329821.name: Plate Halo

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a weight plate overhead with both hands.
2. Step forward with one leg into a lunge position, lowering your back knee towards the floor while keeping the plate overhead.
3. Push through your front heel to return to a standing position, bringing your back foot forward to meet the front foot.
4. Continue walking forward, alternating legs with each lunge, and keeping the plate steady overhead.
3e3f1b28-850b-43dc-984a-27a2abc70f2a.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back and maintain balance.
2. Ensure your front knee stays aligned over your ankle during each lunge.
3. Avoid leaning forward; keep your torso upright throughout the movement.
3e3f1b28-850b-43dc-984a-27a2abc70f2a.name: Plate Overhead Walking Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand overhead with your arm fully extended.
2. Step forward with the opposite leg into a lunge position, lowering your back knee towards the floor.
3. Push through your front heel to return to a standing position, keeping the dumbbell overhead throughout the movement.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms and legs.
3e52d93b-5c83-4210-b99b-efe8e59ee54b.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and balance.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes during the lunge.
3. Maintain a firm grip on the dumbbell to keep it stable overhead.
3e52d93b-5c83-4210-b99b-efe8e59ee54b.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and step one foot back into a reverse lunge, lowering your back knee towards the floor.
2. Push through your front heel to return to standing, then immediately tap your foot out to the side.
3. Return to the starting position and repeat the sequence for four reverse lunges and four side taps.
4. Continue alternating between reverse lunges and side taps for the desired number of repetitions.
3f0ee006-280f-4d40-a954-52910ddd7c88.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control.
2. Ensure your front knee stays aligned over your ankle during the lunges.
3. Perform the side taps with control to avoid any jerky movements.
3f0ee006-280f-4d40-a954-52910ddd7c88.name: 4 Reverse Lunge and 4 Side Taps

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands at your thighs.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge at your hips to lower the plate to just above the floor.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees to lift the plate overhead, pressing it upwards as you rise to a standing position.
4. Lower the plate back to the starting position in a controlled manner and repeat.
3f9056a4-9116-497d-b04e-15e53591087a.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Use your hips and legs to generate power for the lift, not just your arms.
3. Maintain a firm grip on the plate to ensure control during the exercise.
3f9056a4-9116-497d-b04e-15e53591087a.name: Plate Clean and Press

instructions: 1. Attach a sled to a kettlebell using a sturdy rope or strap, and stand facing away from the sled with the kettlebell between your legs.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge at your hips to grasp the kettlebell handle with both hands.
3. Engage your core and begin walking forward, dragging the sled behind you while keeping your back straight.
4. Continue walking for the desired distance, maintaining a steady pace and controlled breathing.
3fcf1686-bfa0-4105-a2de-62751c75b7b7.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Ensure the rope or strap is securely attached to the kettlebell and sled to prevent slipping.
3. Focus on maintaining a steady pace and avoid leaning forward excessively.
3fcf1686-bfa0-4105-a2de-62751c75b7b7.name: Kettlebell Sled Drag

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball with both hands.
2. Raise the ball overhead, then slam it down to the ground with force, bending your knees slightly as you do so.
3. Immediately drop into a burpee by placing your hands on the ground, jumping your feet back into a plank position, and then returning to standing.
4. Pick up the ball and repeat the sequence for the desired number of repetitions.
3ff57fd4-bf0b-477b-9598-5a1561e094de.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back during the slam.
2. Use your entire body to generate power for the slam, not just your arms.
3. Land softly on the balls of your feet during the burpee to reduce impact.
3ff57fd4-bf0b-477b-9598-5a1561e094de.name: Med Ball Slam Burpees

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a barbell resting across your knees.
2. Place the balls of your feet on a weight plate or block to elevate your heels.
3. Raise your heels as high as possible by contracting your calf muscles, keeping the barbell steady on your knees.
4. Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
40d8bf1f-b0ef-4739-8b91-c0640d3dade1.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Avoid bouncing the weight; perform the movement with control.
3. Ensure the barbell is securely positioned on your knees to prevent slipping.
40d8bf1f-b0ef-4739-8b91-c0640d3dade1.name: Barbell Seated on Knee Calve Raises

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Position yourself in front of a bench or box, and lower your body into a squat until your glutes lightly touch the surface.
3. Push through your heels to return to a standing position, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
4. Repeat the squat for the desired number of repetitions, ensuring the barbell remains stable on your back.
410924c5-7b5a-4799-9178-5627cc9a78ae.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back and maintain balance.
2. Ensure your knees track over your toes during the squat.
3. Avoid bouncing off the bench; use it as a depth guide only.
410924c5-7b5a-4799-9178-5627cc9a78ae.name: Barbell Bench Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands at your thighs.
2. Curl the plate towards your chest by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
3. Once the plate reaches chest level, press it overhead by extending your arms fully.
4. Lower the plate back to the starting position in a controlled manner and repeat.
41998978-5cba-497e-a3e6-bbb20ea92f5e.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Avoid swinging the plate; perform the movement with control.
3. Ensure a firm grip on the plate to prevent it from slipping during the exercise.
41998978-5cba-497e-a3e6-bbb20ea92f5e.name: Plate Curl to Overhead Press

instructions: 1. Stand facing a suspension trainer, holding the grips with both hands and stepping one foot back into a split squat position.
2. Lower your back knee towards the floor while keeping your front knee aligned over your ankle.
3. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position, maintaining tension on the suspension trainer.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
41e4779b-9a58-44c5-a37e-1e3f5d910dfd.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes during the squat.
3. Use the suspension trainer for support, but avoid relying on it excessively.
41e4779b-9a58-44c5-a37e-1e3f5d910dfd.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Split Squat

instructions: 1. Position a barbell in a landmine attachment and stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold the end of the barbell with both hands at chest level.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, extending your knees and hips fully.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
420fdc14-4200-46cc-9e5c-395317591b47.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the movement to maintain stability.
2. Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not cave inward.
3. Avoid rounding your back by keeping your chest lifted and shoulders back.
420fdc14-4200-46cc-9e5c-395317591b47.name: Landmine Hack Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing down) just outside your knees.
2. Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and knees slightly bent, until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
3. Pull the barbell towards your lower ribcage, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
4. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
4220a2a7-bf62-47b6-a2ba-6c08773565a9.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to protect your lower back.
2. Avoid using momentum by performing the movement in a controlled manner.
3. Maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise to prevent injury.
4220a2a7-bf62-47b6-a2ba-6c08773565a9.name: Barbell Bent Over Row Pronate Grip

instructions: 1. Stand facing a cable pulley machine with a straight bar attached to the high pulley. Hold the bar with a shoulder-width grip, arms fully extended overhead.
2. Keeping your arms straight, pull the bar down in an arc motion until it reaches your thighs, engaging your lats.
3. Slowly return the bar to the starting position with control, maintaining straight arms.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
423a9098-ccd1-4d13-9a3f-32c55f15f29e.tips:
1. Keep your shoulders down and back to maximize lat engagement.
2. Exhale as you pull the bar down and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
3. Avoid bending your elbows to ensure the focus remains on your lats.
423a9098-ccd1-4d13-9a3f-32c55f15f29e.name: Straight Arm Cable Lat Pull Down

instructions: 1. Begin standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides.
2. Quickly drop into a squat position, placing your hands on the ground in front of you.
3. Jump your feet back to land in a plank position, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels.
4. Jump your feet back towards your hands, then explosively jump into the air, reaching your arms overhead. Land softly and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
423c590e-fa45-4253-91f5-4ae0db51c8aa.tips:
1. Engage your core throughout the movement to maintain stability.
2. Land softly to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Keep your movements controlled to avoid injury.
423c590e-fa45-4253-91f5-4ae0db51c8aa.name: Cluster

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands at chest level.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Hold the squat position and extend the plate forward at shoulder height, keeping your arms straight.
4. Return the plate to your chest, stand up from the squat, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
4312834b-56b4-4ccb-b50c-182876503c9b.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes during the squat.
3. Maintain a straight back and avoid leaning forward excessively.
4312834b-56b4-4ccb-b50c-182876503c9b.name: Plate Squat Hold Reach

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench or chair with your forearm resting on your thigh, holding a kettlebell in your hand with your palm facing up.
2. Allow your wrist to extend downward, lowering the kettlebell towards the floor.
3. Flex your wrist to lift the kettlebell back up to the starting position, engaging your forearm muscles.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
437f839a-95d6-4402-a1a5-0ccb13cdf62f.tips:
1. Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize forearm engagement.
2. Avoid using your shoulder or elbow to lift the kettlebell; focus on wrist movement.
3. Exhale as you lift the kettlebell and inhale as you lower it.
437f839a-95d6-4402-a1a5-0ccb13cdf62f.name: Kettlebell Wrist Extension

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. As you rise from the squat, press the barbell overhead, extending your arms fully.
4. Lower the barbell back to shoulder height as you return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
43884874-e707-47ea-8c8c-060e1472bfac.tips:
1. Engage your core to maintain stability throughout the movement.
2. Ensure your knees track over your toes during the squat.
3. Avoid arching your back when pressing the barbell overhead.
43884874-e707-47ea-8c8c-060e1472bfac.name: Barbell Press Under

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides.
2. Step forward with your right foot into a lunge position, bending both knees to 90 degrees.
3. As you rise from the lunge, kick your left leg forward, extending it fully.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side for the desired number of repetitions.
43c3e3a0-f06e-4823-b0ab-229ec54829ec.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes during the lunge.
3. Perform the kick with control to avoid losing balance.
43c3e3a0-f06e-4823-b0ab-229ec54829ec.name: Lunge Front Kick

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, toes pointing forward, and hands on your hips or at your sides.
2. Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, balancing on the balls of your feet.
3. Hold the top position briefly, squeezing your calf muscles.
4. Lower your heels back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
4436790e-a5b6-477d-bc43-66f467054980.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Avoid locking your knees; keep them slightly bent.
3. Perform the movement slowly to maximize calf engagement.
4436790e-a5b6-477d-bc43-66f467054980.name: Bodyweight Standing Calf Raise

instructions: 1. Step onto the stepmill machine and select your desired speed setting.
2. Begin stepping by lifting one foot and placing it on the next step, alternating legs in a continuous motion.
3. Keep your posture upright, engaging your core and using the handrails for balance if needed.
4. Continue stepping for the desired duration or number of steps.
44d8de38-be22-41e0-9046-cbcc1ab765c9.tips:
1. Maintain an upright posture to avoid leaning on the handrails excessively.
2. Keep a steady pace to ensure a consistent workout.
3. Focus on engaging your core and leg muscles for maximum benefit.
44d8de38-be22-41e0-9046-cbcc1ab765c9.name: Stepmill Machine Steps

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, placing a resistance band around your thighs just above your knees.
2. Lift your right leg off the ground, keeping your knee bent at a 90-degree angle.
3. Press through your left heel to lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
44f60e58-f312-44fd-86f8-5611c7b38ef3.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Ensure your hips remain level throughout the movement.
3. Avoid letting the resistance band slacken; maintain tension for maximum glute activation.
44f60e58-f312-44fd-86f8-5611c7b38ef3.name: Resistance Band One Leg Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Sit on the leg curl machine and adjust the pad so it rests comfortably against the back of your lower legs, just above your heels.
2. Grasp the handles and ensure your knees are aligned with the machine's pivot point.
3. Curl your legs downward by bending your knees, bringing the pad towards your glutes.
4. Slowly return to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
45179a86-5f28-40f0-9f0f-b28927a9994b.tips:
1. Keep your movements controlled to avoid using momentum.
2. Exhale as you curl the weight and inhale as you return to the starting position.
3. Ensure the machine is properly adjusted to your body to prevent strain on your knees.
45179a86-5f28-40f0-9f0f-b28927a9994b.name: Seated Leg Curl Machine

instructions: 1. Attach a resistance band to a low anchor point and kneel on all fours, facing away from the anchor.
2. Loop the band around your right foot, keeping your knee bent at a 90-degree angle.
3. Extend your right leg straight back, engaging your glutes and keeping your core tight.
4. Return your leg to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
45761dde-7ca9-4de0-91d8-4d9b4731f243.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and prevent lower back strain.
2. Avoid arching your back; focus on using your glutes to extend your leg.
3. Perform the movement slowly to maximize muscle engagement.
45761dde-7ca9-4de0-91d8-4d9b4731f243.name: Band Kneeling Rear Kick

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet together, arms at your sides.
2. Step diagonally forward with your right foot, bending both knees to lower into a lunge.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement on the opposite side for the desired number of repetitions.
45ee2f59-28fc-450d-9537-22428a5c75fb.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes during the lunge.
3. Perform the movement with control to avoid unnecessary strain on your knees.
45ee2f59-28fc-450d-9537-22428a5c75fb.name: Diagonal Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with a wide grip.
2. Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees to lift the barbell overhead, catching it in a squat position.
4. Stand up fully to complete the lift, then lower the barbell back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
46682aad-e5da-47f8-8f93-b5607e92a7ef.tips:
1. Engage your core throughout the movement to maintain stability.
2. Keep the barbell close to your body during the lift to maximize control.
3. Use your legs and hips to generate power, avoiding excessive strain on your shoulders.
46682aad-e5da-47f8-8f93-b5607e92a7ef.name: Barbell Snatch

instructions: 1. Stand with your front foot elevated on a platform or step, holding a dumbbell vertically with both hands at chest level.
2. Step back with your other leg into a split stance, keeping your torso upright and core engaged.
3. Lower your back knee towards the ground, ensuring your front knee stays aligned over your ankle.
4. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
468e77f9-5383-43d6-b8e2-7d15336a4230.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and shoulders back throughout the movement.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Avoid letting your front knee extend past your toes to prevent strain.
468e77f9-5383-43d6-b8e2-7d15336a4230.name: Dumbbell Goblet Split Squat Front Foot Elevanted

instructions: 1. Stand facing a sturdy platform or step, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Place one foot on the platform, ensuring your entire foot is secure.
3. Push through your elevated foot to lift your body onto the platform, bringing your trailing leg up to stand fully.
4. Step back down with control, returning to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
46c6b438-33da-40b4-ba55-456e76de4e93.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Exhale as you step up and inhale as you step down.
3. Ensure the platform is stable and non-slip to prevent accidents.
46c6b438-33da-40b4-ba55-456e76de4e93.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Step-Up

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your feet elevated on a chair, knees bent at a 90-degree angle, and arms by your sides.
2. Engage your core and glutes, then lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
3. Hold the bridge position briefly, squeezing your glutes at the top.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
470ceeee-81b3-4da1-9ea1-04cff664ff13.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to prevent arching your lower back.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure your feet are securely placed on the chair to maintain stability.
470ceeee-81b3-4da1-9ea1-04cff664ff13.name: Chair Feet Elevated Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Position yourself under the Smith machine bar with your feet shoulder-width apart and your heels elevated on a small platform or weight plates.
2. Unrack the bar and position it across your upper back, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
3. Lower into a squat by bending your knees, keeping your back straight and knees aligned with your toes.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
487f719b-cdb8-4807-8ce0-1eec891d334c.tips:
1. Keep your knees tracking over your toes to avoid knee strain.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure the bar is securely locked in the Smith machine to prevent slipping.
487f719b-cdb8-4807-8ce0-1eec891d334c.name: Smith Machine Narrow Stance Heels Elevated Squats

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, bending forward at the hips and placing your hands on a stable surface for support.
2. Position your toes on the edge of a step or platform, allowing your heels to hang off.
3. Raise your heels as high as possible by contracting your calf muscles.
4. Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
496b5716-cb9d-4713-b6c4-88795b55505a.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and support your lower back.
2. Exhale as you raise your heels and inhale as you lower them.
3. Avoid bouncing at the bottom of the movement to prevent strain on your Achilles tendon.
496b5716-cb9d-4713-b6c4-88795b55505a.name: Donkey Calf Raise

instructions: 1. Attach a sled to a harness and secure it around your waist.
2. Stand sideways to the sled with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
3. Begin to walk laterally, pulling the sled with you while maintaining an upright posture.
4. Continue for the desired distance or time, then switch directions.
4afa71d1-20e5-43a1-b8f4-c20f33c6fcbb.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and control.
2. Breathe steadily throughout the movement, exhaling as you exert force.
3. Ensure the sled is on a smooth surface to prevent jerky movements.
4afa71d1-20e5-43a1-b8f4-c20f33c6fcbb.name: Lateral Sled Drag

instructions: 1. Sit on the calf machine with your feet positioned on the footplate and knees bent.
2. Place the padded lever on your thighs, securing it comfortably.
3. Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible, engaging your calf muscles.
4. Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
4b751292-1b85-427f-ac9c-d5c66b231f53.tips:
1. Keep your movements controlled to maximize muscle engagement.
2. Exhale as you lift your heels and inhale as you lower them.
3. Avoid locking your knees to maintain tension on the calves.
4b751292-1b85-427f-ac9c-d5c66b231f53.name: Seated Calf Machine

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to lower into a squat by bending your knees and hips.
3. Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, ensuring your knees stay aligned with your toes.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
4c78803e-9dc2-4b35-bccd-8d6fb17f8758.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes to prevent strain.
4c78803e-9dc2-4b35-bccd-8d6fb17f8758.name: Dumbbell Squats

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand overhead with arms fully extended.
2. Step forward with one leg into a lunge position, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
3. Keep your torso upright and core engaged as you push through the front heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
4cfb7a21-4b9a-4baf-92c8-850205148d96.tips:
1. Keep your arms stable and directly above your shoulders throughout the exercise.
2. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you step into the lunge.
3. Avoid letting your front knee extend past your toes to prevent knee strain.
4cfb7a21-4b9a-4baf-92c8-850205148d96.name: Dumbbell Overhead Lunge

instructions: 1. Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor and a resistance band looped around the balls of your feet.
2. Hold the ends of the band in your hands, keeping tension in the band.
3. Push through the balls of your feet to extend your ankles, raising your heels off the ground.
4. Slowly return to the starting position, maintaining control of the band. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
4d562cb2-c9e7-4281-9d3d-76046d5ce2de.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain an upright posture.
2. Exhale as you press your feet forward and inhale as you return.
3. Ensure the resistance band is securely looped to prevent slipping.
4d562cb2-c9e7-4281-9d3d-76046d5ce2de.name: Resistance Band Calf Press Sitting on Chair

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing a wall, and hold a ball with both hands at chest level.
2. Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
3. As you rise from the squat, throw the ball against the wall at a target height.
4. Catch the ball as it returns and immediately lower back into the squat position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
4dd3bc02-c8d1-4193-bb42-011c2241d809.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control.
2. Exhale as you throw the ball and inhale as you catch it.
3. Ensure the wall is sturdy and the area is clear of obstacles.
4dd3bc02-c8d1-4193-bb42-011c2241d809.name: The Wall Ball

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and step back with your left leg into a lunge position.
2. Lower your hips until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees, keeping your torso upright.
3. Push through your right heel to stand up, driving your left knee forward and up towards your chest.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
4dd640d8-c803-4490-9f42-144b17ecd26e.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Exhale as you drive your knee up and inhale as you step back into the lunge.
3. Avoid letting your front knee extend past your toes to prevent strain.
4dd640d8-c803-4490-9f42-144b17ecd26e.name: Lunge to Knee Drive Left Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a bench or elevated surface, facing away from it, and place your right foot on the bench behind you.
2. Lower your hips by bending your left knee, ensuring your torso remains upright and your left knee stays aligned over your ankle.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
4ddcb5ae-e574-4de5-80e2-6c8712129f9a.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and shoulders back throughout the movement.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to prevent strain.
4ddcb5ae-e574-4de5-80e2-6c8712129f9a.name: Bulgarian Split Squat Right Bodyweight Side View

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your heels on top of an exercise ball and arms by your sides.
2. Lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line from your shoulders to your heels, engaging your core and glutes.
3. Bend your knees to roll the ball towards your glutes, keeping your hips elevated.
4. Extend your legs to roll the ball back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
4e22d6fd-d82b-4144-82d5-fafd395eae4e.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging.
2. Exhale as you roll the ball in and inhale as you extend your legs.
3. Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize hamstring engagement.
4e22d6fd-d82b-4144-82d5-fafd395eae4e.name: Exercise Ball Leg Curl

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Explosively push through your heels to jump off the ground, extending your legs fully.
4. Land softly with your knees slightly bent and immediately lower into the next squat. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
4e3496b4-c67a-4bcf-8bd7-6e31eae0b94a.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control during the jump.
2. Exhale as you jump and inhale as you land and lower into the squat.
3. Ensure the barbell is securely positioned on your back to prevent slipping.
4e3496b4-c67a-4bcf-8bd7-6e31eae0b94a.name: Barbell Jump Squat

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a bench, holding a barbell across your upper back with a firm grip, palms facing forward.
2. Extend your left leg back and place the top of your foot on the bench, ensuring your right foot is firmly planted on the ground.
3. Lower your body into a lunge by bending your right knee, keeping your chest up and core engaged, until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
4. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
4e6d18b4-6d6b-46bd-a383-e36673e56b8d.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to prevent strain.
2. Maintain a neutral spine and avoid leaning forward excessively.
3. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
4e6d18b4-6d6b-46bd-a383-e36673e56b8d.name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat Left Side View

instructions: 1. Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
2. Shift your weight onto your left leg and swing your right leg forward and backward in a controlled manner.
3. Keep your core engaged and maintain balance as you swing your leg, ensuring a smooth and steady motion.
4. Repeat the swings for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left leg.
4e960048-caf4-4fed-9332-e46134017902.tips:
1. Keep your movements controlled to avoid overextending your leg.
2. Maintain an upright posture and engage your core for stability.
3. Breathe naturally and avoid holding your breath during the swings.
4e960048-caf4-4fed-9332-e46134017902.name: Back Forward Leg Swings

instructions: 1. Stand facing a wall, extending your right arm out to the side at shoulder height with your palm flat against the wall.
2. Slowly rotate your body away from the wall until you feel a stretch in your biceps and shoulder.
3. Hold the stretch for the desired duration, keeping your arm straight and your shoulder relaxed.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat with the left arm.
4eae1dca-b5f4-4e7e-83c8-47f48ec161e6.tips:
1. Avoid overstretching; stop if you feel any pain.
2. Keep your shoulder down and relaxed to maximize the stretch.
3. Breathe deeply and evenly while holding the stretch.
4eae1dca-b5f4-4e7e-83c8-47f48ec161e6.name: Single Arm Palm Down on Wall Biceps Stretch

instructions: 1. Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your arm extended along the floor, supporting your head with your hand.
2. Keep your other arm extended along your side, palm facing down.
3. Lift your top arm upward, keeping it straight, until it is perpendicular to your body.
4. Lower your arm back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
4f0810f2-e311-4cc4-8a35-386cbe975925.tips:
1. Keep your movements slow and controlled to engage the shoulder muscles effectively.
2. Avoid lifting your arm too high to prevent shoulder strain.
3. Exhale as you lift your arm and inhale as you lower it.
4f0810f2-e311-4cc4-8a35-386cbe975925.name: Laying Lateral Raise

instructions: 1. Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
2. Step back with your right foot into a lunge position, lowering your hips until your left thigh is parallel to the floor.
3. Perform small pulses by slightly raising and lowering your hips while maintaining the lunge position.
4. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
4f59a85e-e4e1-4c56-a249-8218ed8e8862.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
2. Maintain an upright torso and engage your core for stability.
3. Breathe steadily, exhaling as you pulse and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
4f59a85e-e4e1-4c56-a249-8218ed8e8862.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunges Pulses

instructions: 1. Sit on the Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl machine, adjusting the seat and leg pad to fit your body.
2. Position your legs under the pad with your feet flexed and grip the handles for support.
3. Curl one leg towards your buttocks, keeping the other leg extended, and squeeze your hamstrings at the top of the movement.
4. Slowly lower the leg back to the starting position and alternate with the other leg. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
4fa70f3c-c63c-4859-b729-3eff00c64e42.tips:
1. Ensure the machine is adjusted correctly to avoid strain on your knees.
2. Focus on controlled movements to maximize hamstring engagement.
3. Exhale as you curl your leg and inhale as you extend it back.
4fa70f3c-c63c-4859-b729-3eff00c64e42.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl Alternating Legs

instructions: 1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
2. Shift your weight onto your left leg and extend your right leg straight back, keeping your knee straight and your foot flexed.
3. Squeeze your glutes as you lift your leg, ensuring your torso remains upright.
4. Lower your leg back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
4fac34d4-6c2e-4021-abb8-b3fa3e17b9c8.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Avoid arching your back as you lift your leg.
3. Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your leg and inhaling as you lower it.
4fac34d4-6c2e-4021-abb8-b3fa3e17b9c8.name: Multi Hip Glute Extension

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet together and your hands at your sides.
2. Jump your feet out to a squat position, landing softly with your knees bent and your hips back.
3. Quickly jump back to the starting position, bringing your feet together.
4. Repeat the in-and-out jumping squat for the desired number of repetitions.
50a9fd40-71f1-4f00-9a5c-a229fd1cbfff.tips:
1. Land softly to reduce impact on your joints.
2. Keep your chest up and your core engaged throughout the exercise.
3. Breathe steadily, exhaling as you jump out and inhaling as you jump in.
50a9fd40-71f1-4f00-9a5c-a229fd1cbfff.name: In and Out Squats Jump Bodyweight (2)

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms at your sides.
2. Bend one knee and pull it towards your chest, wrapping your hands around your shin to hold the stretch.
3. Keep your other leg extended on the floor and your lower back pressed into the ground.
4. Hold the stretch for the desired duration, then switch legs.
51796655-84f6-478e-8748-df4b8ef4aa4b.tips:
1. Avoid pulling your knee too forcefully to prevent strain.
2. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing steady.
3. Focus on feeling the stretch in your glutes and lower back.
51796655-84f6-478e-8748-df4b8ef4aa4b.name: Lying Knee Pull Glutes Stretch

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands in front of your chest.
2. Hinge at your hips and lower your torso forward, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
3. Lower the plate towards the floor until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
4. Return to the starting position by engaging your hamstrings and glutes to lift your torso back up.
51f4337f-f0d6-4d64-887c-539f294baf7c.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
2. Engage your core to support your lower back throughout the movement.
3. Exhale as you lower the plate and inhale as you return to the starting position.
51f4337f-f0d6-4d64-887c-539f294baf7c.name: Plate Good Morning

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a cable pulley machine with the handle set at a low position, holding the handle with both hands close to your chest.
2. Position your feet shoulder-width apart and lower into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
3. Keep your chest up and your core engaged as you descend, ensuring your knees track over your toes.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, maintaining control of the cable tension.
5265ec2a-dad3-43fe-88bc-2eb4dfbe9efd.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid leaning forward excessively.
2. Engage your core to maintain stability and support your lower back.
3. Exhale as you push up from the squat and inhale as you lower down.
5265ec2a-dad3-43fe-88bc-2eb4dfbe9efd.name: Cable Goblet Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet staggered, one foot slightly in front of the other, holding a kettlebell in front of your thighs with both hands.
2. Hinge at your hips to lower the kettlebell towards the floor, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
3. Lower the kettlebell until you feel a stretch in your lower back and hamstrings.
4. Engage your lower back and glutes to return to the starting position, keeping the kettlebell close to your body.
526904b7-5580-4623-9369-6cc8688d77b4.tips:
1. Maintain a neutral spine and avoid rounding your back.
2. Engage your core for stability and control throughout the movement.
3. Exhale as you lift the kettlebell and inhale as you lower it.
526904b7-5580-4623-9369-6cc8688d77b4.name: Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
2. Bring your knees towards your chest, wrapping your arms around them to hold the stretch.
3. Keep your lower back pressed into the floor and your shoulders relaxed.
4. Hold the stretch for the desired duration, breathing deeply and evenly.
5277e0e5-44b1-417c-8a94-9618d9ae4e92.tips:
1. Avoid pulling your knees too forcefully to prevent strain.
2. Focus on relaxing your lower back and shoulders.
3. Breathe deeply to enhance the stretch and promote relaxation.
5277e0e5-44b1-417c-8a94-9618d9ae4e92.name: Lying Knee Hugs Lower Back Stretch

instructions: 1. Begin in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
2. Perform a pushup by lowering your chest towards the floor, keeping your elbows close to your body.
3. Push back up to the plank position, then perform a renegade row by lifting one hand off the ground and pulling your elbow back towards your hip.
4. Lower your hand back to the ground and repeat the sequence, alternating the rowing arm with each repetition.
52e79c2e-a6bc-4a21-9891-bbbbddbb3d16.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain a stable plank position.
2. Avoid letting your hips sag or rotate during the renegade row.
3. Exhale as you push up and row, and inhale as you lower down.
52e79c2e-a6bc-4a21-9891-bbbbddbb3d16.name: Pushup to Renegade Row

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, placing a resistance band under your front foot and holding the other end with both hands at shoulder height.
2. Step back with your other foot into a lunge position, keeping your torso upright and your core engaged.
3. Lower your hips until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping tension on the band.
4. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position, maintaining control of the band tension. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
53d51255-6da5-4691-b0b0-2e23ecedf6a9.tips:
1. Ensure the resistance band is securely placed under your foot to prevent slipping.
2. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
3. Exhale as you push up from the lunge and inhale as you lower down.
53d51255-6da5-4691-b0b0-2e23ecedf6a9.name: Band Spanish Split Squat_Fe

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip, elbows pointing downwards.
2. Engage your core and slowly lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight, until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
3. Press through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
54609b0a-5beb-4279-a23d-0c386be56d0a.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to avoid unnecessary strain.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise to protect your lower back.
54609b0a-5beb-4279-a23d-0c386be56d0a.name: Barbell Full Squat Side Pov

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
2. Keeping your legs straight but not locked, hinge at the hips to lower the barbell towards the floor, maintaining a flat back.
3. Lower the barbell until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then engage your glutes and lower back to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
551829ec-c263-40fa-b469-4c05bf414ef5.tips:
1. Keep the barbell close to your body throughout the movement.
2. Exhale as you lift the barbell back up and inhale as you lower it down.
3. Avoid rounding your back to prevent injury.
551829ec-c263-40fa-b469-4c05bf414ef5.name: Barbell Stiff Leg Deadlift

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands overhead, arms fully extended.
2. Engage your core and maintain a tall posture as you begin to walk forward.
3. Keep your shoulders stable and avoid leaning to either side as you carry the plate.
4. Continue walking for the desired distance or time, then carefully lower the plate.
55809d31-cde8-4e01-b782-c6d498c581d6.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise to maintain oxygen flow.
3. Avoid arching your back by keeping your ribcage down and aligned with your pelvis.
55809d31-cde8-4e01-b782-c6d498c581d6.name: Plate Overhead Carry

instructions: 1. Sit on the leg press machine with your feet positioned on the platform at shoulder width, toes pointing slightly outward.
2. Extend your legs to push the platform away, keeping a slight bend in your knees.
3. Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible, engaging your calves.
4. Lower your heels back down with control to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
564086ce-1d17-4649-be0d-c57feeae80e8.tips:
1. Keep your knees slightly bent to avoid locking them out.
2. Exhale as you press through your toes and inhale as you lower your heels.
3. Ensure your feet remain flat on the platform except during the calf raise.
564086ce-1d17-4649-be0d-c57feeae80e8.name: Calf Raise Leg Press Machine

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward, and place a resistance band around your thighs just above the knees.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. As you squat, press your knees outward against the resistance band to engage your quadriceps and glutes.
4. Return to the starting position by pressing through your heels and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
56464ff2-ae57-44cc-a948-4d173d8c36a4.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to prevent inward collapse.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you rise back up.
3. Maintain tension in the resistance band throughout the movement for maximum effectiveness.
56464ff2-ae57-44cc-a948-4d173d8c36a4.name: Sumo Squat in Between Legs Resistance Band

instructions: 1. Position yourself under the Smith machine bar, feet shoulder-width apart, and place the bar across your upper back.
2. Unlock the bar and slowly lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight, until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
3. Press through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
566c367e-aced-44f7-ae38-6e4a97cc96f1.tips:
1. Ensure the bar is securely locked before starting your set.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to avoid unnecessary strain.
566c367e-aced-44f7-ae38-6e4a97cc96f1.name: Normal Squat Smith Machine

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hands at your sides.
2. Step your right foot back and across your body, lowering into a curtsy lunge by bending both knees.
3. As you push back to the starting position, clap your hands overhead.
4. Alternate sides and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
56758ba8-9233-43e0-93dc-f7180e5d3edc.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement.
2. Inhale as you lower into the curtsy lunge and exhale as you return to standing.
3. Ensure your front knee remains aligned with your toes to prevent strain.
56758ba8-9233-43e0-93dc-f7180e5d3edc.name: Clap Curtsy Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your front shoulders with an overhand grip, elbows pointing forward.
2. Engage your core and slowly lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight, until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
3. Press through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
571b5d48-586b-4c76-ad50-a9c3a5334ac6.tips:
1. Keep your elbows up to maintain the barbell's position across your shoulders.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise to protect your lower back.
571b5d48-586b-4c76-ad50-a9c3a5334ac6.name: Barbell Clean-Grip Front Squat
