instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Step forward with your right foot, lowering your body until your right thigh is parallel to the floor and your left knee nearly touches the ground.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
4. Alternate legs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
58592be6-6021-4040-8813-f4e3a77515d4.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement.
2. Inhale as you lower into the lunge and exhale as you push back to standing.
3. Ensure your front knee remains aligned with your toes to prevent strain.
58592be6-6021-4040-8813-f4e3a77515d4.name: Barbell Lunges

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a box or bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Place your right foot on the box behind you, keeping your left foot flat on the floor.
3. Lower your body by bending your left knee, keeping your chest up and back straight, until your left thigh is parallel to the floor.
4. Press through your left heel to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
58a461ab-e134-4127-a2bb-3df182ee3e85.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to prevent strain.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Maintain balance by engaging your core throughout the exercise.
58a461ab-e134-4127-a2bb-3df182ee3e85.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Box Split Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet staggered, holding a weight plate in front of your thighs with both hands.
2. Keeping your back straight, hinge at the hips to lower the plate towards the floor, maintaining a slight bend in your knees.
3. Lower the plate until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then engage your glutes and lower back to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch your lead foot and repeat.
58ac387e-19ab-4b1c-9769-cd97b300b41d.tips:
1. Keep the plate close to your body throughout the movement.
2. Exhale as you lift the plate back up and inhale as you lower it down.
3. Avoid rounding your back to prevent injury.
58ac387e-19ab-4b1c-9769-cd97b300b41d.name: Plate Staggered Deadlift

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight, until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
3. Press through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
4. Switch the dumbbell to the other hand and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
58d3d581-584f-4da7-822f-3e87030e5400.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to avoid unnecessary strain.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise to protect your lower back.
58d3d581-584f-4da7-822f-3e87030e5400.name: Dumbbell Offset Squat

instructions: 1. Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat, holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
2. Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended, keeping your wrists straight and palms facing forward.
3. Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control, elbows slightly bent.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
59666a3b-f8ce-4162-b83f-6adfb7089789.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Exhale as you press the dumbbells up and inhale as you lower them down.
3. Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement to maintain tension on the chest muscles.
59666a3b-f8ce-4162-b83f-6adfb7089789.name: Dumbbell Lying on Floor Chest Press

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step back with your right foot, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the floor and your right knee nearly touches the ground.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
4. Alternate legs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
59c65ecd-5fbc-4bd0-9c4e-d520fcb76997.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement.
2. Inhale as you lower into the lunge and exhale as you push back to standing.
3. Ensure your front knee remains aligned with your toes to prevent strain.
59c65ecd-5fbc-4bd0-9c4e-d520fcb76997.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge on the Spot

instructions: 1. Sit on the hip abductor machine with your back against the pad and feet placed on the footrests.
2. Adjust the machine so that your knees are positioned inside the pads, and grasp the handles for support.
3. Press your knees outward against the resistance, engaging your hip muscles.
4. Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
5a65dddb-822d-4713-93f7-3087d14cbc73.tips:
1. Keep your back firmly against the pad to maintain proper posture.
2. Exhale as you press your knees outward and inhale as you return to the starting position.
3. Avoid using momentum; perform the movement with control to maximize muscle engagement.
5a65dddb-822d-4713-93f7-3087d14cbc73.name: Seated Hip Abductor Machine

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step one foot back into a split stance, keeping your torso upright and your front knee aligned over your ankle.
3. Lower your back knee towards the floor by bending both knees, keeping the kettlebells at your sides.
4. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
5ac7ae72-e1c8-4dcc-a57a-cbf1c1a3f3af.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Avoid letting your front knee extend past your toes.
3. Exhale as you push back up to the starting position.
5ac7ae72-e1c8-4dcc-a57a-cbf1c1a3f3af.name: Kettlebell Split Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip just outside your knees.
2. Initiate the movement by extending your hips and knees to lift the barbell off the ground, pulling it close to your body.
3. As the bar reaches your thighs, explosively extend through your hips, knees, and ankles, shrugging your shoulders and pulling the barbell upward.
4. Catch the barbell at shoulder height, then press it overhead by extending your arms fully. Lower the barbell back to the starting position and repeat.
5ae4e0e7-fe30-4f6f-a316-5c99353d4b18.tips:
1. Keep the barbell close to your body throughout the movement.
2. Use your legs to generate power during the lift.
3. Maintain a neutral spine to protect your back.
5ae4e0e7-fe30-4f6f-a316-5c99353d4b18.name: Barbell Clean and Press

instructions: 1. Stand facing a step box with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Place one foot on the step box, ensuring your entire foot is flat on the surface.
3. Push through your front foot to lift your body onto the box, bringing your trailing leg up to meet the leading leg.
4. Step back down with the trailing leg first, followed by the leading leg. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
5b1ecc9a-edb6-44e0-aa19-7dfa739f1104.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and shoulders back throughout the exercise.
2. Engage your core to maintain balance.
3. Avoid pushing off with your trailing leg to ensure the leading leg does the work.
5b1ecc9a-edb6-44e0-aa19-7dfa739f1104.name: Bodyweight Step-Up on Step Box

instructions: 1. Position yourself face down on a hyperextension bench with your ankles secured under the footpads and your upper thighs resting on the support pad.
2. Hold a weight plate against your chest with both hands.
3. Lower your upper body towards the floor by bending at the hips, keeping your back straight.
4. Engage your upper back and glutes to raise your torso back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
5b9d591f-4a3f-4d80-96b8-26b06c9a30e3.tips:
1. Keep your movements slow and controlled to avoid swinging.
2. Maintain a neutral spine to protect your back.
3. Exhale as you lift your torso and inhale as you lower it.
5b9d591f-4a3f-4d80-96b8-26b06c9a30e3.name: Weighted Back Extensions on Hyperextension Bench

instructions: 1. Stand behind a sled, holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
2. Lean forward slightly and place your hands on the sled handles, keeping your arms straight.
3. Drive through your legs to push the sled forward, maintaining a steady pace.
4. Continue pushing the sled for the desired distance or time.
5bae2cd5-c1fe-419a-967b-b83ab9b50526.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
2. Use your legs to generate power, not your back.
3. Maintain a steady breathing pattern throughout the exercise.
5bae2cd5-c1fe-419a-967b-b83ab9b50526.name: Double Kettlebell Sled Push

instructions: 1. Stand at the beginning of an agility ladder with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Jump forward, landing with one foot in each square of the ladder.
3. Continue moving forward, alternating feet with each jump.
4. Complete the ladder and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
5bc6fec0-2ba7-4721-801a-076a4f368022.tips:
1. Keep your knees slightly bent to absorb the impact of each jump.
2. Use your arms to help maintain balance and rhythm.
3. Focus on quick, light footwork to improve agility.
5bc6fec0-2ba7-4721-801a-076a4f368022.name: Agility Ladder Skipping 1 Touch

instructions: 1. Stand on one leg in front of a box or platform, with your other leg slightly bent behind you.
2. Swing your arms and bend your standing leg to generate momentum.
3. Jump onto the box, landing softly on the same leg.
4. Step back down and repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
5c3337a9-665f-4473-ba6c-fbdf9c5f213f.tips:
1. Focus on landing softly to reduce impact on your joints.
2. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
3. Use your arms to help generate momentum for the jump.
5c3337a9-665f-4473-ba6c-fbdf9c5f213f.name: Unilateral Box Jump

instructions: 1. Stand upright with a dumbbell in one hand, feet hip-width apart.
2. Shift your weight to the opposite leg and lift the leg on the same side as the dumbbell out to the side.
3. Keep your torso upright and your core engaged as you lift your leg.
4. Lower your leg back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
5cff43a2-5a73-4b32-afbd-b6c6b1295a05.tips:
1. Keep your movements controlled to avoid swinging your leg.
2. Maintain a slight bend in your standing leg for balance.
3. Exhale as you lift your leg and inhale as you lower it.
5cff43a2-5a73-4b32-afbd-b6c6b1295a05.name: Dumbbell Standing Hip Abduction

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell on your hips.
2. Stagger your feet by moving one foot slightly forward.
3. Engage your glutes and core to lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch the staggered foot position.
5ed6c932-e55a-41c9-86b7-e9b55edaf7b0.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
2. Ensure your hips remain level throughout the movement.
3. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
5ed6c932-e55a-41c9-86b7-e9b55edaf7b0.name: Dumbbell Staggered Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your heels in the handles of a suspension trainer, legs extended.
2. Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line from your shoulders to your heels.
3. Bend your knees to pull your heels towards your glutes, keeping your hips elevated.
4. Extend your legs back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
5f2a57e6-c99e-4f1d-bd3a-fa2766190d17.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
2. Avoid letting your hips sag during the movement.
3. Exhale as you curl your legs and inhale as you extend them.
5f2a57e6-c99e-4f1d-bd3a-fa2766190d17.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Straight Hip Leg Curl

instructions: 1. Stand with your back to a bench, placing one foot on the bench behind you.
2. Hold a resistance band in both hands, securing it under your front foot.
3. Lower your back knee towards the floor by bending both knees, keeping your torso upright.
4. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
5f69e823-89f0-4cb1-891d-d704e4c72449.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Avoid letting your front knee extend past your toes.
3. Exhale as you push back up to the starting position.
5f69e823-89f0-4cb1-891d-d704e4c72449.name: Bulgarian Split Squat Cable Resistance Band

instructions: 1. Sit on the leg press machine with your feet placed close together on the platform.
2. Release the safety handles and extend your legs to push the platform away, keeping your knees slightly bent.
3. Lower the platform by bending your knees towards your chest, keeping your feet flat on the platform.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
6070e81d-f4e4-4759-b35c-a876bbe69bbd.tips:
1. Keep your back pressed against the seat to maintain proper alignment.
2. Avoid locking your knees at the top of the movement.
3. Exhale as you press the platform away and inhale as you lower it.
6070e81d-f4e4-4759-b35c-a876bbe69bbd.name: Leg Press Machine Close Stance

instructions: 1. Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your ankles, feet hip-width apart.
2. Shift your weight to one leg and lift the opposite leg out to the side, keeping your torso upright.
3. Hold the position briefly, then return your leg to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
60b8a51b-8f30-48c2-980a-8d564a4bdace.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Avoid leaning to the side as you lift your leg.
3. Exhale as you lift your leg and inhale as you lower it.
60b8a51b-8f30-48c2-980a-8d564a4bdace.name: Resistance Band Standing Balance Hip Abduction

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with one end secured in a landmine attachment.
2. Position the barbell in front of your shoulder with your elbow bent.
3. Press the barbell overhead by extending your arm fully, keeping your core engaged.
4. Lower the barbell back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
6123a0c9-2aa5-42e1-af92-fa2ad3b8e02b.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
2. Avoid arching your back as you press the barbell overhead.
3. Exhale as you press the barbell and inhale as you lower it.
6123a0c9-2aa5-42e1-af92-fa2ad3b8e02b.name: Landmine Overhead Press

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a barbell with one end secured in a landmine attachment.
2. Position the barbell in front of one shoulder with your elbow bent.
3. Press the barbell overhead by extending your arm fully, keeping your core engaged.
4. Lower the barbell back to the starting position and repeat with the opposite arm. Alternate arms for the desired number of repetitions.
614a5f60-8678-4f10-9bdb-bca7d33068de.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
2. Avoid arching your back as you press the barbell overhead.
3. Exhale as you press the barbell and inhale as you lower it.
614a5f60-8678-4f10-9bdb-bca7d33068de.name: Landmine Seated Alternating Overhead Press

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, bending slightly at the knees and hinging at the hips to lean forward, keeping your back straight.
2. Extend your arms downward, simulating holding a barbell end, and pull your elbows back towards your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
3. Lower your arms back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
61903bd3-1f7c-4521-adc0-f02935f38d68.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise.
3. Avoid rounding your shoulders as you row.
61903bd3-1f7c-4521-adc0-f02935f38d68.name: Land Mine Row

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a kettlebell on your hips with both hands.
2. Engage your core and glutes, then lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
3. Hold the bridge position momentarily, then lower your hips back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
61bc55ed-8cec-43ac-8c1d-6f299f05eb57.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to prevent arching your lower back.
2. Ensure your feet are hip-width apart for stability.
3. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
61bc55ed-8cec-43ac-8c1d-6f299f05eb57.name: Kettlebell Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Hinge at the hips to lower the dumbbells towards the ground, keeping your back straight and the non-supporting leg extended behind you.
3. Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstring, then return to the starting position by driving your hips forward.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
627c9759-24a8-4cbb-8fea-a3e6ebdfbebb.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Avoid rounding your back as you lower the dumbbells.
3. Focus on hinging at the hips rather than bending at the waist.
627c9759-24a8-4cbb-8fea-a3e6ebdfbebb.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift Dumbbell

instructions: 1. Stand facing a sturdy chair with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Step onto the chair with your right foot, pressing through your heel to lift your body up.
3. Bring your left foot up to meet your right foot on the chair.
4. Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
62c542e0-2298-419a-9f59-1a0e1b3134b6.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the exercise.
2. Ensure the chair is stable and secure before stepping on it.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on controlled movements.
62c542e0-2298-419a-9f59-1a0e1b3134b6.name: Step Up on Chair Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Stand upright with a dumbbell in each hand, feet hip-width apart.
2. Raise your heels off the ground, balancing on the balls of your feet, and squeeze your calves at the top of the movement.
3. Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
6307cba2-024c-404e-abdb-4f9170240c66.tips:
1. Keep your knees slightly bent to avoid locking them.
2. Maintain a straight posture throughout the exercise.
3. Exhale as you lift your heels and inhale as you lower them.
6307cba2-024c-404e-abdb-4f9170240c66.name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise

instructions: 1. Stand at the side of an agility ladder with your feet together.
2. Step into the first square with both feet, then step out to the side with both feet, landing outside the ladder.
3. Continue the in-in-out pattern laterally down the ladder.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
630ffd83-22a7-473b-a5e1-a1f9cf6c646b.tips:
1. Keep your knees slightly bent and stay light on your feet.
2. Focus on quick, controlled movements to enhance agility.
3. Maintain a steady rhythm to improve coordination.
630ffd83-22a7-473b-a5e1-a1f9cf6c646b.name: Agility Ladder Lateral Movement in in Out

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your feet elevated on a bench or step, holding a dumbbell on your hips with both hands.
2. Engage your core and glutes, then lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
3. Hold the bridge position momentarily, then lower your hips back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
632e48d7-c343-469f-beb3-fa57202ba3fe.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to prevent arching your lower back.
2. Ensure your feet are securely placed on the elevated surface.
3. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
632e48d7-c343-469f-beb3-fa57202ba3fe.name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
2. Lower into a squat position, keeping the barbell close to your shins.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees to lift the barbell, shrugging your shoulders and pulling the barbell upwards.
4. Drop under the bar into a squat position, catching it on your shoulders, then stand up to complete the lift.
6464e313-2368-492b-9157-0ab65bf7e31a.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your back throughout the lift.
2. Maintain a straight back and avoid rounding your shoulders.
3. Focus on a smooth, explosive movement to generate power.
6464e313-2368-492b-9157-0ab65bf7e31a.name: Barbell Full Clean

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a rebounder with your feet together.
2. Jump onto the rebounder, landing with your feet apart.
3. Jump back to the ground, landing with your feet together.
4. Repeat the in-and-out jumping pattern for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
65713c0f-2a55-4e0d-a43b-a19ce306ba30.tips:
1. Keep your knees slightly bent to absorb the impact of each jump.
2. Maintain a steady rhythm to enhance coordination and balance.
3. Focus on landing softly to reduce stress on your joints.
65713c0f-2a55-4e0d-a43b-a19ce306ba30.name: Rebounder in & Out From Ground

instructions: 1. Stand with a resistance band looped around your ankles, feet hip-width apart.
2. Shift your weight onto your left leg and extend your right leg straight back, keeping it slightly bent.
3. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, then return your right leg to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
660c095b-589d-432b-8307-4b7b28c64a95.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Avoid arching your back as you extend your leg.
3. Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize glute activation.
660c095b-589d-432b-8307-4b7b28c64a95.name: Resistance Band Standing Balance Glute Kickback (Version 2)

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Lower into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees to lift the dumbbells, shrugging your shoulders and pulling the dumbbells upwards.
4. Drop under the dumbbells into a partial squat, catching them at shoulder height, then stand up to complete the lift.
66155158-8a86-4c81-bb45-be4a2793d1f4.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your back throughout the lift.
2. Maintain a straight back and avoid rounding your shoulders.
3. Focus on a smooth, explosive movement to generate power.
66155158-8a86-4c81-bb45-be4a2793d1f4.name: Dumbbell Hang Power Clean

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
2. Bend your knees slightly and dip your body down to generate power.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees, driving the barbell overhead.
4. Catch the barbell with your arms fully extended, then lower it back to the starting position.
66b07b77-f76a-4706-a155-c5a4b656bfe1.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability throughout the lift.
2. Ensure your elbows are locked out when catching the barbell overhead.
3. Focus on a quick, powerful movement to drive the barbell up.
66b07b77-f76a-4706-a155-c5a4b656bfe1.name: Barbell Power Jerk

instructions: 1. Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
2. Swing your legs forward and then backward to generate momentum.
3. Use the momentum to pull your chest towards the bar, keeping your core engaged.
4. Lower yourself back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
66c45c54-0536-4f95-adcd-f88b1a82a35d.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to control the swinging motion.
2. Avoid excessive swinging to prevent strain on your shoulders.
3. Focus on using your upper back muscles to pull yourself up.
66c45c54-0536-4f95-adcd-f88b1a82a35d.name: Kipping Pull Up

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet together, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step to the right into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
3. Push through your right foot to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement to the left side, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
66ce9b1c-c5c4-43de-8298-555d870ae642.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes during the squat.
3. Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement.
66ce9b1c-c5c4-43de-8298-555d870ae642.name: Dumbbell Side Squat Side to Side

instructions: 1. Stand with a resistance band looped around your ankles, feet hip-width apart.
2. Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right leg out to the side, keeping it straight.
3. Squeeze your hip muscles at the top of the movement, then return your right leg to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
671560ba-78e8-40c3-8a68-916b1ffd971e.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Avoid leaning to the side as you lift your leg.
3. Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize hip activation.
671560ba-78e8-40c3-8a68-916b1ffd971e.name: Resistance Band Standing Hip Abduction

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended and palms facing forward.
2. Curl the dumbbells upward, rotating your wrists so your palms face your shoulders at the top of the movement.
3. Pause briefly, then rotate your wrists so your palms face downward as you lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
6722e8ce-faf0-4ebb-aede-001b61bd8221.tips:
1. Keep your elbows close to your sides throughout the exercise to maximize bicep engagement.
2. Exhale as you curl the dumbbells up and inhale as you lower them.
3. Avoid swinging your body or using momentum to lift the weights.
6722e8ce-faf0-4ebb-aede-001b61bd8221.name: Zotman Curl Dumbbell Simultaneous

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides.
2. Lower into a squat position, keeping your chest up and your knees behind your toes.
3. As you rise from the squat, extend one leg to the side in a side kick motion while reaching the opposite hand towards the heel of the standing leg.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side for the desired number of repetitions.
67269287-b6f5-441d-a34c-e29266a6a1bd.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance during the side kick.
2. Inhale as you squat down and exhale as you kick and reach.
3. Avoid letting your knees cave inward during the squat to protect your joints.
67269287-b6f5-441d-a34c-e29266a6a1bd.name: Alternate Heel Touch Side Kick Squat

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell on your hips with both hands.
2. Engage your core and glutes, then lift your hips off the floor to form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
3. Hold the bridge position briefly, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
675fe377-84ab-4eae-9516-11eadc37e7be.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent arching your lower back.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure the dumbbell is securely positioned on your hips to avoid shifting during the exercise.
675fe377-84ab-4eae-9516-11eadc37e7be.name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Step forward with one leg into a lunge, lowering your back knee towards the floor while keeping your front knee aligned with your ankle.
3. Pause briefly at the bottom of the lunge, maintaining tension in your quadriceps.
4. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite leg for the desired number of repetitions.
6762593a-5546-4cc9-96b6-5d9be0aa9c26.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged to maintain balance and proper form.
2. Inhale as you lower into the lunge and exhale as you push back up.
3. Avoid letting your front knee extend past your toes to protect your joints.
6762593a-5546-4cc9-96b6-5d9be0aa9c26.name: Barbell Front Lunges With Small Pause

instructions: 1. Kneel on the floor with one knee up and the other knee down, holding the end of a barbell attached to a landmine attachment with both hands at shoulder height.
2. Press the barbell overhead with one arm, extending your elbow fully while keeping your core engaged.
3. Lower the barbell back to shoulder height with control, then switch arms and repeat the press on the opposite side.
4. Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
676d44a8-22e1-41af-a0ae-1cb88e410755.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to stabilize your body and prevent leaning.
2. Exhale as you press the barbell overhead and inhale as you lower it.
3. Ensure the barbell path is straight and controlled to avoid shoulder strain.
676d44a8-22e1-41af-a0ae-1cb88e410755.name: Landmine Kneeling Alternating Overhead Press

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, placing a resistance band under both feet and holding the ends in each hand.
2. Engage your core and raise your heels off the ground, coming onto your toes while keeping the band taut.
3. Pause briefly at the top of the movement, squeezing your calf muscles.
4. Lower your heels back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
68003e57-2379-4331-a47a-193ba902723b.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance throughout the exercise.
2. Exhale as you lift your heels and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure the resistance band is securely placed under your feet to prevent slipping.
68003e57-2379-4331-a47a-193ba902723b.name: Band Two Legs Calf Raise - (Band Under Both Legs) Version 2

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended overhead with palms facing each other.
2. Lower into a full squat, keeping your chest up and your arms extended overhead.
3. Push through your heels to return to the standing position, maintaining the overhead arm position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
694a2e0c-4a7f-4b7c-af46-3e4ca6d0288a.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back and maintain posture.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you rise.
3. Avoid letting your knees collapse inward during the squat to protect your joints.
694a2e0c-4a7f-4b7c-af46-3e4ca6d0288a.name: Bodyweight Full Squat With Overhead Press

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, feet flat on the ground, and a dumbbell resting on your hips.
2. Engage your core and glutes, then lift your hips off the floor to form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
3. Hold the hip thrust position briefly, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
6a294207-de9d-4c52-be81-e7cd89147077.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent arching your lower back.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure the dumbbell is securely positioned on your hips to avoid shifting during the exercise.
6a294207-de9d-4c52-be81-e7cd89147077.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust (Version 2)

instructions: 1. Begin in a standing position with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
2. Bend your knees slightly and lift one leg, bringing your knee towards your chest.
3. Extend the lifted leg out to the side in a kicking motion while maintaining balance on the standing leg.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side for the desired number of repetitions.
6b5673b2-994c-4725-bfcd-33f5c6f58a58.tips:
1. Engage your core to maintain balance during the kick.
2. Inhale as you prepare to kick and exhale as you extend your leg.
3. Avoid locking your standing knee to maintain stability and prevent injury.
6b5673b2-994c-4725-bfcd-33f5c6f58a58.name: Bent Knee Back to Side Kick

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a sturdy bench or step, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step up onto the bench with one foot, driving through your heel and bringing the opposite knee up towards your chest.
3. Step back down with control, returning to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement on the opposite leg for the desired number of repetitions.
6b7a545e-209c-42c8-82dd-359fc1c715a1.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Exhale as you step up and inhale as you step down.
3. Ensure the bench or step is stable to prevent slipping or tipping.
6b7a545e-209c-42c8-82dd-359fc1c715a1.name: Dumbbell Step-Up With Knee Raise

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides.
2. Lower into a squat, keeping your chest up and your knees behind your toes.
3. As you rise from the squat, extend one leg forward, keeping it straight and parallel to the ground.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite leg for the desired number of repetitions.
6bbf4c7f-8f99-4a5e-ad63-2b1ae8be4f08.tips:
1. Engage your core to maintain balance during the leg extension.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you extend your leg.
3. Avoid letting your knees collapse inward during the squat to protect your joints.
6bbf4c7f-8f99-4a5e-ad63-2b1ae8be4f08.name: Bodyweight Squat to Front Leg

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Lower into a squat, allowing your knees to travel forward while keeping your torso upright.
3. Pause briefly at the bottom of the squat, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
6c6f1c81-a717-44e0-8db7-62656736e6b1.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back and maintain posture.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you rise.
3. Avoid letting your knees collapse inward during the squat to protect your joints.
6c6f1c81-a717-44e0-8db7-62656736e6b1.name: Dumbbell Supported Sissy Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Lower into a full squat, keeping your chest up and your knees aligned with your toes.
3. Push through your heels to return to the standing position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
4. Repeat the squat for the desired number of repetitions.
6c6f51ac-6ca2-46fe-823d-3015fbe1b13f.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back and maintain posture.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you rise.
3. Avoid letting your knees collapse inward during the squat to protect your joints.
6c6f51ac-6ca2-46fe-823d-3015fbe1b13f.name: Barbell Full Squat(back)

instructions: 1. Position yourself under a barbell on a squat rack, placing it across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and lower into a full squat, keeping your chest up and your knees aligned with your toes.
3. Push through your heels to return to the standing position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
4. Repeat the squat for the desired number of repetitions.
6e9c23a6-45f0-4bb8-8661-ba20770633df.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back and maintain posture.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you rise.
3. Ensure the squat rack is set at the correct height to safely unrack and rerack the barbell.
6e9c23a6-45f0-4bb8-8661-ba20770633df.name: Barbell Full Squat(with Rack)

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands at chest level.
2. Press the plate overhead, fully extending your arms while keeping your core engaged.
3. Lower the plate behind your head, bending your elbows to perform a tricep extension.
4. Return the plate to the starting position at chest level and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
6ee61af8-f07a-4533-8241-42ad458f4c5d.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to prevent arching your lower back during the overhead press.
2. Exhale as you press the plate overhead and inhale as you lower it.
3. Ensure your elbows stay close to your head during the tricep extension to maximize muscle engagement.
6ee61af8-f07a-4533-8241-42ad458f4c5d.name: Plate Overhead Press to Tricep Extension

instructions: 1. Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with a close grip, palms facing up.
2. Keep your elbows close to your torso and curl the barbell upward towards your shoulders by flexing your elbows.
3. Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
6f6b0123-b76e-41ae-8bfd-0c847de47781.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid swinging your body to lift the barbell.
2. Exhale as you lift the barbell and inhale as you lower it.
3. Ensure your elbows remain stationary and close to your sides throughout the exercise.
6f6b0123-b76e-41ae-8bfd-0c847de47781.name: Barbell Biceps Curl Close Grip

instructions: 1. Attach a resistance band to a low anchor point and kneel on the floor with the band secured around one ankle.
2. Extend your leg out to the side, keeping your knee slightly bent and your core engaged.
3. Move your leg in a half-circle motion, bringing it from one side of your body to the other.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
6f75d722-d8b1-4487-88ad-0f7a5947220f.tips:
1. Maintain a stable core to prevent excessive movement in your upper body.
2. Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement.
3. Keep your knee slightly bent throughout the exercise to protect your joints.
6f75d722-d8b1-4487-88ad-0f7a5947220f.name: Resistance Band Kneeling Leg Half Circle

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a weight plate in each hand using a pinch grip.
2. Bend at your hips and knees to lower the plates towards the floor, keeping your back straight and chest up.
3. Engage your lower back and glutes to lift the plates back to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
70628c6d-c6aa-47c8-a8b4-34506ba006e6.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to support your lower back.
2. Avoid rounding your back as you lower and lift the plates.
3. Use a firm grip on the plates to prevent them from slipping.
70628c6d-c6aa-47c8-a8b4-34506ba006e6.name: Plate Pinch Grip Deadlift

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your chest with an overhand grip.
2. Keep your chest up and core engaged as you lower into a squat by bending your knees and hips.
3. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor, ensuring your knees track over your toes.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
70bd74f8-25ec-40ec-b874-7909cdf11a97.tips:
1. Maintain an upright torso throughout the squat to avoid leaning forward.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Keep your weight evenly distributed through your feet to maintain balance.
70bd74f8-25ec-40ec-b874-7909cdf11a97.name: Barbell Front Chest Bench Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell overhead with a shoulder-width grip.
2. Step forward with one leg into a lunge position, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees.
3. Keep your torso upright and the barbell stable overhead as you push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
4. Alternate legs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
7172e105-9e1d-4c35-95cd-c9087865b6e7.tips:
1. Engage your core to maintain balance and stability with the barbell overhead.
2. Inhale as you step forward into the lunge and exhale as you return to the starting position.
3. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
7172e105-9e1d-4c35-95cd-c9087865b6e7.name: Barbell Overhead Lunge

instructions: 1. Lie on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor and arms extended in front of your chest, palms together.
2. Press your palms together as if holding an imaginary weight, engaging your chest muscles.
3. Slowly extend your arms outward to the sides, keeping them parallel to the floor.
4. Bring your arms back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
71bae516-1e89-4743-baad-6aff8f9fc9de.tips:
1. Focus on squeezing your chest muscles throughout the movement.
2. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability on the bench.
3. Avoid arching your back during the exercise.
71bae516-1e89-4743-baad-6aff8f9fc9de.name: Svend Press Flat Bench

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a chair with your back to it, placing your left foot on the seat behind you.
2. Lower your body into a lunge position by bending your right knee, keeping your chest upright and core engaged.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the right leg.
71fff393-5e55-4780-9c55-e2921d87adc8.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to avoid strain on your knee joint.
2. Maintain an upright posture throughout the exercise to engage your core effectively.
3. Control the movement to prevent the knee from collapsing inward.
71fff393-5e55-4780-9c55-e2921d87adc8.name: Chair Bulgarian Split Squats Bodyweight Left

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended overhead.
2. Bend to one side, reaching your arm over your head and stretching your lats.
3. Hold the stretch for a moment, feeling the extension along your side.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
71fffc85-0006-42cb-9cae-8ad35510bcb6.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your spine during the stretch.
2. Avoid twisting your torso; focus on lateral bending only.
3. Breathe deeply to enhance the stretch and relax your muscles.
71fffc85-0006-42cb-9cae-8ad35510bcb6.name: Side Bend Standing Lats Stretch

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, securing a resistance band under your front foot and holding the handles at your sides.
2. Step back with one leg into a curtsy lunge, crossing it behind your front leg and bending both knees.
3. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
4. Alternate legs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
729b529b-947d-4040-bdbb-0d8f96b62f57.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Ensure your front knee tracks over your toes to prevent injury.
3. Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement.
729b529b-947d-4040-bdbb-0d8f96b62f57.name: Curtsy Lunges Resistance Band

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your forearm resting on your thigh, holding a kettlebell in your hand with your palm facing up.
2. Allow your wrist to extend downward, lowering the kettlebell towards the floor.
3. Curl your wrist upward, lifting the kettlebell as high as possible while keeping your forearm stationary.
4. Slowly lower the kettlebell back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching arms.
7364dacd-f876-4cea-9529-80e7999c638b.tips:
1. Keep your forearm flat on your thigh to isolate the wrist movement.
2. Use a controlled motion to avoid swinging the kettlebell.
3. Exhale as you curl the kettlebell up and inhale as you lower it.
7364dacd-f876-4cea-9529-80e7999c638b.name: Kettlebell Wrist Curl

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands behind your head, elbows out to the sides.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
742cc1ad-acb6-48b8-a230-9e07c5ac4057.tips:
1. Keep your elbows wide and chest lifted to maintain an open posture.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you rise back up.
3. Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
742cc1ad-acb6-48b8-a230-9e07c5ac4057.name: Ball Headlock Squat

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with a foam roller positioned under your upper back, feet flat on the floor, and hands supporting your head.
2. Lift your hips off the ground and slowly roll the foam roller down your back towards your lower back.
3. Pause briefly at any tight spots, then continue rolling back up to your upper back.
4. Repeat the rolling motion for the desired duration, maintaining a steady pace.
75478a45-4d35-4891-9b64-69dd96b4e1c2.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your spine during the rolling motion.
2. Avoid rolling directly on your lower back to prevent strain.
3. Breathe deeply and relax your muscles to enhance the massage effect.
75478a45-4d35-4891-9b64-69dd96b4e1c2.name: Foam Roller Back

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, positioning a barbell on blocks at mid-shin height.
2. Grip the barbell with a wide overhand grip, keeping your back straight and chest up.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees to lift the barbell overhead in one fluid motion.
4. Lower the barbell back to the blocks with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
76aad9f4-d93d-4d4f-b8f3-ca79d9afa9e2.tips:
1. Engage your core and keep your back straight throughout the lift.
2. Use your legs to generate power and avoid relying solely on your arms.
3. Ensure a smooth, controlled descent to prevent injury.
76aad9f4-d93d-4d4f-b8f3-ca79d9afa9e2.name: Barbell Snatch From Blocks

instructions: 1. Assume a push-up position with your feet shoulder-width apart and one hand placed on the floor under your chest.
2. Lower your body towards the floor by bending your elbow, keeping your body in a straight line.
3. Push through your hand to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching arms.
776aa678-9dab-46b5-8d76-7dfe287bda3a.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain a straight body line.
2. Avoid letting your hips sag or rise during the push-up.
3. Breathe out as you push up and inhale as you lower down.
776aa678-9dab-46b5-8d76-7dfe287bda3a.name: One Arm Push Up

instructions: 1. Lie face down on the floor with a resistance band secured around your wrists, arms extended overhead.
2. Engage your upper back and lift your chest off the floor, pulling your elbows down towards your sides.
3. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom of the movement.
4. Extend your arms back overhead and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
77a8a566-0c6d-4f23-9960-bbfc00c5bba9.tips:
1. Keep your neck in a neutral position to avoid strain.
2. Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together to maximize upper back engagement.
3. Perform the movement slowly and with control to enhance muscle activation.
77a8a566-0c6d-4f23-9960-bbfc00c5bba9.name: Superman Pulls Resistance Bands

instructions: 1. Position yourself on the hack squat machine with your shoulders under the pads and feet placed on the platform, toes pointing forward.
2. Extend your legs to lift the weight, then position your feet so that only the balls of your feet are on the platform, with your heels hanging off.
3. Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible, squeezing your calves at the top of the movement.
4. Slowly lower your heels back down below the platform level to stretch your calves before repeating.
7867d204-b62e-4343-b3ff-73d892bb8600.tips:
1. Keep your knees slightly bent throughout the exercise to avoid locking them.
2. Exhale as you raise your heels and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure your movements are controlled to maximize calf engagement and prevent injury.
7867d204-b62e-4343-b3ff-73d892bb8600.name: Calf Raise on Hack Squat Machine

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, with the barbell on the floor in front of you, over your mid-foot.
2. Bend at your hips and knees to grip the barbell with both hands, keeping your back straight and chest up.
3. Lift the barbell by extending your hips and knees, keeping the bar close to your body, until you are standing upright.
4. Lower the barbell back to the floor by bending at the hips and knees, maintaining a straight back.
78d2fe42-39d3-4d49-bc9b-963092dd4f59.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the lift to protect your lower back.
2. Exhale as you lift the barbell and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid rounding your back to prevent strain and injury.
78d2fe42-39d3-4d49-bc9b-963092dd4f59.name: Barbell Deadlift (Side Pov)

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet hip-width apart, arms extended in front of you for balance.
2. Lift one leg off the ground and lower your body into a squat on the standing leg, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Lower yourself until your glutes lightly touch the box, then push through your heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
7967f49e-7420-4400-829d-98f8b0d4c557.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Avoid letting your knee cave inward during the squat to protect your joints.
7967f49e-7420-4400-829d-98f8b0d4c557.name: Pistol Squat to Box

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, barbell on the floor in front of you.
2. Bend at your hips and knees to grip the barbell, keeping your back straight and chest up.
3. Lift the barbell to your shoulders by extending your hips and knees, then quickly drop under the bar to catch it in a squat position.
4. Stand up from the squat, then push the barbell overhead by extending your arms and legs simultaneously.
5. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control.
79993328-6ddb-491b-928b-4dfd3fa18daa.tips:
1. Keep your core tight throughout the movement to maintain stability.
2. Exhale as you lift the barbell and inhale as you lower it.
3. Ensure a smooth transition between the clean and jerk phases to maintain momentum and control.
79993328-6ddb-491b-928b-4dfd3fa18daa.name: Barbell Clean and Jerk

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, stepping on the middle of the resistance band, holding the ends in each hand.
2. Step one foot back into a reverse lunge, lowering your back knee towards the floor while keeping your front knee over your ankle.
3. Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
79bd3b4e-49a8-4fad-a6fc-1d23fb0db0cd.tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and core engaged throughout the exercise.
2. Inhale as you lower into the lunge and exhale as you push back up.
3. Avoid letting your front knee extend past your toes to prevent strain on the knee joint.
79bd3b4e-49a8-4fad-a6fc-1d23fb0db0cd.name: Lunge Reverse With Resistance Band

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a kettlebell on top of each knee.
2. Position the balls of your feet on the edge of a weight plate or step, with your heels hanging off.
3. Raise your heels as high as possible by pushing through the balls of your feet, squeezing your calves at the top.
4. Slowly lower your heels back down below the level of the plate or step before repeating.
7a992791-f373-4f13-9849-2769cca5b34d.tips:
1. Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize calf engagement.
2. Exhale as you raise your heels and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure the kettlebells are securely placed on your knees to maintain balance.
7a992791-f373-4f13-9849-2769cca5b34d.name: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your feet elevated on a bench or step, knees bent, and hold a dumbbell on your hips.
2. Position one foot slightly forward and the other slightly back, maintaining a staggered stance.
3. Lift your hips towards the ceiling by engaging your glutes, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
7ad5bd47-a5f1-4378-ae89-d4b832700a53.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back throughout the movement.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure your hips remain level and avoid twisting during the exercise.
7ad5bd47-a5f1-4378-ae89-d4b832700a53.name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Explosively jump upwards, extending your legs fully and lifting the dumbbells with you.
4. Land softly back into the squat position and immediately repeat the jump.
7af509e6-1a63-4204-8470-90da7c6c0029.tips:
1. Engage your core to maintain balance and control during the jump.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you jump.
3. Avoid letting your knees cave inward during the squat to protect your joints.
7af509e6-1a63-4204-8470-90da7c6c0029.name: Dumbbell Jumping Squat

instructions: 1. Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the hand on the same side, the other hand can be used for balance.
2. Position the ball of your foot on the edge of a step or platform, with your heel hanging off.
3. Raise your heel as high as possible by pushing through the ball of your foot, squeezing your calf at the top of the movement.
4. Slowly lower your heel back down below the level of the step before repeating.
7afecd57-81c0-4379-818e-5678ce341f8d.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance on one leg.
2. Exhale as you raise your heel and inhale as you lower it.
3. Ensure your movements are controlled to maximize calf engagement and prevent injury.
7afecd57-81c0-4379-818e-5678ce341f8d.name: Dumbbell Standing Single Leg Calf Raise

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Push through your heels to return to the standing position, maintaining control of the kettlebells.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
7b328db4-a68b-4481-b3dd-3cb212bbc3f3.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to support your lower back.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you stand up.
3. Avoid letting your knees extend past your toes to prevent strain on the knee joints.
7b328db4-a68b-4481-b3dd-3cb212bbc3f3.name: Kettlebell Suitcase Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball with both hands.
2. Rotate your torso to one side and slam the ball against the wall with force.
3. Catch the ball as it rebounds off the wall and immediately rotate to the opposite side.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions on each side.
7bf27770-1b18-458b-9c49-8542f966c165.tips:
1. Engage your core to generate power and maintain stability.
2. Exhale as you slam the ball and inhale as you catch it.
3. Ensure you have a firm grip on the ball to prevent it from slipping during the exercise.
7bf27770-1b18-458b-9c49-8542f966c165.name: Med Ball Side Wall Slams

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands at chest level.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. As you reach the bottom of the squat, extend your arms upward, reaching the plate towards the ceiling.
4. Return to the starting position by lowering the plate back to chest level and standing up.
7c17b2b2-a582-43da-a64c-0dfa35395544.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back throughout the exercise.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you stand up and reach.
3. Avoid letting your knees extend past your toes to prevent strain on the knee joints.
7c17b2b2-a582-43da-a64c-0dfa35395544.name: Plate Squat Reach

instructions: 1. Stand on a rebounder with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides.
2. Slightly bend your knees and begin to jump lightly, keeping your movements controlled.
3. Use your arms to help maintain balance and rhythm as you continue to jump.
4. Repeat the light jumps for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
7c6b7977-1e50-42e0-aca7-f3255b87300b.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and control.
2. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise to maintain a consistent rhythm.
3. Avoid jumping too high to reduce impact on your joints and maintain control.
7c6b7977-1e50-42e0-aca7-f3255b87300b.name: Rebounder Light Jumps

instructions: 1. Sit on the incline leg press machine and position one foot on the platform, aligning your knee with your toes.
2. Release the safety handles and extend your leg to push the platform away, keeping your other foot off the platform.
3. Lower the platform by bending your knee until it is just above a 90-degree angle, keeping your foot flat on the platform.
4. Push through your heel to extend your leg back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
7c91e5fd-af2d-4a8a-abca-5077716cb60d.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back during the exercise.
2. Exhale as you press the platform away and inhale as you lower it back.
3. Avoid locking your knee at the top of the movement to prevent joint strain.
7c91e5fd-af2d-4a8a-abca-5077716cb60d.name: Single Leg Incline 45 Degree Leg Press Machine

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, stepping on the middle of the resistance band, holding the ends in each hand.
2. Start with your arms fully extended by your sides, palms facing forward.
3. Curl one hand towards your shoulder, keeping your elbow close to your body, while the other arm remains extended.
4. Lower the hand back to the starting position and repeat with the opposite arm, alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
7e3a1909-6a01-4fa4-a421-f7cd55498279.tips:
1. Keep your elbows close to your body to maximize bicep engagement.
2. Exhale as you curl the band upwards and inhale as you lower it back down.
3. Avoid swinging your arms to maintain control and focus on the biceps.
7e3a1909-6a01-4fa4-a421-f7cd55498279.name: Alternate Biceps Curl Resistance Band

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your right leg extended straight in front of you and your left leg bent, with the sole of your left foot against the inner thigh of your right leg.
2. Reach forward with both hands towards your right foot, keeping your back straight and bending at the hips.
3. Hold the stretch at the point of mild discomfort, ensuring you feel the stretch along the back of your right leg.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the left leg.
7e4671ee-58d5-4a39-a4af-e0d6185a272a.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your spine as you reach forward.
2. Breathe deeply and relax into the stretch to enhance flexibility.
3. Avoid bouncing or jerking movements to prevent strain on the hamstrings.
7e4671ee-58d5-4a39-a4af-e0d6185a272a.name: Seated Single Leg Toe Touch Hamstring Stretch

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the floor, ensuring your knees do not extend past your toes.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
7e957fde-9a27-46e5-bf18-421a6ae04ca1.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back and maintain balance.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Avoid letting your knees collapse inward during the squat to protect your joints.
7e957fde-9a27-46e5-bf18-421a6ae04ca1.name: Dumbbell Narrow Stance Squats

instructions: 1. Stand on your left leg, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your left knee and hip, keeping your right leg extended in front of you.
3. Descend until your left thigh is parallel to the floor, ensuring your knee does not extend past your toes.
4. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position, maintaining balance and control.
7f430fa5-afbb-4bd0-aef9-2b0039670a13.tips:
1. Engage your core to help maintain balance throughout the exercise.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you return to standing.
3. Focus on a point in front of you to help with balance and stability.
7f430fa5-afbb-4bd0-aef9-2b0039670a13.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Squat

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a box or step, holding a barbell across your upper back with a firm grip.
2. Step onto the box with your right foot, pressing through your heel to lift your body up.
3. Balance on your right leg at the top of the step, keeping your left leg elevated and your core engaged.
4. Carefully step back down with your left foot, followed by your right, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
7f7f4e6b-ffa0-4d42-a5bd-bd8c6a281fa4.tips:
1. Ensure the box or step is stable and secure before beginning the exercise.
2. Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement.
3. Avoid using momentum to step up; focus on controlled, deliberate movements.
7f7f4e6b-ffa0-4d42-a5bd-bd8c6a281fa4.name: Barbell Step Up Balance on Box

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a bench, facing away, with your left foot resting on the bench behind you.
2. Lower your body into a lunge by bending your right knee, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Descend until your right thigh is parallel to the floor, ensuring your knee does not extend past your toes.
4. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position, maintaining balance and control.
7f9f3ed9-f3b1-49aa-a2ea-b44443f0251c.tips:
1. Engage your core to help maintain balance throughout the exercise.
2. Inhale as you lower into the lunge and exhale as you push back up.
3. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to prevent strain on the joint.
7f9f3ed9-f3b1-49aa-a2ea-b44443f0251c.name: Bulgarian Split Squat Left Bodyweight Side View

instructions: 1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.
2. Step back with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge by bending both knees.
3. Descend until your left thigh is parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up and back straight.
4. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position, then repeat with the opposite leg.
8058e2bc-1d71-4fa0-a72f-37216983c07d.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and support your lower back.
2. Inhale as you step back into the lunge and exhale as you return to standing.
3. Ensure your front knee stays aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
8058e2bc-1d71-4fa0-a72f-37216983c07d.name: Bodyweight Rear Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet staggered, left foot forward, holding the end of a barbell in your right hand, with the barbell secured in a landmine attachment.
2. Press the barbell overhead with your right arm, extending your elbow fully while keeping your core engaged.
3. Lower the barbell back to shoulder height with control, maintaining a stable stance.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the left arm.
809805bb-5c43-4503-9157-cda5bf18416e.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to maintain stability and prevent arching your back.
2. Exhale as you press the barbell overhead and inhale as you lower it back down.
3. Ensure your shoulder remains stable and avoid shrugging during the press.
809805bb-5c43-4503-9157-cda5bf18416e.name: Landmine Single Arm Staggered Overhead Press

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell overhead with a wide grip.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping the barbell stable overhead.
3. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor, ensuring your knees do not extend past your toes.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, maintaining control of the barbell overhead.
80ce38d9-ba3b-4d52-9e9d-597f589beebb.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back and maintain balance.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure the barbell remains directly above your head to prevent forward lean.
80ce38d9-ba3b-4d52-9e9d-597f589beebb.name: Barbell Overhead Squat

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a large tyre with a sledgehammer in both hands, feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Raise the sledgehammer overhead, keeping your core engaged and arms extended.
3. Swing the sledgehammer down towards the tyre, striking it with force.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat the motion for the desired number of repetitions.
811bbfda-95ab-4ac4-9d98-bfc0271b51d7.tips:
1. Maintain a firm grip on the sledgehammer to ensure control during the swing.
2. Engage your core throughout the movement to protect your lower back.
3. Use your whole body to generate power, not just your arms.
811bbfda-95ab-4ac4-9d98-bfc0271b51d7.name: Tyre Hammering

instructions: 1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step back with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge by bending both knees.
3. Descend until your left thigh is parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up and back straight.
4. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position, then repeat with the opposite leg.
81e17b87-d0bc-43fb-af95-8774078d7c55.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and support your lower back.
2. Inhale as you step back into the lunge and exhale as you return to standing.
3. Ensure your front knee stays aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
81e17b87-d0bc-43fb-af95-8774078d7c55.name: Kettlebell Reverse Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor, ensuring your knees do not extend past your toes.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
82139ac4-9eee-4d92-99f1-a1fc8c0e264b.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back and maintain balance.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Avoid letting your knees collapse inward during the squat to protect your joints.
82139ac4-9eee-4d92-99f1-a1fc8c0e264b.name: Dumbbell Front Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart and a few feet away from the wall.
2. Slide down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor, forming a 90-degree angle at your knees.
3. Hold this position, keeping your back flat against the wall and your core engaged.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
828140a6-15c8-4749-8f94-0927ab898aee.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back and maintain stability.
2. Ensure your knees are directly above your ankles to prevent strain.
3. Avoid arching your back; keep it flat against the wall throughout the exercise.
828140a6-15c8-4749-8f94-0927ab898aee.name: Wall Sit Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Stand on your left leg, holding a weight plate in your right hand using a pinch grip.
2. Hinge at the hips to lower the plate towards the floor, keeping your back straight and your right leg extended behind you for balance.
3. Lower until you feel a stretch in your left hamstring, then return to the starting position by driving through your left heel.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the right leg.
830e9a12-11bb-4cbd-9daa-e42deb9a49f7.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control throughout the movement.
2. Inhale as you lower the plate and exhale as you return to standing.
3. Focus on a point in front of you to help with balance and stability.
830e9a12-11bb-4cbd-9daa-e42deb9a49f7.name: Plate Single Leg Pinch Grip Deadlift

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides.
2. Engage your core and glutes to lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
3. Hold the bridge position for a moment, squeezing your glutes at the top.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
83262a8e-1d24-4cb3-b5c4-250c423375cc.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Ensure your hips remain level throughout the exercise to maximize glute activation.
3. Avoid arching your back; focus on using your glutes and core to lift your hips.
83262a8e-1d24-4cb3-b5c4-250c423375cc.name: Glute Bridge Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Attach a resistance band to a low anchor point and loop the other end around your right ankle.
2. Position yourself on all fours, with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
3. Extend your right leg straight back, keeping your foot flexed and squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
4. Return your right knee to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the left leg.
838c44a5-8503-4f42-a458-43da33335699.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and prevent lower back strain.
2. Exhale as you extend your leg back and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
3. Avoid arching your back; focus on using your glutes to perform the kickback.
838c44a5-8503-4f42-a458-43da33335699.name: Resistance Band One Leg Kickback (Bent Position)

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a bench with your back to it, placing your left foot on the bench behind you.
2. Lower your body into a lunge position by bending your right knee, keeping your chest upright and core engaged.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
83b6af24-019f-4c2f-b2bf-338109b263cb.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to avoid unnecessary strain.
2. Maintain a straight back and avoid leaning forward.
3. Control the movement to prevent your back knee from touching the ground.
83b6af24-019f-4c2f-b2bf-338109b263cb.name: Bench Bulgarian Split Squats Left

instructions: 1. Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
2. Lower your body towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
3. Push back up to the high plank position.
4. Repeat the pushup movement for the desired number of repetitions.
83d01153-2afa-4298-9149-c42c08b137e5.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain a straight line throughout the exercise.
2. Inhale as you lower your body and exhale as you push up.
3. Avoid letting your hips sag or rise too high.
83d01153-2afa-4298-9149-c42c08b137e5.name: Plank Pushup

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip in front of your thighs.
2. Lower into a partial squat while keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees to lift the barbell, pulling it up towards your shoulders.
4. Catch the barbell in a front rack position with your elbows high, then stand up fully.
5. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control.
8402876d-c7be-4564-af30-c4ebf9ebfe6f.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to protect your lower back during the lift.
2. Use your legs and hips to generate power, not just your arms.
3. Ensure the barbell stays close to your body throughout the movement.
8402876d-c7be-4564-af30-c4ebf9ebfe6f.name: Barbell Split Clean

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a bench with your back to it, placing your left foot on the bench behind you.
2. Lower your body into a lunge position by bending your right knee, keeping your chest upright and core engaged.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
8450cc45-d1e9-4b48-b0e0-0530a3de67dc.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to avoid unnecessary strain.
2. Maintain a straight back and avoid leaning forward.
3. Control the movement to prevent your back knee from touching the ground.
8450cc45-d1e9-4b48-b0e0-0530a3de67dc.name: Bulgarian Split Squat Bodyweight Left

instructions: 1. Sit on the Hammer Strength machine and adjust the seat so your knees are aligned with the pivot point.
2. Place one leg under the padded lever and the other leg on the floor for support.
3. Curl the padded lever towards your glutes by flexing your knee.
4. Slowly return to the starting position and repeat with the alternate leg.
84bea430-bb3e-4e82-b6cb-28a976419779.tips:
1. Ensure your knee is aligned with the pivot point for optimal mechanics.
2. Exhale as you curl the lever and inhale as you return to the start.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on controlled movements.
84bea430-bb3e-4e82-b6cb-28a976419779.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl_Alternate Legs

instructions: 1. Stand upright with a barbell resting on your upper back, feet hip-width apart.
2. Step forward with one leg and lower your hips until both knees are bent at a 90-degree angle.
3. Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position.
4. Alternate legs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
85984129-6399-443b-923b-8f1941773e89.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend beyond your toes.
3. Maintain balance by keeping your feet hip-width apart.
85984129-6399-443b-923b-8f1941773e89.name: Barbell Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand upright with a barbell resting on your upper back, feet hip-width apart.
2. Step one leg behind and across your body into a curtsy position, lowering your hips until your front thigh is parallel to the ground.
3. Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position.
4. Alternate legs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
85fb37f3-a745-48f5-b05c-2d9b1b20ea38.tips:
1. Keep your chest lifted and core engaged for stability.
2. Avoid letting your front knee extend beyond your toes.
3. Maintain control to prevent any twisting of the torso.
85fb37f3-a745-48f5-b05c-2d9b1b20ea38.name: Barbell Curtsy Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand upright with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
2. Walk forward, maintaining an upright posture and keeping your core engaged.
3. Continue walking for the desired distance or time.
4. Turn around and walk back, maintaining form.
866234ad-0d1c-41f2-b63a-2ae3099005c9.tips:
1. Keep your shoulders back and down to avoid rounding.
2. Maintain a steady pace and avoid rushing.
3. Engage your core to support your lower back.
866234ad-0d1c-41f2-b63a-2ae3099005c9.name: Dumbbell Farmer Walks

instructions: 1. Stand upright with a barbell resting on your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Step to the side with one leg, bending the knee and lowering your hips while keeping the other leg straight.
3. Push through the heel of your bent leg to return to the starting position.
4. Alternate sides and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
86c3dfa3-2126-4819-935f-a0034e295d96.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the exercise.
2. Ensure your knee stays aligned with your toes during the lunge.
3. Avoid leaning forward; maintain an upright torso.
86c3dfa3-2126-4819-935f-a0034e295d96.name: Barbell Lateral Lunges

instructions: 1. Position yourself on the hack squat machine with your shoulders under the pads and feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
2. Unlock the safety handles and lower your body by bending your knees, keeping your back against the pad.
3. Push through your heels to extend your legs and return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
8707ba6d-896f-4a6e-8a3e-58068a50953d.tips:
1. Keep your feet flat on the platform to ensure even weight distribution.
2. Avoid locking your knees at the top of the movement.
3. Maintain a neutral spine by keeping your back against the pad.
8707ba6d-896f-4a6e-8a3e-58068a50953d.name: Hack Squat Machine

instructions: 1. Stand upright with a dumbbell in each hand, feet hip-width apart.
2. Step one leg behind and across your body into a curtsy position, lowering your hips until your front thigh is parallel to the ground.
3. Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position.
4. Alternate legs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
870ed863-6412-4ff4-9eba-221ba835fc2c.tips:
1. Keep your chest lifted and core engaged for stability.
2. Avoid letting your front knee extend beyond your toes.
3. Maintain control to prevent any twisting of the torso.
870ed863-6412-4ff4-9eba-221ba835fc2c.name: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand facing a bench with a barbell resting on your upper back, feet hip-width apart.
2. Step onto the bench with one foot, pressing through your heel to lift your body up.
3. Step back down with the same foot, returning to the starting position.
4. Alternate legs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
8771129c-1d40-4a82-9d6a-3ace0154d201.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Ensure your entire foot is on the bench to maintain balance.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on controlled steps.
8771129c-1d40-4a82-9d6a-3ace0154d201.name: Barbell Step Up on Bench

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your feet against a sturdy surface and a resistance band looped around your feet.
2. Hold the ends of the band in your hands and bend your knees towards your chest.
3. Press your feet away from your body, extending your legs fully.
4. Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
8774041a-df95-41f9-b02a-42f09354d1c3.tips:
1. Ensure the resistance band is securely anchored to prevent slipping.
2. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
