3. Control the movement to avoid snapping the band back.
8774041a-df95-41f9-b02a-42f09354d1c3.name: Band Leg Press

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench holding a weight plate with both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions.
2. Extend your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
3. Rotate the plate to the left, then to the right, as if steering a wheel.
4. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
87e0c34a-488d-41d0-9f0c-323c65a11b5e.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
2. Avoid using your lower body; focus on shoulder movement.
3. Control the rotation to prevent any jerky motions.
87e0c34a-488d-41d0-9f0c-323c65a11b5e.name: Seated Plate Bus Drivers

instructions: 1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball with both hands.
2. Lower into a squat position, bringing the ball towards the ground.
3. Explosively jump upwards, extending your arms overhead.
4. Land softly and return to the squat position, repeating for the desired number of repetitions.
89af981d-a484-42f8-b67c-0a08708ce986.tips:
1. Engage your core and use your legs to generate power.
2. Ensure a soft landing to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Keep your chest up and avoid rounding your back.
89af981d-a484-42f8-b67c-0a08708ce986.name: Medicine Ball Jumps

instructions: 1. Sit on a chair with your back straight and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
2. Extend your right leg out in front of you until it is parallel to the floor, engaging your quadriceps.
3. Hold briefly at the top, then lower your foot back to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement with your left leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
8aa946ed-f211-484e-80ef-7e531fb77ec9.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid leaning back during the exercise.
2. Engage your core to maintain stability.
3. Breathe out as you extend your leg and inhale as you lower it back down.
8aa946ed-f211-484e-80ef-7e531fb77ec9.name: Seated Leg Extension_Alternate Legs

instructions: 1. Lie on your back near a wall with your left leg extended along the floor and your right leg raised, resting against the wall.
2. Adjust your position so that your right leg is straight and your heel is touching the wall, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
3. Hold this position for the desired duration, keeping your hips and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
4. Switch legs and repeat the stretch on the left side.
8b540007-e670-46a0-a3d4-61143f524a20.tips:
1. Ensure your lower back remains in contact with the floor to avoid strain.
2. Breathe deeply and relax into the stretch for better flexibility.
3. Do not force your leg to straighten completely if it causes discomfort.
8b540007-e670-46a0-a3d4-61143f524a20.name: Lying Single Leg Extended on Wall Hamstrings Stretch

instructions: 1. Attach the suspension trainer to a secure anchor point and lie on your back with your heels in the grips, legs extended.
2. Engage your core and glutes, then bend your knees to pull your heels towards your glutes, lifting your hips off the ground.
3. Hold briefly at the top of the movement, then slowly extend your legs back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining control throughout the exercise.
8ba4a58e-1816-49db-bbae-d41123a719a8.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent your hips from sagging.
2. Breathe out as you curl your legs and inhale as you extend them.
3. Ensure the suspension trainer is securely anchored before starting the exercise.
8ba4a58e-1816-49db-bbae-d41123a719a8.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Leg Curl

instructions: 1. Set a barbell on a rack at knee height and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the barbell.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips to grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
3. Engage your core and lift the barbell by extending your hips and knees, keeping your back straight until you are standing upright.
4. Lower the barbell back to the rack with control, bending at the hips and knees.
8c669aa8-b59c-41fe-b1e6-c7c86226f4d9.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and core engaged throughout the movement to avoid injury.
2. Exhale as you lift the barbell and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid rounding your back or using momentum to lift the barbell.
8c669aa8-b59c-41fe-b1e6-c7c86226f4d9.name: Barbell Rack Pull

instructions: 1. Begin in a pike position with your hands and feet on the floor, hips elevated and forming an inverted V shape.
2. Shift your weight onto your left hand and lift your right hand to tap your left shoulder.
3. Return your right hand to the floor and repeat the movement with your left hand tapping your right shoulder.
4. Continue alternating shoulder taps for the desired number of repetitions.
8e33bba2-61c9-4871-a99c-f9cdcb0c6a62.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you tap your shoulder.
3. Avoid letting your hips sag; maintain the inverted V shape.
8e33bba2-61c9-4871-a99c-f9cdcb0c6a62.name: Pike Shoulder Taps

instructions: 1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand by your sides.
2. Step forward with your right foot, bending both knees to lower your body into a lunge position.
3. Push off your right foot to return to the starting position, then immediately step forward with your left foot into a lunge.
4. Continue alternating lunges on the spot for the desired number of repetitions.
8e401938-ab7c-4ce9-b2d5-b31f0c11b1f9.tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you step forward.
3. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to avoid strain.
8e401938-ab7c-4ce9-b2d5-b31f0c11b1f9.name: Dumbbell Lunge Alternating on the Spot

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and extend your arms forward at shoulder height, palms facing each other.
2. Engage your core and push your hands forward as if pushing against an imaginary resistance.
3. Maintain the push for a brief moment, then return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
8e7692bd-8dac-4594-ada6-db4fe7e341dc.tips:
1. Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid shrugging them during the exercise.
2. Breathe out as you push forward and inhale as you return to the starting position.
3. Focus on engaging your chest muscles throughout the movement.
8e7692bd-8dac-4594-ada6-db4fe7e341dc.name: Push Pull Front Handle Push

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, holding a dumbbell across your hips.
2. Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
3. Drive through your heels to lift your hips towards the ceiling, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
8ea271ef-e774-47c0-ad6b-f6fe1346444a.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them back down.
3. Ensure your knees remain aligned with your toes throughout the exercise.
8ea271ef-e774-47c0-ad6b-f6fe1346444a.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips.
2. Step your right foot behind and across your left leg, bending both knees to lower into a squat position.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement on the opposite side, alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
8f4f3308-f9a2-4af7-9494-009e3de74770.tips:
1. Keep your chest lifted and core engaged throughout the exercise.
2. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you lower into the squat.
3. Ensure your front knee stays aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
8f4f3308-f9a2-4af7-9494-009e3de74770.name: Curtsy Squat

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you and your back upright.
2. Inhale deeply, then exhale as you bend forward at the hips, reaching your hands towards your feet.
3. Hold the stretch at a comfortable position, keeping your back as straight as possible.
4. Breathe deeply and relax into the stretch for the desired duration.
8f7bed38-44ba-402d-8df6-4a9514cad933.tips:
1. Avoid rounding your back; focus on bending at the hips.
2. Breathe deeply to enhance relaxation and flexibility.
3. Do not force the stretch; move within your comfort range.
8f7bed38-44ba-402d-8df6-4a9514cad933.name: Seated Forward Bend

instructions: 1. Stand with your back against a wall, placing an exercise ball between your lower back and the wall.
2. Position your feet shoulder-width apart and a few inches in front of your body.
3. Lower your body into a squat, rolling the ball down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
8fc34e8d-95d8-47a0-8bfa-11f4c22ac0b0.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you lower into the squat.
3. Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes to avoid strain.
8fc34e8d-95d8-47a0-8bfa-11f4c22ac0b0.name: Exercise Ball Wall Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and arms hanging naturally by your sides.
2. Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight, and reach your right hand towards the floor as if starting a lawnmower.
3. Pull your right elbow back, squeezing your shoulder blades together as you rotate your torso slightly to the right.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side, alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
904e80df-f889-4a02-80e8-89e1aa8ff24d.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Exhale as you pull your elbow back and inhale as you return to the starting position.
3. Avoid rounding your back; maintain a straight spine throughout the movement.
904e80df-f889-4a02-80e8-89e1aa8ff24d.name: Lawnmower Row

instructions: 1. Stand facing a cable pulley machine with the ankle strap attached to your right ankle.
2. Step back to create tension in the cable and stand on your left leg, holding onto the machine for support if needed.
3. Extend your right leg forward, engaging your quadriceps, until it is straight and parallel to the floor.
4. Slowly return your right leg to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
90631500-ef93-4f2f-919d-e0691e1af8bd.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Exhale as you extend your leg and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
3. Ensure the cable tension is appropriate to avoid jerky movements.
90631500-ef93-4f2f-919d-e0691e1af8bd.name: Cable Standing Leg Extension

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold an imaginary tennis racket with both hands.
2. Rotate your torso to the right, bringing your hands back as if preparing for a forehand stroke.
3. Shift your weight onto your back foot, then pivot on your back foot as you swing your arms forward, simulating a tennis forehand stroke.
4. Follow through with the swing, rotating your torso and shifting your weight onto your front foot.
90710814-88cf-4496-8763-47a45d82e7e1.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your movements.
2. Breathe out as you swing forward and inhale as you prepare for the stroke.
3. Focus on smooth, controlled movements to mimic the natural flow of a tennis stroke.
90710814-88cf-4496-8763-47a45d82e7e1.name: Tennis Forehand Ground Stroke

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your feet elevated on a chair, knees bent at 90 degrees, and arms by your sides.
2. Engage your core and glutes to lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
3. Hold the bridge position briefly, then lower your hips back to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
908509c0-a4f5-43b7-ac81-a35883e07cc2.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them back down.
3. Ensure your feet remain flat on the chair to maintain balance.
908509c0-a4f5-43b7-ac81-a35883e07cc2.name: Chair Frog Feet Elevated Glute Bridge Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Position the barbell on your upper back, just below the ridge of your shoulder blades, and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Engage your core and begin the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the floor or slightly below, ensuring your knees track over your toes.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
90ba3291-0638-4515-b718-63bc862f2c3a.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight to avoid rounding your spine.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure your knees do not cave inward during the movement.
90ba3291-0638-4515-b718-63bc862f2c3a.name: Barbell Low Bar Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and bring your arms to your chest, elbows bent.
2. Lower into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up.
3. Perform small pulses by slightly raising and lowering your body while maintaining the squat position.
4. Continue pulsing for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
92c9be74-800c-4015-abf2-ca19ff9b864d.tips:
1. Keep your weight distributed evenly across your feet to maintain balance.
2. Engage your core throughout the exercise to support your lower back.
3. Avoid letting your knees extend past your toes to prevent strain.
92c9be74-800c-4015-abf2-ca19ff9b864d.name: Bodyweight Pulse Squat Arms to Chest

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
2. Step your right foot behind and across your left leg, bending both knees to lower into a lunge.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
4. Alternate legs and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
92d198f6-ab1e-4908-a153-c1d2d8454d42.tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Inhale as you lower into the lunge and exhale as you return to standing.
3. Ensure your front knee does not extend beyond your toes to protect your joints.
92d198f6-ab1e-4908-a153-c1d2d8454d42.name: Barbell Curtsy Lunges

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with one foot elevated on a stable surface and the other foot flat on the floor, knees bent.
2. Engage your core and glutes, lifting your hips off the ground to form a straight line from shoulders to knees.
3. Hold the elevated position briefly, then lower your hips back down with control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
92f51cd8-5281-4902-b23d-9d9f84b25a46.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent arching your lower back.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure your elevated foot is stable to maintain balance.
92f51cd8-5281-4902-b23d-9d9f84b25a46.name: Bodyweight Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
2. Step forward with one leg, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
3. Pause briefly in the lunge position, maintaining balance and control.
4. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position, then alternate legs.
92f5c186-ee53-4938-a19b-4d6a8b419166.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged for stability.
2. Inhale as you step forward and lower, exhale as you push back to standing.
3. Avoid letting your front knee extend beyond your toes to protect your joints.
92f5c186-ee53-4938-a19b-4d6a8b419166.name: Barbell Pause Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a bench with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Step onto the bench with your right foot, pressing through your heel to lift your body upward.
3. Bring your left foot up to meet your right foot on the bench, then step back down with your right foot.
4. Alternate legs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
93b30832-5310-48c5-86e5-b6fa3e14800c.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Exhale as you step up and inhale as you step down.
3. Ensure the bench is stable and secure before beginning the exercise.
93b30832-5310-48c5-86e5-b6fa3e14800c.name: Bench Alternating Step Ups

instructions: 1. Stand on a rebounder with your feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides.
2. Begin running in place, lifting your knees high towards your chest.
3. Pump your arms in coordination with your legs to maintain balance.
4. Continue the movement for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
94ed2e22-b03d-478e-88e9-948a3e301b45.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability on the rebounder.
2. Breathe steadily and rhythmically throughout the exercise.
3. Focus on lifting your knees high to maximize the intensity of the workout.
94ed2e22-b03d-478e-88e9-948a3e301b45.name: Rebounder High Knee Runs

instructions: 1. Position a barbell across your upper back and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Initiate the squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, lowering your body as deep as possible while keeping your chest up.
3. Aim to lower until your hips are below your knees, maintaining a straight back.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
94fce016-b62c-47b9-91ad-b29e2ee42644.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight to avoid rounding your spine.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not cave inward.
94fce016-b62c-47b9-91ad-b29e2ee42644.name: Barbell Squat to Grass

instructions: 1. Stand at the side of an agility ladder, facing perpendicular to it.
2. Step laterally into the first square with your lead foot, followed by your trailing foot.
3. Quickly switch your base by stepping your trailing foot into the next square, followed by your lead foot.
4. Continue advancing laterally through the ladder, maintaining a quick and controlled pace.
950faf9d-f550-463c-9a61-4e8c512f9a88.tips:
1. Keep your knees slightly bent and stay light on your feet for agility.
2. Focus on quick foot movements and maintain a steady rhythm.
3. Avoid looking down at your feet; keep your gaze forward to enhance coordination.
950faf9d-f550-463c-9a61-4e8c512f9a88.name: Agility Ladder Advancing Laterally Switching Base

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the end of a barbell in a landmine attachment with both hands at chest level.
2. Step laterally to the right, bending your right knee and keeping your left leg straight as you lower into a lateral lunge.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
4. Alternate sides and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
955571c7-e7b7-4250-a8ef-16df50e06a66.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Inhale as you step into the lunge and exhale as you push back to standing.
3. Ensure your knee does not extend beyond your toes to protect your joints.
955571c7-e7b7-4250-a8ef-16df50e06a66.name: Landmine Goblet Lateral Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step backward with your right foot, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
4. Alternate legs and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
965403f5-a41f-4db9-8a3f-cd26e9635311.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged for stability.
2. Inhale as you step back and lower, exhale as you push back to standing.
3. Avoid letting your front knee extend beyond your toes to protect your joints.
965403f5-a41f-4db9-8a3f-cd26e9635311.name: Dumbbell Rear Lunge

instructions: 1. Begin on all fours with a resistance band looped around your thighs, just above your knees.
2. Keeping your knee bent, lift your right leg towards the ceiling, engaging your glutes.
3. Hold briefly at the top of the movement, then lower your leg back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left leg.
96870067-8b1c-4bd5-b787-947f8123bc45.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and prevent arching your back.
2. Exhale as you lift your leg and inhale as you lower it.
3. Focus on squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement for maximum activation.
96870067-8b1c-4bd5-b787-947f8123bc45.name: Resistance Band Bent Leg Kickback (Kneeling)

instructions: 1. Start in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
2. Reach your right arm forward, keeping your hips stable and core engaged.
3. Return your right hand to the starting position and repeat with your left arm.
4. Alternate arms and continue for the desired number of repetitions.
96ac1f63-13c8-4ea1-9402-16620662a292.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to prevent your hips from swaying.
2. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise to maintain focus and control.
3. Avoid letting your hips drop or rise; maintain a straight line from head to heels.
96ac1f63-13c8-4ea1-9402-16620662a292.name: Plank Individual Arm Reach

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your arms extended out to the sides and knees bent at 90 degrees.
2. Slowly lower your knees to one side, keeping your shoulders flat on the floor.
3. Hold the stretch briefly, then return your knees to the center.
4. Repeat on the opposite side and continue alternating for the desired duration.
96daaa13-62c7-4124-a5f9-b985b65e8a6e.tips:
1. Move slowly and with control to avoid straining your lower back.
2. Breathe deeply and relax into the stretch to enhance flexibility.
3. Keep your shoulders grounded to maximize the stretch in your lower back.
96daaa13-62c7-4124-a5f9-b985b65e8a6e.name: Lying Knees to Floor Lower Back Stretch

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a Smith machine, positioning the barbell at shoulder height.
2. Place one foot behind you on a bench, ensuring your front foot is positioned under the bar.
3. Lower into a split squat by bending your front knee, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
4. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position, repeating for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
973d0ff3-af95-4d13-8391-4b1d0da91afd.tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning forward.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure your front knee does not extend beyond your toes to protect your joints.
973d0ff3-af95-4d13-8391-4b1d0da91afd.name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand at chest level with your elbow bent.
2. Lean forward slightly and place your free hand on the ground in front of you, mimicking a sled push position.
3. Drive forward by pushing off your legs, maintaining a strong core and keeping the kettlebell steady at chest level.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
9746045d-564f-4265-b513-9745eb31e10a.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the movement to maintain balance.
2. Ensure your back remains straight to avoid strain.
3. Avoid letting the kettlebell sway; keep it controlled.
9746045d-564f-4265-b513-9745eb31e10a.name: Single Kettlebell Sled Push

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).
2. Begin with the dumbbells resting on your thighs, arms fully extended.
3. Raise the dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height, keeping your arms straight and parallel to the floor.
4. Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
974807f0-11e4-4984-b356-cedadff0d03f.tips:
1. Keep your shoulders down and back to avoid shrugging.
2. Exhale as you lift the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
3. Maintain a slight bend in your elbows to reduce joint strain.
974807f0-11e4-4984-b356-cedadff0d03f.name: Seated Dumbbell Neutral Grip Front Raises

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell with both hands at chest level.
2. Step out to the side with your right foot, bending your right knee while keeping your left leg straight.
3. Lower your hips into a lateral lunge, keeping the kettlebell close to your chest and your back straight.
4. Push off your right foot to return to the starting position and repeat on the left side.
979de146-de74-46c8-8e5f-df1635f26fb1.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Ensure your knee does not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
3. Move slowly and with control to maintain balance.
979de146-de74-46c8-8e5f-df1635f26fb1.name: Kettlebell Lateral Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand on one leg in front of a box or platform, with your arms at your sides.
2. Bend your knee slightly and jump onto the box, landing softly on both feet.
3. Absorb the impact by bending your knees and hips, keeping your core engaged.
4. Step or jump back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
981bfeef-f85e-41fe-8fe3-beda83b75688.tips:
1. Focus on landing softly to reduce impact on your joints.
2. Keep your gaze forward to maintain balance.
3. Engage your core to stabilize your body during the jump.
981bfeef-f85e-41fe-8fe3-beda83b75688.name: Unilateral Box Jump - Bilateral Deceleration

instructions: 1. Kneel on the floor with your forearms resting on the ground, palms facing down.
2. Lean forward slightly, keeping your elbows and wrists aligned.
3. Gently press your forearms into the floor to feel a stretch in your forearm flexors.
4. Hold the stretch for the desired duration, then release.
98344fda-7a5b-464d-80b1-b1ebbf9a4624.tips:
1. Keep your shoulders relaxed to avoid tension.
2. Breathe deeply and evenly throughout the stretch.
3. Avoid forcing the stretch to prevent injury.
98344fda-7a5b-464d-80b1-b1ebbf9a4624.name: Kneeling Forearm Flexor Stretch

instructions: 1. Place a weight plate on the floor and position your hands on either side of it in a pushup position.
2. Extend your legs behind you, forming a straight line from head to heels.
3. Lower your chest towards the plate, keeping your elbows close to your body.
4. Push back up to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
9880d298-79b2-4e4e-96fe-9975115138b9.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to maintain a straight body line.
2. Inhale as you lower your body and exhale as you push up.
3. Avoid letting your hips sag to prevent lower back strain.
9880d298-79b2-4e4e-96fe-9975115138b9.name: Plate Deficit Pushup

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet together, holding a medicine ball with both hands at chest level.
2. Jump up, spreading your legs wide and raising the medicine ball overhead.
3. Land softly with your feet together, bringing the medicine ball back to chest level.
4. Repeat the jumping jack motion for the desired number of repetitions.
994ee54b-1113-44ad-855b-4713c42fcddf.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Land softly to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Control the movement of the medicine ball to avoid excessive swinging.
994ee54b-1113-44ad-855b-4713c42fcddf.name: Med Ball Jumping Jacks

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip just outside your knees.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips to lower the barbell to mid-shin level.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees, pulling the barbell up and catching it on your shoulders in a squat position.
4. Stand up fully, then lower the barbell back to the starting position and repeat.
99f10e86-b558-4901-aeb6-735d0b8509ce.tips:
1. Keep the barbell close to your body throughout the lift.
2. Engage your core to stabilize your spine.
3. Use your legs and hips to drive the movement, not your arms.
99f10e86-b558-4901-aeb6-735d0b8509ce.name: Barbell Power Clean

instructions: 1. Attach a resistance band to a low anchor point and loop the other end around your ankle.
2. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, facing sideways to the anchor point.
3. Move your leg with the band across your body, keeping your hips stable.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
9bd3e556-e55b-416c-9a0b-208fc2c0095c.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent excessive hip movement.
2. Maintain a slight bend in your standing knee for stability.
3. Control the movement to avoid snapping the band.
9bd3e556-e55b-416c-9a0b-208fc2c0095c.name: Band Hip Adduction

instructions: 1. Stand beside a bench with a barbell across your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Step onto the bench with one foot, driving through your heel to lift your body up.
3. Bring your trailing leg up to meet the leading leg on the bench.
4. Step back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
9ca5737c-7a93-4723-896d-12f90599c309.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Focus on pushing through your heel to engage your quadriceps.
3. Avoid leaning forward to maintain balance and proper form.
9ca5737c-7a93-4723-896d-12f90599c309.name: Barbell Bench Lateral Step-Up

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell on your hips.
2. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to form a figure four position.
3. Lift your hips towards the ceiling, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
9d33dd6e-e0e6-4cd0-ba33-1529d1d836ab.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Ensure your hips remain level throughout the movement.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on controlled, deliberate movements.
9d33dd6e-e0e6-4cd0-ba33-1529d1d836ab.name: Dumbbell Figure Four Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands at chest level.
2. Lower into a squat position, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Pause for 2 seconds at the bottom of the squat, maintaining tension in your quadriceps.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position and repeat.
9d9380df-e0c9-4c56-a2a3-0f4a88f2b4c5.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
2. Maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.
3. Control your breathing; inhale as you lower and exhale as you rise.
9d9380df-e0c9-4c56-a2a3-0f4a88f2b4c5.name: Dumbbell Goblet 2 Sec Hold Squat

instructions: 1. Stand on the platform of an assisted pull-up machine, grasping the handles with a close grip.
2. Step off the platform, allowing the machine to support some of your weight.
3. Pull yourself up until your chin is above the handles, keeping your elbows close to your body.
4. Lower yourself back to the starting position with control and repeat.
9dd6d1e1-e3ec-44e5-a0e2-42173c94fa2e.tips:
1. Engage your core to stabilize your body during the movement.
2. Avoid swinging or using momentum to lift yourself.
3. Exhale as you pull up and inhale as you lower down.
9dd6d1e1-e3ec-44e5-a0e2-42173c94fa2e.name: Assisted Chin Up Close Grip

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper chest with an overhand grip.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Push through your heels to return to a standing position, maintaining the barbell's position.
4. Repeat the squat for the desired number of repetitions.
9e494e91-4442-4d56-b3a7-69e5f809125f.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to prevent injury.
2. Engage your core to support your spine throughout the movement.
3. Breathe in as you lower and exhale as you rise.
9e494e91-4442-4d56-b3a7-69e5f809125f.name: Barbell Front Bench Squat

instructions: 1. Kneel on the floor with your feet flat and knees hip-width apart.
2. Lean back slightly, keeping your body straight from knees to head.
3. Lower your body towards the floor by bending your knees, keeping your core engaged.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
9fb1afc5-3760-4263-887c-593d4cb28122.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to maintain a straight body line.
2. Avoid arching your back to prevent strain.
3. Control the movement to avoid excessive pressure on your knees.
9fb1afc5-3760-4263-887c-593d4cb28122.name: Bodyweight Kneeling Sissy Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the end of a barbell secured in a landmine attachment with both hands at chest level.
2. Rotate your torso to one side, pivoting on your back foot while keeping the barbell close to your body.
3. As you rotate back to the center, press the barbell overhead in a controlled motion.
4. Lower the barbell back to the starting position and repeat the movement, alternating sides.
a06054a0-1902-4d52-ab83-fe79bb0da39a.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability.
2. Exhale as you press the barbell overhead and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid twisting your knees excessively; the rotation should come from your hips and torso.
a06054a0-1902-4d52-ab83-fe79bb0da39a.name: Landmine Rotational Lift to Press

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
2. Step forward with your left foot into a lunge position, bending both knees to lower your body.
3. Rotate your torso to the left, keeping your core engaged.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat on the right side, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
a0a22037-12ef-4883-be78-87053ce23851.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
2. Maintain an upright posture and engage your core during the rotation.
3. Breathe steadily, exhaling during the rotation and inhaling as you return to the start.
a0a22037-12ef-4883-be78-87053ce23851.name: Lunge Rotation Left and Right Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
2. Cross your right ankle over your left knee, forming a figure four shape.
3. Twist your torso towards your right knee, placing your left hand on the floor behind you for support.
4. Hold the stretch, then return to the starting position and switch sides.
a0d0bb29-c8af-4a46-9d65-e518f179fe70.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
2. Breathe deeply and relax into the stretch to enhance flexibility.
3. Avoid forcing the twist; move gently to prevent discomfort.
a0d0bb29-c8af-4a46-9d65-e518f179fe70.name: Seated Figure Four With Twist Glute Stretch

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands using a pinch grip.
2. Stagger your stance by stepping one foot slightly back.
3. Hinge at the hips to lower the plate towards the floor, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
4. Return to the starting position by extending your hips and standing tall, repeating for the desired number of repetitions.
a0fba57c-1ddb-452d-b864-80c0d603cf05.tips:
1. Keep your shoulders back and chest up to maintain a neutral spine.
2. Engage your core to support your lower back during the lift.
3. Avoid rounding your back; focus on hinging at the hips.
a0fba57c-1ddb-452d-b864-80c0d603cf05.name: Plate Staggered Pinch Grip Deadlift

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a bar grip.
2. Lower your hips into a squat position, keeping your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
3. Push through your heels to return to a standing position, squeezing your quadriceps at the top.
4. Repeat the squat for the desired number of repetitions.
a13232eb-641c-4cb0-8dbe-4ea5e0d7ca6c.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you return to standing.
3. Avoid letting your knees cave inward; maintain proper alignment.
a13232eb-641c-4cb0-8dbe-4ea5e0d7ca6c.name: Dumbbell Bar Grip Sumo Squat

instructions: 1. Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee, holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
2. Hinge at the hips to lower the dumbbell towards the floor, extending your free leg behind you for balance.
3. Keep your back straight and core engaged as you lower.
4. Return to the starting position by extending your hips and standing tall, repeating for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
a135929c-815e-4b64-9501-94c7d181d07f.tips:
1. Focus on a slow and controlled movement to maintain balance.
2. Keep your shoulders back and avoid rounding your spine.
3. Engage your core to support your lower back throughout the exercise.
a135929c-815e-4b64-9501-94c7d181d07f.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Deadlift

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of you.
2. Lower your hips into a squat position, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Push through your heels to return to a standing position, squeezing your quadriceps at the top.
4. Repeat the squat for the desired number of repetitions.
a175a046-423e-46e7-b440-ec87dd4e8923.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you stand up.
3. Maintain a neutral spine and avoid leaning forward.
a175a046-423e-46e7-b440-ec87dd4e8923.name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat (Version 2)

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a chair, facing away from it, and place your right foot on the seat behind you.
2. Lower your hips into a split squat position, bending your left knee while keeping your chest up.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
a1b29d42-f282-4750-ad44-044a5bff4ef9.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to prevent strain.
2. Engage your core to maintain balance and stability.
3. Avoid letting your front knee extend past your toes during the squat.
a1b29d42-f282-4750-ad44-044a5bff4ef9.name: Chair Bulgarian Split Squats Bodyweight Right

instructions: 1. Stand beside a low box with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Quickly step one foot onto the box, followed by the other, mimicking a running motion.
3. Step down in the same manner, maintaining a brisk pace.
4. Continue alternating steps for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
a1b57c94-f4df-44c8-b169-86abb6d51ef8.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control.
2. Use your arms to help drive the movement, similar to running.
3. Avoid stomping on the box; aim for light and quick foot contacts.
a1b57c94-f4df-44c8-b169-86abb6d51ef8.name: Low Box Lateral Runner

instructions: 1. Sit on a horizontal leg press machine with one foot on the platform and the other foot resting on the floor.
2. Press the platform away by extending your working leg, keeping your heel on the platform.
3. At full extension, perform a calf raise by pushing through the ball of your foot.
4. Lower your heel back down, then bend your knee to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
a1e3558a-3a39-404a-8b17-f1da675e9763.tips:
1. Keep your movements controlled to avoid locking your knee at full extension.
2. Focus on a full range of motion during the calf raise for maximum benefit.
3. Breathe steadily, exhaling as you press and inhale as you return.
a1e3558a-3a39-404a-8b17-f1da675e9763.name: Horizontal Leg Press Calf Raise Single Leg

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands at chest level.
2. Extend your arms forward to reach the plate out in front of you at shoulder height.
3. Hold the position briefly, engaging your shoulders and core.
4. Return the plate to your chest and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
a21cbad3-adac-45e6-9546-885f77d3827f.tips:
1. Keep your shoulders down and back to avoid tension in your neck.
2. Engage your core to maintain stability throughout the movement.
3. Avoid arching your back; keep a neutral spine.
a21cbad3-adac-45e6-9546-885f77d3827f.name: Plate Reach

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate in one hand.
2. Bend at the hips to lower the plate towards the floor, keeping your back straight.
3. Pull the plate towards your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
4. Lower the plate back to the floor and repeat with the opposite hand, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
a271d932-da09-45a2-bfc3-a5f0dd6827c5.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Avoid rounding your shoulders; maintain a straight back throughout the exercise.
3. Exhale as you pull the plate towards your torso and inhale as you lower it.
a271d932-da09-45a2-bfc3-a5f0dd6827c5.name: Plate Alternating Deadstop Row

instructions: 1. Attach a resistance band to a secure anchor point and kneel on a bench with the band looped around one ankle.
2. Extend your leg out to the side in a half-circle motion, keeping your core engaged.
3. Return your leg to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
a2c17da3-8824-4359-b087-f8dd55aea8c7.tips:
1. Maintain a stable position on the bench by engaging your core.
2. Move your leg slowly to maximize muscle activation and control.
3. Avoid arching your back; keep your spine neutral throughout the exercise.
a2c17da3-8824-4359-b087-f8dd55aea8c7.name: Resistance Band Kneeling Leg Half Circle on Bench

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across the front of your shoulders with your elbows pointing forward.
2. Lower your hips into a squat position, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Push through your heels to return to a standing position, squeezing your quadriceps at the top.
4. Repeat the squat for the desired number of repetitions.
a4714698-af99-4a44-aa55-75b7e2c4c2fb.tips:
1. Keep your elbows up to maintain the barbell's position on your shoulders.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you stand up.
3. Avoid letting your knees cave inward; maintain proper alignment.
a4714698-af99-4a44-aa55-75b7e2c4c2fb.name: Barbell Front Squats

instructions: 1. Sit on a leg extension machine with your back against the pad and feet under the padded lever.
2. Extend both legs to lift the padded lever, keeping your back pressed against the seat.
3. Hold the extended position briefly, engaging your quadriceps.
4. Lower the lever back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
a70f81ef-4a4d-43f0-a4fe-72a09a0a1b42.tips:
1. Avoid locking your knees at the top of the movement to prevent strain.
2. Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle engagement.
3. Exhale as you extend your legs and inhale as you lower them.
a70f81ef-4a4d-43f0-a4fe-72a09a0a1b42.name: Seated Leg Extension_Both Legs

instructions: 1. Stand on the treadmill with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold onto the handrails if needed.
2. Start the treadmill at a slow walking pace, maintaining an upright posture with your shoulders relaxed.
3. Walk naturally, swinging your arms at your sides, and keep your gaze forward.
4. Gradually increase the speed or incline as desired, maintaining a steady pace for the duration of your walk.
a75bff05-8718-453e-98f4-327922fca2f3.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your posture.
2. Avoid holding onto the handrails unless necessary for balance.
3. Breathe naturally and consistently throughout the exercise.
a75bff05-8718-453e-98f4-327922fca2f3.name: Treadmill Walk

instructions: 1. Begin in a deep squat position with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your hands on the floor in front of you.
2. Keeping your hips low, step forward with one hand and the opposite foot, then repeat with the other side, mimicking a gorilla's movement.
3. Continue moving forward in this manner, maintaining a low squat position throughout.
4. Reverse the movement to return to the starting position or continue for the desired distance.
a8488343-681b-4447-8922-01df600bd34a.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight to maintain proper form.
2. Engage your core to stabilize your movement.
3. Move slowly and deliberately to avoid straining your knees or back.
a8488343-681b-4447-8922-01df600bd34a.name: Gorilla Walk

instructions: 1. Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides, and feet hip-width apart.
2. Step forward with one foot into a lunge position, keeping your back straight and lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees.
3. Hold the lunge position, ensuring your front knee is directly above your ankle and your back knee is hovering just above the floor.
4. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite leg.
a84b8317-0a1d-49ea-9ef0-39aeb1c377c6.tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning forward.
2. Engage your core for balance and stability.
3. Inhale as you lower into the lunge and exhale as you return to the starting position.
a84b8317-0a1d-49ea-9ef0-39aeb1c377c6.name: Dumbbell Static Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a large tire with your feet shoulder-width apart and squat down to grip the bottom of the tire with both hands.
2. Engage your core and lift the tire by extending your hips and knees, keeping your back straight and chest up.
3. As the tire reaches hip height, shift your grip to the sides and use your momentum to flip the tire forward.
4. Step forward to reset your stance and prepare for the next flip.
a89118fe-e960-45ad-a30a-6ba4a71301d1.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders during the lift.
2. Use your legs and hips to generate power, not just your arms.
3. Ensure a firm grip on the tire to maintain control throughout the movement.
a89118fe-e960-45ad-a30a-6ba4a71301d1.name: Tyre Flip

instructions: 1. Position a barbell across your upper back and stand with your feet close together, toes pointing slightly outward.
2. Engage your core and slowly lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor or as low as comfortable while maintaining proper form.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
a894434e-993c-4238-9573-7ff55c06505e.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to avoid inward collapse.
2. Maintain a neutral spine and avoid leaning forward excessively.
3. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
a894434e-993c-4238-9573-7ff55c06505e.name: Barbell Narrow Stance Squat

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a bench or elevated surface, holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
2. Place your left foot on the bench behind you, ensuring your right foot is firmly planted on the ground.
3. Lower your body into a lunge by bending your right knee, keeping your chest up and back straight.
4. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
a94decb3-7504-4034-bbd0-422f000aa34a.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your ankle to prevent strain.
2. Engage your core for balance and stability throughout the movement.
3. Inhale as you lower into the lunge and exhale as you return to the starting position.
a94decb3-7504-4034-bbd0-422f000aa34a.name: Kettlebell Bulgarian Split Squat Right Side View

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and lower into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
2. Place your hands on the floor in front of you and jump your feet back into a plank position.
3. Perform a push-up, then jump your feet back towards your hands, returning to the squat position.
4. Explosively jump up from the squat, reaching your arms overhead, and land softly to repeat the sequence.
aa6fd91d-5da0-41e0-932f-eca97db951e8.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back during the plank and push-up.
2. Land softly on your feet to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Breathe steadily, exhaling as you jump and inhaling as you lower into the squat.
aa6fd91d-5da0-41e0-932f-eca97db951e8.name: Burpee Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet close together and hold a dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands.
2. Elevate your heels by standing on a small platform or weight plate, keeping your core engaged.
3. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, maintaining control of the dumbbell throughout.
aad567c8-7349-480f-9dd5-2d55afe28f87.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to prevent inward collapse.
2. Maintain a neutral spine and avoid leaning forward excessively.
3. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
aad567c8-7349-480f-9dd5-2d55afe28f87.name: Narrow Stance Heels Elevated Dumbbell Goblet Squats

instructions: 1. Stand on one leg with your knee slightly bent and hold your arms out in front of you for balance.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your standing knee, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Extend your other leg behind you as a counterbalance, maintaining control and stability.
4. Push through your heel to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
ab12dc9b-0fa0-4134-a4fb-eb1506e4a815.tips:
1. Focus on a point in front of you to help maintain balance.
2. Engage your core to support your lower back and stabilize your movement.
3. Perform the movement slowly and with control to enhance balance and coordination.
ab12dc9b-0fa0-4134-a4fb-eb1506e4a815.name: Counterbalanced Skater Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and position a barbell across your upper back.
2. Step forward with one foot into a split stance, keeping your back straight and lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees.
3. Hold the split squat position, ensuring your front knee is directly above your ankle and your back knee is hovering just above the floor.
4. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite leg.
ab560855-2906-4c6b-b903-679cc58805dc.tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning forward.
2. Engage your core for balance and stability.
3. Inhale as you lower into the split squat and exhale as you return to the starting position.
ab560855-2906-4c6b-b903-679cc58805dc.name: Barbell Jefferson Split Squat

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your upper back against an elevated surface and your feet flat on the ground, knees bent.
2. Place a resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees, and elevate your feet onto a stable platform.
3. Engage your core and glutes to lift your hips towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control, keeping tension on the band throughout the movement.
ab906ebe-8854-451c-b00d-878a1fda73ba.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Ensure your hips reach full extension at the top of the movement for maximum glute activation.
3. Perform the movement slowly and with control to avoid any jerky motions.
ab906ebe-8854-451c-b00d-878a1fda73ba.name: Banded Feet Elevated Hip Thrusters

instructions: 1. Lie face down on a mat with your legs extended and arms at your sides.
2. Bend one knee and reach back with the same-side hand to grasp your ankle or foot.
3. Gently pull your foot towards your glutes until you feel a stretch in the front of your thigh.
4. Hold the stretch for the desired duration, then switch sides.
abf3626a-f002-4003-b470-bc10e0226c5f.tips:
1. Keep your hips pressed into the mat to isolate the stretch in your quadriceps.
2. Avoid pulling too hard to prevent straining your knee joint.
3. Breathe deeply and relax into the stretch for better effectiveness.
abf3626a-f002-4003-b470-bc10e0226c5f.name: Lying Face Down Quadriceps Stretch

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place a resistance band under your left foot, holding the other end in your right hand.
2. Step back with your right foot into a reverse lunge, keeping your chest up and lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position, maintaining tension on the band throughout the movement.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the opposite leg.
ac178d1d-c029-4fdb-85bc-479c197d6c2f.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your ankle to prevent strain.
2. Engage your core for balance and stability throughout the movement.
3. Inhale as you lower into the lunge and exhale as you return to the starting position.
ac178d1d-c029-4fdb-85bc-479c197d6c2f.name: Reverse Lunge Left Resistance Band

instructions: 1. Stand on a balance board with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and arms at your sides.
2. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture, keeping your gaze forward.
3. Shift your weight gently from side to side or front to back to maintain balance on the board.
4. Continue balancing for the desired duration, focusing on stability and control.
ac4b5c63-824b-48af-b92e-6d6fb4fb341d.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your balance and posture.
2. Avoid locking your knees; keep them slightly bent for better control.
3. Focus on a point in front of you to help maintain balance.
ac4b5c63-824b-48af-b92e-6d6fb4fb341d.name: Balance Board (Version 2)

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a barbell attached to a landmine attachment with both hands at shoulder height.
2. Engage your core and press the barbell overhead by extending your arms fully, keeping your back straight and chest up.
3. Lower the barbell back to shoulder height with control, maintaining tension in your shoulders.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
ac7b54b1-bb12-479c-8128-5fa6a4c70047.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent arching your back during the press.
2. Exhale as you press the barbell overhead and inhale as you lower it back down.
3. Ensure your elbows are slightly in front of your shoulders to maintain proper form.
ac7b54b1-bb12-479c-8128-5fa6a4c70047.name: Landmine Seated Overhead Press

instructions: 1. Stand with your left foot on a chair and the resistance band secured under your right foot. Hold the other end of the band in your right hand.
2. Step your right foot back into a lunge position, bending both knees until your left thigh is parallel to the floor.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position, maintaining tension on the band.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
ae365949-2031-4009-acfb-5a2f8aff0385.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Ensure the resistance band is securely placed under your foot to avoid slipping.
3. Exhale as you push back to the starting position, and inhale as you lower into the lunge.
ae365949-2031-4009-acfb-5a2f8aff0385.name: Chair Back Lunge Left Resistance Band

instructions: 1. Kneel on the floor with your knees hip-width apart and a barbell placed across your upper back.
2. Engage your core and glutes, then lower your hips back towards your heels.
3. Press through your knees to return to the upright kneeling position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
ae87f7d6-45cd-4fa3-8714-2573dfbfaa06.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid arching as you lower and lift.
2. Exhale as you rise and inhale as you lower.
3. Ensure the barbell is balanced and secure on your upper back.
ae87f7d6-45cd-4fa3-8714-2573dfbfaa06.name: Barbell Kneeling Squat

instructions: 1. Begin in a pushup position with a kettlebell placed beside your right hand.
2. Perform a pushup, lowering your chest towards the floor.
3. As you push back up, move your right hand over the kettlebell to the other side.
4. Repeat the pushup on the opposite side, alternating hands over the kettlebell for each repetition.
aedb2e6b-8515-4a5f-bd9b-97e92b678819.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain a straight line from head to heels.
2. Exhale as you push up and inhale as you lower down.
3. Move your hand over the kettlebell with control to avoid losing balance.
aedb2e6b-8515-4a5f-bd9b-97e92b678819.name: Kettlebell Walkover Pushup

instructions: 1. Sit on the hip adductor machine with your back against the pad and feet on the footrests.
2. Adjust the machine so your knees are positioned comfortably against the pads.
3. Squeeze your legs together, bringing the pads towards each other.
4. Slowly return to the starting position with control, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
af5075d5-1bf4-4ca9-9809-18aff79d6e46.tips:
1. Keep your back pressed against the pad to maintain proper posture.
2. Exhale as you squeeze your legs together and inhale as you return to the starting position.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on controlled movements to engage the hip muscles effectively.
af5075d5-1bf4-4ca9-9809-18aff79d6e46.name: Seated Machine Hip Adductor

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a step or bench holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
2. Place your right foot on the step and press through your heel to lift your body up.
3. Step down with your left foot, returning to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
b00e41ac-4a4b-4188-a3d2-0acd1894be05.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Exhale as you step up and inhale as you step down.
3. Ensure the step or bench is stable and secure before beginning the exercise.
b00e41ac-4a4b-4188-a3d2-0acd1894be05.name: Kettlebell Step Up

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell attached to a landmine attachment with both hands at chest level.
2. Step forward into a lunge with your right leg, bending both knees to lower your body.
3. As you lunge, press the barbell forward from your chest.
4. Return to the starting position and alternate legs for each repetition.
b0a931e2-9a84-41ff-9599-c288d9a9e569.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged and back straight throughout the movement.
2. Exhale as you press the barbell and inhale as you return to the starting position.
3. Ensure the landmine attachment is secure and stable before starting the exercise.
b0a931e2-9a84-41ff-9599-c288d9a9e569.name: Landmine Alternating Lunge to Chest Press

instructions: 1. Stand with your left foot forward and right foot back, securing a resistance band under your right foot and holding the other end in your right hand.
2. Lower your body into a split squat, bending both knees until your left thigh is parallel to the floor.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position, maintaining tension on the band.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
b13c6a32-b949-4382-95f4-f59f901a06d0.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Ensure the resistance band is securely placed under your foot to avoid slipping.
3. Exhale as you push back to the starting position, and inhale as you lower into the squat.
b13c6a32-b949-4382-95f4-f59f901a06d0.name: Band Spanish Split Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet staggered, one foot slightly in front of the other, holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
2. Hinge at the hips to lower the barbell towards the floor, keeping your back straight and knees slightly bent.
3. Engage your lower back and glutes to lift the barbell back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch the lead foot.
b1f1c30e-7bc8-4485-929d-c732b87b5acb.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back throughout the movement.
2. Exhale as you lift the barbell and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid rounding your back; maintain a neutral spine to prevent injury.
b1f1c30e-7bc8-4485-929d-c732b87b5acb.name: Barbell Staggered Deadlift

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides.
2. Lower into a squat, keeping your chest up and knees aligned with your toes.
3. As you rise, step your right leg out to the side, then return to the squat position.
4. Repeat the movement, alternating stepping to the side and stepping forward with each leg.
b2409981-3326-458e-b1c1-4de44feb6949.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Exhale as you rise from the squat and inhale as you lower.
3. Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
b2409981-3326-458e-b1c1-4de44feb6949.name: Bodyweight Squat to Side to Front Leg

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet together and hands on your hips.
2. Step your right foot out to the side, bending your left knee to lower into a side lunge.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement, alternating sides with each step.
b291beba-b2aa-4d1c-933a-e80bb88cb987.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the exercise.
2. Exhale as you push back to the starting position, and inhale as you step out.
3. Ensure your knee is aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
b291beba-b2aa-4d1c-933a-e80bb88cb987.name: Alternating Step Out

instructions: 1. Lie on your side with your legs bent at a 90-degree angle and a resistance band around your thighs.
2. Keep your feet together and lift your top knee towards the ceiling, keeping your core engaged.
3. Lower your knee back to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
b2ddf1ed-12f5-49c3-bebf-0311b2a40904.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to stabilize your pelvis and prevent rolling back.
2. Exhale as you lift your knee and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on controlled movements to engage the muscles effectively.
b2ddf1ed-12f5-49c3-bebf-0311b2a40904.name: Resistance Band Clam

instructions: 1. Stand facing a cable pulley machine with a rope attachment set at upper chest height.
2. Grasp the rope with both hands, palms facing each other, and step back to create tension.
3. Pull the rope towards your face, flaring your elbows out to the sides.
4. Slowly return to the starting position with control, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
b31ebe7b-5e56-4d34-ae64-e9389fb7b871.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged and back straight throughout the exercise.
2. Exhale as you pull the rope towards your face and inhale as you return to the starting position.
3. Avoid using your lower back to pull; focus on using your shoulder muscles.
b31ebe7b-5e56-4d34-ae64-e9389fb7b871.name: Cable Face Pull With Rope

instructions: 1. Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand, the other hand on your hip.
2. Hinge at the hips to lower the dumbbell towards the floor, keeping your back straight and the non-supporting leg extended behind you.
3. Engage your lower back and glutes to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
b4048073-5b73-4da2-a830-77fa7935040f.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Exhale as you lift the dumbbell and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid rounding your back; maintain a neutral spine to prevent injury.
b4048073-5b73-4da2-a830-77fa7935040f.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Single Arm Deadlift

instructions: 1. Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor and hands gripping the sides of the seat.
2. Lean back slightly and lift your legs off the floor, keeping them straight.
3. Pull your knees towards your chest while maintaining your balance on the chair.
4. Extend your legs back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
b49be7d9-36f8-4332-825f-abd9f833a17c.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and support your lower back.
2. Exhale as you pull your knees in and inhale as you extend them.
3. Avoid leaning too far back to prevent straining your lower back.
b49be7d9-36f8-4332-825f-abd9f833a17c.name: Push Pull Chair Over Head Pull

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
2. Lower into a squat, keeping your chest up and knees aligned with your toes.
3. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, maintaining the dumbbells at shoulder height.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
b4e1f53f-274e-48de-b20d-6aae0180b087.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back throughout the movement.
2. Exhale as you rise from the squat and inhale as you lower.
3. Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
b4e1f53f-274e-48de-b20d-6aae0180b087.name: Front Squats Dumbbell Low

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a bench, knees bent, and feet flat on the floor. Place a dumbbell on your lap, holding it with both hands.
2. Cross your right ankle over your left knee to form a figure four position.
3. Drive through your left heel to lift your hips towards the ceiling, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
b4e542c6-a060-4bde-9011-7c5dc8c06e33.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the movement to maintain stability.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure the dumbbell is securely held to prevent it from slipping during the exercise.
b4e542c6-a060-4bde-9011-7c5dc8c06e33.name: Dumbbell Figure Four Hip Thrust

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a resistance band in your right hand, with the other end secured under your left foot.
2. Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right leg slightly off the ground behind you.
3. Hinge at the hips to lower your torso towards the floor, keeping your back straight and the resistance band taut.
4. Return to the starting position by engaging your lower back and glutes. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
b6f0a9be-4f96-4c05-a426-2a3de0b19ba3.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and prevent rounding of the back.
2. Exhale as you lower your torso and inhale as you return to the starting position.
3. Focus on a slow and controlled movement to enhance stability and muscle engagement.
b6f0a9be-4f96-4c05-a426-2a3de0b19ba3.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlifts Right Cable Resistance Band

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your feet elevated on a bench, knees bent, and a barbell resting across your hips.
2. Engage your core and glutes, and press through your heels to lift your hips towards the ceiling.
3. Hold the top position briefly, ensuring your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
b72c6877-9727-4944-b534-2ee72e9534b2.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to prevent arching of the lower back.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure the barbell is securely positioned to avoid any movement during the exercise.
b72c6877-9727-4944-b534-2ee72e9534b2.name: Barbell Feet Elevated Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Adjust the cable pulley machine to a low setting and attach an ankle strap to your right ankle.
2. Lie face down on a bench with your knees just off the edge, keeping your left leg straight and right knee bent.
3. Curl your right heel towards your glutes by contracting your hamstrings, keeping your hips pressed against the bench.
4. Slowly extend your right leg back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
b76c7fde-88d9-4a3b-8162-7c18c992dc73.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to stabilize your body on the bench.
2. Exhale as you curl your leg and inhale as you extend it.
3. Avoid lifting your hips off the bench to maintain proper form and focus on the hamstrings.
b76c7fde-88d9-4a3b-8162-7c18c992dc73.name: Cable Assisted Inverse Leg Curl

instructions: 1. Lie face down on the leg curl machine, positioning your ankles under the padded lever.
2. Grip the handles for support and ensure your knees are aligned with the pivot point of the machine.
3. Curl your legs upward by contracting your hamstrings, bringing your heels towards your glutes.
4. Lower the lever back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
b7bec4b6-f18f-4117-96d3-3782daa7d3aa.tips:
1. Keep your hips pressed against the bench to isolate the hamstrings effectively.
2. Exhale as you curl your legs and inhale as you lower them.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on a slow and controlled movement.
b7bec4b6-f18f-4117-96d3-3782daa7d3aa.name: Lying Leg Curl Machine

instructions: 1. Begin on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
2. Keeping your knee bent, lift your right leg out to the side, maintaining a 90-degree angle at the knee.
3. Squeeze your quadriceps at the top of the movement, ensuring your hips remain level.
4. Lower your leg back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
b8785788-d6aa-48b8-9fa2-8bed5ede16f7.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and prevent arching of the back.
2. Exhale as you lift your leg and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid rotating your hips; focus on isolating the quadriceps.
b8785788-d6aa-48b8-9fa2-8bed5ede16f7.name: Bent Leg Side Kick (Kneeling)

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the end of a barbell secured in a landmine attachment in your right hand.
2. Bend forward slightly at the hips, keeping your back straight and elbow resting against the inside of your right thigh.
3. Curl the barbell towards your shoulder by contracting your biceps, keeping your upper arm stationary.
4. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
b937427b-e2eb-4b4c-b295-d186dff4e522.tips:
1. Ensure the landmine attachment is secure to prevent slipping.
2. Exhale as you curl the barbell and inhale as you lower it.
3. Keep your elbow stationary to focus on bicep engagement.
b937427b-e2eb-4b4c-b295-d186dff4e522.name: Landmine Concentration Curl

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and perform a standard burpee by squatting down, placing your hands on the floor, and jumping your feet back into a plank position.
2. Perform a push-up, then jump your feet back towards your hands and explode upwards into a jump.
3. As you land, immediately jump up to grab a pull-up bar and perform a pull-up by pulling your chin above the bar.
4. Lower yourself back down with control and return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
b961c7a4-fb7a-430f-ae7f-ce9dd2e5d25e.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the movement to maintain stability.
2. Exhale as you jump and pull up, inhale as you lower yourself.
3. Ensure you have a firm grip on the pull-up bar to prevent slipping.
b961c7a4-fb7a-430f-ae7f-ce9dd2e5d25e.name: Burpee To Pull-Up

instructions: 1. Stand next to a wall with your right side facing it, placing your right forearm against the wall at shoulder height.
2. Step your right foot forward slightly and rotate your torso away from the wall to feel a stretch in your chest.
3. Hold the stretch for a moment, ensuring your shoulder remains relaxed and down.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
b9aedc4b-c5b2-4e88-821a-eee7fa7b36b8.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and support your posture.
2. Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.
3. Avoid overstretching; focus on a comfortable range of motion.
b9aedc4b-c5b2-4e88-821a-eee7fa7b36b8.name: Side Chest Stretch on Wall

instructions: 1. Attach a sled to a harness and secure it around your waist.
2. Begin in a crawling position with your hands and feet on the ground, knees slightly bent.
3. Crawl forward, dragging the sled behind you, keeping your core engaged and back straight.
4. Continue crawling for the desired distance, maintaining a steady pace and controlled movements.
b9b65a29-5d75-4534-9001-5d8ca8f9c145.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to stabilize your body and prevent lower back strain.
2. Breathe steadily and rhythmically as you crawl.
3. Ensure the sled is securely attached to avoid any sudden jerks or imbalances.
b9b65a29-5d75-4534-9001-5d8ca8f9c145.name: Crawl With Sled Drag

instructions: 1. Kneel on the leg curl machine with your knees aligned with the pivot point and ankles secured under the padded lever.
2. Grip the handles for support and ensure your body is stable.
3. Curl your legs upward by contracting your hamstrings, bringing your heels towards your glutes.
4. Lower the lever back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
bad2cffa-3072-4609-9467-018e249f68f2.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and prevent excessive movement.
2. Exhale as you curl your legs and inhale as you lower them.
3. Focus on a slow and controlled motion to maximize hamstring engagement.
bad2cffa-3072-4609-9467-018e249f68f2.name: Kneeling Leg Curl Machine

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, positioning a barbell across your upper back.
2. Step one foot forward and one foot back, bending both knees to lower into a squat position.
3. Keep your torso upright and engage your core as you push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch the leading foot.
bb12d3cf-dbff-43eb-b130-e12f859682d5.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and support your spine.
2. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you lower into the squat.
3. Ensure your knees track over your toes to prevent strain on the joints.
bb12d3cf-dbff-43eb-b130-e12f859682d5.name: Barbell Jefferson Squat

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, arms by your sides.
2. Lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees, engaging your glutes and core.
3. While keeping your hips elevated, move your knees outwards in a controlled manner and back.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
bb451e4a-a95e-4f49-a665-c44c647b4a55.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Ensure your hips remain elevated and level throughout the exercise to maximize glute activation.
3. Perform the leg abductions slowly and with control to avoid any jerky movements and enhance muscle engagement.
bb451e4a-a95e-4f49-a665-c44c647b4a55.name: Glute Bridge With Abduction Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Adjust the machine to fit your height and secure one ankle under the padded lever.
2. Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and grip the handles for support.
3. Curl your leg upward by contracting your hamstrings, bringing your heel towards your glutes.
4. Lower the lever back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
bb933039-7f84-4b46-bb6b-b55f641645ba.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and prevent excessive movement.
2. Exhale as you curl your leg and inhale as you lower it.
3. Focus on a slow and controlled motion to maximize hamstring engagement.
bb933039-7f84-4b46-bb6b-b55f641645ba.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl Single Leg

instructions: 1. Lie on your side with your legs extended and arms resting comfortably.
2. Begin making small circles with your top arm, keeping your shoulder relaxed.
3. Gradually increase the size of the circles, maintaining a smooth and controlled motion.
4. Reverse the direction of the circles after the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
bba14da0-da79-4ca0-967a-968206efb98e.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and prevent excessive movement.
2. Breathe steadily and rhythmically throughout the exercise.
3. Focus on a smooth and controlled motion to enhance shoulder mobility and warm-up effectively.
bba14da0-da79-4ca0-967a-968206efb98e.name: Lying on Side Arm Circle Warm Up

instructions: 1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with your elbows bent and palms facing each other.
2. Step forward with your right foot, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees, keeping your torso upright.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left leg.
bbb1894b-f770-4b35-94d3-c9025f900e9b.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes during the lunge.
3. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you lower into the lunge.
bbb1894b-f770-4b35-94d3-c9025f900e9b.name: Dumbbell Front Rack Lunge

instructions: 1. Position yourself on a leg press machine with your feet placed wide and high on the platform, toes slightly pointed outward.
2. Push the platform away by extending your legs, ensuring your back remains flat against the seat.
3. Slowly bend your knees to lower the platform back towards you, maintaining control.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
bc1b1a30-2943-4ef1-b42d-4c78a1fe1f6d.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to prevent injury.
2. Avoid locking your knees at the top of the movement.
3. Exhale as you press the platform away and inhale as you lower it back.
bc1b1a30-2943-4ef1-b42d-4c78a1fe1f6d.name: Leg Press Wide High Stance Behind View

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of your hips.
2. Lower your hips into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, squeezing your glutes at the top.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
bc2020c9-07c4-46a4-af4e-bd6c436a3890.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
2. Maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise.
3. Exhale as you stand up and inhale as you lower into the squat.
bc2020c9-07c4-46a4-af4e-bd6c436a3890.name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat
