instructions: 1. Attach a barbell to a landmine attachment and stand facing the barbell with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Hold the end of the barbell with one hand and position yourself in a slight forward lean, keeping your back straight.
3. Extend your leg back, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
4. Return your leg to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
bc324ad9-bc83-4589-aa90-e18dc1bbfbe2.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
2. Avoid arching your back during the movement.
3. Exhale as you kick back and inhale as you return to the starting position.
bc324ad9-bc83-4589-aa90-e18dc1bbfbe2.name: Landmine Glute Kick Back

instructions: 1. Sit on a horizontal leg press machine with your feet placed shoulder-width apart on the platform.
2. Push the platform away by extending your legs, ensuring your back remains flat against the seat.
3. Slowly bend your knees to lower the platform back towards you, maintaining control.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
bc4540f9-1ed6-4db4-ba07-e1f49fc009ca.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to prevent injury.
2. Avoid locking your knees at the top of the movement.
3. Exhale as you press the platform away and inhale as you lower it back.
bc4540f9-1ed6-4db4-ba07-e1f49fc009ca.name: Horizontal Leg Press

instructions: 1. Attach a barbell to a landmine attachment and stand facing the barbell with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold the end of the barbell with both hands, palms facing up, and elbows close to your body.
3. Curl the barbell towards your shoulders by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
4. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
bd611dc9-d74e-41e8-aa99-8d0391d11b9a.tips:
1. Keep your elbows close to your body to isolate the biceps.
2. Avoid swinging your body or using momentum to lift the barbell.
3. Exhale as you curl the barbell up and inhale as you lower it back down.
bd611dc9-d74e-41e8-aa99-8d0391d11b9a.name: Landmine Bicep Curl

instructions: 1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, hands on your hips or extended in front for balance.
2. Step to the side with your right foot, bending your right knee while keeping your left leg straight, lowering your hips into a side lunge.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left leg.
bd8770cb-9277-4217-bead-02ab895be8ef.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the exercise.
2. Ensure your knee is aligned with your toes to prevent strain.
3. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you lower into the lunge.
bd8770cb-9277-4217-bead-02ab895be8ef.name: Multi Hip Abduction

instructions: 1. Stand at the end of an agility ladder with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Step into the first square with your right foot, followed by your left foot, then step out to the sides with both feet.
3. Continue this in-in-out-out pattern down the length of the ladder, moving quickly and with control.
4. Repeat the sequence for the desired number of repetitions or time.
bd8cf3d2-f4e4-43f7-92c2-2d6b6ef5b6d4.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and agility.
2. Focus on quick, light steps to enhance speed and coordination.
3. Avoid looking down at your feet; keep your gaze forward to improve spatial awareness.
bd8cf3d2-f4e4-43f7-92c2-2d6b6ef5b6d4.name: Agility Ladder in in Out Out

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, and place a barbell across your hips.
2. Extend one leg out in front of you while keeping the other foot flat on the floor.
3. Drive through your heel to lift your hips towards the ceiling, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
bd9abf04-1fec-4303-9e7b-f4602fb5afa4.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Avoid arching your back at the top of the movement.
3. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them back down.
bd9abf04-1fec-4303-9e7b-f4602fb5afa4.name: Barbell One Leg Hip Thrust

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a bench, facing away, and place one foot on the bench behind you.
2. Lower your hips into a squat position by bending your front knee, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
be0550f6-aa4f-4ee0-9a7a-fabe477bb2a8.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to prevent strain.
2. Maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise.
3. Exhale as you stand up and inhale as you lower into the squat.
be0550f6-aa4f-4ee0-9a7a-fabe477bb2a8.name: Bulgarian Split Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and arms by your sides.
2. Jump to the right, landing on your right foot and swinging your left leg behind your right leg, mimicking a skating motion.
3. Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot and swinging your right leg behind your left leg.
4. Continue alternating sides in a smooth, controlled manner for the desired number of repetitions or time.
be7c5150-03e3-4fe9-ac18-cd950010589b.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control.
2. Land softly on each jump to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Use your arms to help propel your body and maintain rhythm.
be7c5150-03e3-4fe9-ac18-cd950010589b.name: Skater Hops

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a kettlebell in one hand.
2. Extend one leg out in front of you while keeping the other foot flat on the floor.
3. Drive through your heel to lift your hips towards the ceiling, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
beade308-8b6e-46d4-a1b2-cca999c52b7b.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Avoid arching your back at the top of the movement.
3. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them back down.
beade308-8b6e-46d4-a1b2-cca999c52b7b.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Attach a barbell to a landmine attachment and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the end of the barbell in one hand at shoulder height.
2. Step forward into a lunge position with the opposite leg, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees.
3. Push through your front heel to return to a standing position while simultaneously pressing the barbell overhead.
4. Lower the barbell back to shoulder height and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
bf34e332-858d-446e-911d-f42872588e53.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes during the lunge.
3. Exhale as you press the barbell overhead and inhale as you lower it back down.
bf34e332-858d-446e-911d-f42872588e53.name: Landmine Lunge to Overhead Press

instructions: 1. Lie on your side with a foam roller positioned under your lateral quadriceps, supporting your upper body with your forearm.
2. Use your arms and opposite leg to control your movement, rolling your body over the foam roller from your hip to just above your knee.
3. Apply gentle pressure as you roll back and forth, focusing on any tight or tender areas.
4. Repeat the rolling motion for the desired amount of time or repetitions before switching sides.
c04fd5f8-d706-4760-920c-1372584fb191.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and control.
2. Avoid rolling directly over your knee joint to prevent injury.
3. Breathe deeply and relax your muscles to enhance the effectiveness of the massage.
c04fd5f8-d706-4760-920c-1372584fb191.name: Foam Roller Lateral Quads

instructions: 1. Stand upright with your feet together, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step to the side with your right foot, bending your right knee while keeping your left leg straight, lowering your hips into a side lunge.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position, balancing on your left leg.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left leg.
c15b27fd-2e9a-4505-9b2a-dfcfc3c65472.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the exercise.
2. Ensure your knee is aligned with your toes to prevent strain.
3. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you lower into the lunge.
c15b27fd-2e9a-4505-9b2a-dfcfc3c65472.name: Dumbbell Side Lunge Single Leg

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a plate with both hands in front of your thighs.
2. Shift your weight onto your right leg, keeping a slight bend in the knee, and hinge at the hips to lower the plate towards the floor while extending your left leg straight behind you.
3. Keep your back straight and core engaged as you lower the plate until your torso is parallel to the floor.
4. Return to the starting position by driving through your right heel and bringing your left leg forward. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
c1791827-b05d-4d7d-8cf6-3327cc671171.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and protect your lower back.
2. Avoid rounding your back as you lower the plate.
3. Focus on a point on the floor to help maintain balance.
c1791827-b05d-4d7d-8cf6-3327cc671171.name: Plate Single Leg Deadlift

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
2. Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Hold the squat position with your thighs parallel to the floor, ensuring your knees do not extend past your toes.
4. Maintain this position for the desired duration before returning to a standing position.
c2704609-fd8f-4a35-9bbe-32f4bd18c416.tips:
1. Keep your weight distributed evenly across your feet.
2. Engage your core to support your lower back.
3. Avoid letting your knees collapse inward during the hold.
c2704609-fd8f-4a35-9bbe-32f4bd18c416.name: Bodyweight Squats Hold

instructions: 1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides.
2. Swing your right leg forward in a controlled manner, keeping your knee straight.
3. Immediately swing your right leg backward, maintaining control and balance.
4. Continue swinging your leg back and forth for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left leg.
c3d8a4ac-c6d8-483a-9134-8d4feb2cad5f.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Avoid swinging your leg too high, which may compromise form.
3. Perform the swings in a controlled manner to prevent injury.
c3d8a4ac-c6d8-483a-9134-8d4feb2cad5f.name: Back and Forward Leg Swings

instructions: 1. Stand on the platform of a cable pulley machine with your feet hip-width apart, holding the cable handles at your sides.
2. Engage your core and lift your heels off the platform, rising onto the balls of your feet.
3. Hold the top position briefly, squeezing your calves.
4. Lower your heels back to the platform in a controlled manner. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
c3ec3fce-4bc3-4247-af83-982702ec020a.tips:
1. Keep your knees slightly bent to reduce strain on your joints.
2. Exhale as you lift your heels and inhale as you lower them.
3. Avoid bouncing at the top of the movement to maintain muscle tension.
c3ec3fce-4bc3-4247-af83-982702ec020a.name: Cable Calve Raise

instructions: 1. Position a barbell in a landmine attachment and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the end of the barbell with both hands at chest level.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Drive through your heels to return to a standing position while pressing the barbell overhead.
4. Lower the barbell back to chest level as you prepare for the next repetition.
c4b4418a-d2d3-45a9-864b-74f151a316e1.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the movement to maintain stability.
2. Ensure your knees track over your toes during the squat.
3. Avoid arching your back as you press the barbell overhead.
c4b4418a-d2d3-45a9-864b-74f151a316e1.name: Landmine Squat and Press

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across the front of your shoulders with your elbows pointing forward.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up and elbows high.
3. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor, ensuring your knees do not extend past your toes.
4. Drive through your heels to return to a standing position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
c5b71ba5-d394-4313-9f07-516971e9f8ab.tips:
1. Keep your elbows high to prevent the barbell from rolling forward.
2. Engage your core to support your lower back.
3. Avoid letting your knees collapse inward during the squat.
c5b71ba5-d394-4313-9f07-516971e9f8ab.name: Barbell Front Chest Squat

instructions: 1. Sit on the leg curl machine and adjust the pad so it rests just above your ankles.
2. Grasp the handles and engage your core, keeping your back pressed against the seat.
3. Curl both legs towards your buttocks by bending your knees, squeezing your hamstrings at the top of the movement.
4. Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your legs. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
c620d02c-5114-447a-8f60-cca13ea0b014.tips:
1. Keep your movements controlled to avoid using momentum.
2. Exhale as you curl your legs and inhale as you extend them.
3. Ensure the pad is securely positioned to prevent slipping.
c620d02c-5114-447a-8f60-cca13ea0b014.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl_Both Leg

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your feet elevated on a bench or step, and cross your right ankle over your left knee to form a figure four.
2. Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor to form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
3. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, holding briefly.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
c63e6580-b35c-4219-8313-ab2d1d14ad1f.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and protect your lower back.
2. Ensure your hips remain level throughout the exercise.
3. Avoid arching your back as you lift your hips.
c63e6580-b35c-4219-8313-ab2d1d14ad1f.name: Bodyweight Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Stand on one leg with your knee slightly bent and your arms at your sides.
2. Bend your knee and lower into a slight squat to prepare for the jump.
3. Explode off the ground, jumping as high as possible while swinging your arms upward.
4. Land softly on the same leg, absorbing the impact by bending your knee. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
c743cba2-f53f-4ccb-b2f4-33283a7a35a7.tips:
1. Engage your core to maintain balance during the jump.
2. Focus on landing softly to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Avoid letting your knee collapse inward upon landing.
c743cba2-f53f-4ccb-b2f4-33283a7a35a7.name: Unilateral Jumps

instructions: 1. Adjust the seat and handlebars of the exercise bike to a comfortable position.
2. Begin pedaling at a moderate pace to warm up.
3. Increase your speed to a sprint, pedaling as fast as possible while maintaining control.
4. Continue sprinting for the desired duration, then gradually slow down to recover.
c7ef6e4c-a79c-46b8-a5f6-9c030ae0bcea.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability on the bike.
2. Focus on smooth, circular pedal strokes to maximize efficiency.
3. Avoid leaning too far forward, which can strain your back.
c7ef6e4c-a79c-46b8-a5f6-9c030ae0bcea.name: Indoor Cycling Spinbike Sprint

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, positioning a barbell on blocks just below knee height.
2. Bend at the hips and knees to grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees to lift the barbell off the blocks, shrugging your shoulders and pulling the barbell upward.
4. Catch the barbell at shoulder height in a squat position, then stand up to complete the movement. Lower the barbell back to the blocks and repeat.
c81377c6-a7e4-4f6a-a149-ee81c0174a1a.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to protect your lower back during the lift.
2. Focus on a powerful hip extension to generate momentum.
3. Avoid pulling with your arms too early; let your legs and hips drive the movement.
c81377c6-a7e4-4f6a-a149-ee81c0174a1a.name: Barbell Power Clean From Blocks

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and extend one leg forward, keeping your heel on the ground.
2. Lower your body into a squat on the supporting leg, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Use a support, such as a chair or railing, to assist with balance as needed.
4. Push through your heel to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
c8403989-7d5c-4378-82d9-84d64e22fcc1.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
2. Ensure your knee does not extend past your toes during the squat.
3. Use assistance only as needed to maintain proper form.
c8403989-7d5c-4378-82d9-84d64e22fcc1.name: Assisted Pistol Squats

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a plate in each hand at your sides.
2. Step forward with your right leg onto a slightly elevated surface, such as a plate, and lower your body into a lunge.
3. Keep your front knee aligned over your ankle and your back knee hovering just above the ground.
4. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
c96f8f72-ae10-4d77-a508-b625cdf7d37a.tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Avoid letting your front knee extend past your toes.
3. Focus on a controlled descent and ascent to maximize muscle engagement.
c96f8f72-ae10-4d77-a508-b625cdf7d37a.name: Plate Deficit Lunge

instructions: 1. Secure a resistance band around a stable anchor point at ankle height and attach the other end to your right ankle.
2. Stand facing the anchor point with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
3. Extend your right leg straight back, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
4. Return your leg to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
ca3f8363-c1a0-492a-9ca9-5622aa178b98.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Avoid arching your back as you extend your leg.
3. Perform the movement slowly to ensure proper muscle activation.
ca3f8363-c1a0-492a-9ca9-5622aa178b98.name: Resistance Band Leg Kickback

instructions: 1. Kneel on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand, holding them at shoulder height with a clean grip.
2. Engage your core and step one foot forward to come into a half-kneeling position.
3. Press through your front heel to stand up, bringing your back foot forward.
4. Reverse the movement to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, alternating the leading leg.
cb309f03-0053-4d07-9b73-25f86a265ce9.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to maintain balance during the transition.
2. Ensure your knees are aligned with your toes as you step forward.
3. Avoid leaning forward excessively as you stand up.
cb309f03-0053-4d07-9b73-25f86a265ce9.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Hold to Stand Clean Grip

instructions: 1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell across the front of your shoulders with an overhand grip, elbows pointing forward.
2. Step forward with your right foot into a lunge position, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement with your left leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
cb5aba72-2c11-4c77-a5b5-c7d01399d7ae.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged to maintain balance and protect your lower back.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes during the lunge.
3. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you step forward.
cb5aba72-2c11-4c77-a5b5-c7d01399d7ae.name: Barbell Front Chest Lunges

instructions: 1. Stand with your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart and a few inches away from the wall.
2. Slide down the wall by bending your knees until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your back flat against the wall.
3. Hold the squat position, ensuring your knees are directly above your ankles.
4. Press through your heels to return to the starting position and repeat.
cbac78fe-9758-4ef3-82c7-b55801053915.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain a flat back against the wall.
2. Avoid letting your knees cave inward; keep them aligned with your toes.
3. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you press back up.
cbac78fe-9758-4ef3-82c7-b55801053915.name: Bodyweight Wall Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
2. Shift your weight to your right leg, bending your right knee and lowering your hips while keeping your left leg straight.
3. Lower your hips as far as comfortable, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
4. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position and switch sides, repeating the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
cc43b6dc-82dd-4243-8e3a-84873925a603.tips:
1. Keep your chest lifted and back straight to avoid leaning forward.
2. Ensure your knee stays aligned with your toes to prevent strain.
3. Move slowly and with control to maintain balance and engage the muscles effectively.
cc43b6dc-82dd-4243-8e3a-84873925a603.name: Cossack Squat

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your legs crossed comfortably in front of you.
2. Extend your right arm overhead and gently lean to the left, feeling a stretch along your right side.
3. Hold the side bend for a moment, keeping your left hand on the floor for support.
4. Return to the upright position and repeat on the opposite side.
cc66f5b0-5c04-477d-b6fe-7794e82920c9.tips:
1. Keep your spine elongated and avoid collapsing your chest as you bend.
2. Breathe deeply, inhaling as you prepare to bend and exhaling as you stretch.
3. Move gently to avoid any sudden or jerky movements that could strain your back.
cc66f5b0-5c04-477d-b6fe-7794e82920c9.name: Seated Side Bend Pose

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically at chest level with both hands.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping the dumbbell close to your chest.
3. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor or as far as comfortable, ensuring your chest remains upright.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position and repeat.
ccff74ab-7f37-451d-80a1-c2bcc3fda892.tips:
1. Keep your elbows close to your body to maintain control of the dumbbell.
2. Engage your core throughout the movement to support your lower back.
3. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
ccff74ab-7f37-451d-80a1-c2bcc3fda892.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat

instructions: 1. Begin in a handstand position against a wall, with your hands shoulder-width apart and feet resting on the wall.
2. Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your head in a neutral position.
3. Use a kipping motion by bending your knees and driving your legs upward to assist in pushing your body back to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
cd1310cd-f109-446d-ac7b-6fd3cbaa3e0f.tips:
1. Maintain a tight core to stabilize your body throughout the exercise.
2. Use the momentum from your legs to assist in the push-up, but control the descent.
3. Keep your elbows tucked in to protect your shoulders from strain.
cd1310cd-f109-446d-ac7b-6fd3cbaa3e0f.name: Kipping Handstand Push-Up

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a resistance band looped around your thighs, just above your knees.
2. Lower into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up.
3. Explosively jump upwards, extending your legs fully while maintaining tension in the band.
4. Land softly back into the squat position and repeat the jump for the desired number of repetitions.
cdef605c-7aae-4544-897e-b4f0e670bd61.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to prevent inward collapse during the squat and jump.
2. Engage your core to maintain balance and control throughout the movement.
3. Exhale as you jump and inhale as you land back into the squat.
cdef605c-7aae-4544-897e-b4f0e670bd61.name: Resistance Band Squat Jump

instructions: 1. Sit on the ground with your upper back resting against a bench, knees bent, and feet flat on the floor. Place a barbell across your hips.
2. Drive through your heels to lift your hips towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
3. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, ensuring your core is engaged.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat.
ce82812c-5a43-443e-93fb-13c512406054.tips:
1. Keep your chin tucked to maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise.
2. Ensure your feet are positioned so that your shins are vertical at the top of the movement.
3. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them back down.
ce82812c-5a43-443e-93fb-13c512406054.name: Barbell Hip Thrust

instructions: 1. Stand behind a sled, placing your hands on the handles or bar in front of you.
2. Lean forward slightly, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
3. Drive through your legs to push the sled forward, maintaining a steady pace.
4. Continue pushing for the desired distance or time, keeping your movements controlled.
ce8edfb6-43dd-49a9-bfac-3def58ef929e.tips:
1. Keep your shoulders down and back to avoid rounding your upper back.
2. Maintain a firm grip on the sled to ensure control and stability.
3. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, focusing on exhaling as you exert force.
ce8edfb6-43dd-49a9-bfac-3def58ef929e.name: Pull Sled or Dog Sled Push

instructions: 1. Stand to the side of an agility ladder with your feet together, ready to move laterally.
2. Step into the first square with your lead foot, followed by your trailing foot, then perform a double hop.
3. Continue moving laterally through the ladder, stepping into each square and performing a double hop.
4. Complete the movement for the desired length of the ladder and repeat in the opposite direction.
cfc6316f-35d1-4fb4-a093-fa50bd7d99a2.tips:
1. Keep your knees slightly bent to absorb impact and maintain agility.
2. Focus on quick, light steps to enhance speed and coordination.
3. Maintain a steady breathing pattern to support endurance and rhythm.
cfc6316f-35d1-4fb4-a093-fa50bd7d99a2.name: Agility Ladder Lateral Movement With Double Hop

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell on top of your right knee.
2. Raise your right heel off the ground by contracting your calf muscles, keeping the ball of your foot on the floor.
3. Hold the contraction at the top for a moment, then slowly lower your heel back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left leg.
d0198811-7186-4697-b85f-d047f68beec7.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your posture.
2. Avoid bouncing the weight; use a controlled motion to maximize muscle engagement.
3. Exhale as you lift your heel and inhale as you lower it back down.
d0198811-7186-4697-b85f-d047f68beec7.name: Seated Calf Raises Dumbbell on Knee

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet close together, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up.
3. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor or as far as comfortable, ensuring your knees stay aligned with your toes.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position and repeat.
d04659a1-7b62-44ab-ad39-a474a33d4cf1.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back throughout the squat.
2. Avoid letting your knees cave inward; maintain alignment with your toes.
3. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
d04659a1-7b62-44ab-ad39-a474a33d4cf1.name: Barbell Narrow Stance Full Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell in a landmine attachment with your right hand.
2. Press the barbell upward by extending your right arm, keeping your core engaged and torso stable.
3. Lower the barbell back to shoulder level with control, then switch to your left hand.
4. Alternate arms for the desired number of repetitions.
d05acbec-0c49-4851-ab6a-c4f9a266ec29.tips:
1. Keep your shoulders down and back to avoid straining your neck.
2. Engage your core to maintain balance and prevent torso rotation.
3. Exhale as you press the barbell up and inhale as you lower it back down.
d05acbec-0c49-4851-ab6a-c4f9a266ec29.name: Landmine Alternating Single Arm Press

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a bench, holding a kettlebell in your right hand at shoulder height.
2. Place your left foot on the bench behind you, keeping your right foot planted firmly on the ground.
3. Lower your body into a split squat by bending your right knee, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
4. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions on the right leg.
d079a668-fb73-43c7-abf9-70b2bcc8ce60.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to prevent inward collapse.
2. Engage your core to maintain balance and support your lower back.
3. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
d079a668-fb73-43c7-abf9-70b2bcc8ce60.name: Kettlebell Bulgarian Split Squat Right

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, a resistance band looped around your thighs just above your knees.
2. Keep your back straight and core engaged as you press your knees outward against the resistance of the band.
3. Hold the abduction for a moment, then slowly bring your knees back together.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
d08a1c76-2399-4a90-9f5b-ee11a4979fc7.tips:
1. Maintain a tall posture with your chest up and shoulders back.
2. Focus on squeezing your glutes as you press your knees outward.
3. Breathe steadily, exhaling as you press out and inhaling as you return.
d08a1c76-2399-4a90-9f5b-ee11a4979fc7.name: Resistance Band Seated Hip Abduction

instructions: 1. Stand with your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart and a few inches away from the wall.
2. Slide down the wall by bending your knees until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your back pressed against the wall.
3. Hold this position for the desired duration, ensuring your knees do not extend past your toes.
4. Slowly slide back up the wall to return to the starting position.
d10bd9d0-e871-4a82-a6e0-ccec3f074e1e.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Ensure your knees are aligned with your toes to prevent strain.
3. Maintain even pressure against the wall with your back throughout the exercise.
d10bd9d0-e871-4a82-a6e0-ccec3f074e1e.name: Wall Squat Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Engage your core and keep your chest up as you bend your knees and hips to lower your body into a squat.
3. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor, ensuring your knees track over your toes.
4. Press through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
d18cb27c-753c-4142-a1de-fbec699e77c2.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure the barbell is securely positioned on your upper back to avoid discomfort.
d18cb27c-753c-4142-a1de-fbec699e77c2.name: Barbell Squat Back Pov

instructions: 1. Begin on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
2. Lift your right knee out to the side, keeping it bent at a 90-degree angle.
3. Move your knee in a circular motion, maintaining control and engaging your core.
4. Complete the desired number of circles, then switch to the left leg.
d19402c4-3742-4838-898c-ac7e9046dcdf.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to maintain stability throughout the movement.
2. Avoid arching your back as you lift your leg.
3. Perform the circles slowly to maximize muscle engagement and control.
d19402c4-3742-4838-898c-ac7e9046dcdf.name: Fire Hydrant Circle Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Attach a heavy bag to a sled and stand facing away from the sled, holding the sled straps in your hands.
2. Lean forward slightly and begin walking forward, dragging the sled behind you.
3. Maintain a steady pace, engaging your core and keeping your shoulders back.
4. Continue for the desired distance or time, then carefully stop and set the sled down.
d1b8dca4-8689-4c4c-a4e9-be923924b061.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent lower back strain.
2. Maintain a steady breathing pattern throughout the exercise.
3. Ensure you have a clear path to avoid tripping or obstacles.
d1b8dca4-8689-4c4c-a4e9-be923924b061.name: Heavy Bag Sled Drag

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell with both hands at chest level.
2. Engage your core and keep your chest up as you bend your knees and hips to lower your body into a squat.
3. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor, ensuring your knees track over your toes.
4. Press through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
d247e07e-9a9f-43e8-8a79-4343c147d047.tips:
1. Keep the kettlebell close to your chest to maintain balance.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure your knees do not collapse inward during the movement.
d247e07e-9a9f-43e8-8a79-4343c147d047.name: Kettlebell Squats

instructions: 1. Lie on your side with your legs stacked, knees bent at a 90-degree angle, and your head supported by your lower arm.
2. Keeping your feet together, lift your top knee as high as possible without rotating your hips.
3. Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower your knee back to the starting position.
4. Complete the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other side.
d26be5e1-a74e-4492-8fe8-bd917266fd54.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent your hips from rotating.
2. Exhale as you lift your knee and inhale as you lower it.
3. Perform the movement slowly to maximize muscle engagement.
d26be5e1-a74e-4492-8fe8-bd917266fd54.name: Clamshell

instructions: 1. Stand facing a suspension trainer, holding the grips with both hands, feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Step your right foot out to the side, bending your right knee while keeping your left leg straight.
3. Lower your body into a side squat, keeping your chest up and back straight.
4. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position, then repeat on the left side.
d26de037-0c2e-46ae-84e9-8a170a3a7832.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes during the squat.
d26de037-0c2e-46ae-84e9-8a170a3a7832.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Side Squat

instructions: 1. Start in a standing position with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Step forward with your right foot, lowering your hips into a lunge position with both knees bent at 90 degrees.
3. Jump explosively, switching your legs mid-air, landing in a lunge with your left foot forward.
4. Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
d27dbf30-e786-4df3-a00a-07df64ab4540.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance during the jumps.
2. Land softly to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes when landing.
d27dbf30-e786-4df3-a00a-07df64ab4540.name: Jumping Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands at chest level.
2. Step your right foot back into a split stance, bending both knees to lower your body into a lunge.
3. Keep your chest up and core engaged as you descend until your back knee is just above the floor.
4. Press through your front heel to return to the starting position, then switch legs.
d2dd1a0b-2246-426d-8721-de95e1889ac6.tips:
1. Keep the dumbbell close to your chest to maintain balance.
2. Inhale as you lower into the lunge and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure your front knee remains aligned with your toes during the movement.
d2dd1a0b-2246-426d-8721-de95e1889ac6.name: Dumbbell Goblet Split Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Engage your core and keep your chest up as you bend your knees slightly to lower your body into a quarter squat.
3. Descend only a quarter of the way down, ensuring your knees track over your toes.
4. Press through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
d3570791-76f2-4a35-b990-ea86b968d968.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure the barbell is securely positioned on your upper back to avoid discomfort.
d3570791-76f2-4a35-b990-ea86b968d968.name: Barbell Quarter Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your front shoulders with an overhand grip.
2. Step forward with your right foot, lowering your hips into a lunge position with both knees bent at 90 degrees.
3. Keep your chest up and core engaged as you descend until your back knee is just above the floor.
4. Press through your front heel to return to the starting position, then switch legs.
d3c512d5-7aaa-4de9-84cd-fd3a7d691faa.tips:
1. Keep the barbell balanced on your shoulders to maintain stability.
2. Inhale as you lower into the lunge and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure your front knee remains aligned with your toes during the movement.
d3c512d5-7aaa-4de9-84cd-fd3a7d691faa.name: Barbell Front Rack Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands at chest level.
2. Shift your weight to your right leg, bending your right knee while keeping your left leg straight.
3. Lower your body into a side squat, keeping your chest up and back straight.
4. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position, then repeat on the left side.
d3c73cfd-3a52-4ab4-afa3-7301a706f940.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up.
3. Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes during the squat.
d3c73cfd-3a52-4ab4-afa3-7301a706f940.name: Dumbbell Cossack Squats (Version 2)

instructions: 1. Begin in a kneeling position with your hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart on the floor.
2. Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your knees, engaging your core.
3. Lower your chest towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
4. Push through your palms to return to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
d40c9238-3663-4348-8b4f-9bede837f1ed.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain a straight line from head to knees.
2. Inhale as you lower your body and exhale as you push back up.
3. Avoid flaring your elbows out to the sides to protect your shoulders.
d40c9238-3663-4348-8b4f-9bede837f1ed.name: Kneeling Push-Up

instructions: 1. Begin by lying face down on the floor with a foam roller positioned under your thighs.
2. Support your upper body with your forearms, keeping your core engaged.
3. Roll your body forward and backward, moving the foam roller from just above your knees to just below your hips.
4. Continue rolling for the desired duration, focusing on any tight areas.
d51a8846-1dc4-4ca6-a444-a3380ca7a2fd.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back during the exercise.
2. Breathe steadily and relax your muscles as you roll.
3. Apply gentle pressure and avoid rolling directly over your knee joints.
d51a8846-1dc4-4ca6-a444-a3380ca7a2fd.name: Foam Roller Quads

instructions: 1. Attach an ankle strap to a low cable pulley and secure it around your right ankle.
2. Stand facing the machine, holding onto it for support, with your left foot slightly forward.
3. Extend your right leg straight back, engaging your glutes, without arching your lower back.
4. Slowly return your leg to the starting position, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
d631710b-bd40-4bb3-bd12-1b6f58366d4a.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Exhale as you extend your leg and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on controlled movements to engage the glutes effectively.
d631710b-bd40-4bb3-bd12-1b6f58366d4a.name: Cable Individual Glute Kickbacks

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your upper back against a chair, knees bent, and feet flat on the floor. Extend one leg straight out in front of you.
2. Press through the heel of the foot on the floor to lift your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your extended leg in line with your torso.
3. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, ensuring your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
d645879b-bb47-40f3-a8fa-318bf89d6b0e.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability.
2. Avoid letting your hips drop or twist during the movement.
3. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
d645879b-bb47-40f3-a8fa-318bf89d6b0e.name: Chair Elevated Single Leg Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your upper back against an elevated surface, such as a bench, and hold a dumbbell on your hip with one hand. Extend one leg straight out in front of you.
2. Press through the heel of the foot on the floor to lift your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your extended leg in line with your torso.
3. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, ensuring your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
d65872fb-aeec-45ca-9b06-be41ca243b38.tips:
1. Keep the dumbbell stable on your hip throughout the movement.
2. Engage your core to prevent your hips from dropping or twisting.
3. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
d65872fb-aeec-45ca-9b06-be41ca243b38.name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Single Leg Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
2. Raise your heels off the ground to stand on the balls of your feet, keeping your knees straight.
3. Pause at the top of the movement, squeezing your calf muscles.
4. Slowly lower your heels back to the ground and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
d70aa4dc-65b8-4298-a6c9-c20b2e815e9f.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance throughout the exercise.
2. Avoid rocking your body; focus on the movement coming from your ankles.
3. Exhale as you lift your heels and inhale as you lower them.
d70aa4dc-65b8-4298-a6c9-c20b2e815e9f.name: Kettlebell Calf Raise

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
2. Hinge at your hips and lower the dumbbells towards the floor, keeping your back straight and knees slightly bent.
3. Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, ensuring your back remains flat.
4. Return to the starting position by driving your hips forward and standing upright. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
d71b39ec-6321-4824-9fc4-e06213e5ad38.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
2. Engage your core to support your lower back throughout the movement.
3. Exhale as you lift the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
d71b39ec-6321-4824-9fc4-e06213e5ad38.name: Dumbbell Stiff Leg Deadlift

instructions: 1. Begin in a standard plank position with your forearms on the ground and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
2. Shift your weight onto one forearm and rotate your body to the side, stacking your feet and extending your free arm towards the ceiling.
3. Hold this position, keeping your core engaged and body aligned.
4. Return to the starting plank position and repeat on the opposite side.
d7b26d9a-5dc7-492d-8ced-6a4ad6109076.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging.
2. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise to maintain control.
3. Avoid letting your hips drop or rotate excessively during the movement.
d7b26d9a-5dc7-492d-8ced-6a4ad6109076.name: Unilateral Plank

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with one leg extended straight in front of you and the other leg bent, foot against the inner thigh of the extended leg.
2. Reach your opposite arm over your head and towards the extended leg, twisting your torso slightly.
3. Hold the stretch, feeling a gentle pull along your side and back.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
d7c1dd8d-80bb-4c1c-a26f-ebc304511506.tips:
1. Keep your extended leg straight and your foot flexed to enhance the stretch.
2. Breathe deeply and relax into the stretch to maximize flexibility.
3. Avoid forcing the twist; move within a comfortable range of motion.
d7c1dd8d-80bb-4c1c-a26f-ebc304511506.name: Revolved Head to Knee

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and arms crossed over your chest.
2. Lift one leg and kick it forward while maintaining balance on the standing leg.
3. Return the kicking leg to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
d83d9707-23a5-4dd5-9cd9-e370eb1d1b24.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance during the kicks.
2. Avoid leaning back as you kick; keep your torso upright.
3. Exhale as you kick and inhale as you return to the starting position.
d83d9707-23a5-4dd5-9cd9-e370eb1d1b24.name: Crossed Arms Front Leg Kick

instructions: 1. Stand with a barbell secured in a landmine attachment and hold the end of the barbell with one hand at shoulder height.
2. Dip slightly at your knees and then explosively press the barbell overhead using your legs and shoulder.
3. Fully extend your arm at the top of the movement, keeping your core engaged.
4. Lower the barbell back to shoulder height with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching arms.
d8fccade-8419-4d35-94eb-cfea362f3128.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to stabilize your body throughout the movement.
2. Exhale as you press the barbell overhead and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid arching your back; maintain a neutral spine position.
d8fccade-8419-4d35-94eb-cfea362f3128.name: Landmine Single Arm Push Press

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
2. Hinge at your hips and lower the dumbbells towards the floor, keeping your back straight and knees slightly bent.
3. Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, ensuring your back remains flat.
4. Return to the starting position by driving your hips forward and standing upright. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
d99b8611-7b4e-4e63-911c-d8da77b4c9f2.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
2. Engage your core to support your lower back throughout the movement.
3. Exhale as you lift the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
d99b8611-7b4e-4e63-911c-d8da77b4c9f2.name: Dumbbell Straight Leg Deadlift

instructions: 1. Kneel on the floor with your knees hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Sit back onto your heels, keeping your torso upright and core engaged.
3. Press through your knees to return to the starting position, squeezing your glutes at the top.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
d9dbd572-4e9e-4c6b-afb4-545c6f1ad0ab.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain an upright torso throughout the exercise.
2. Avoid arching your back as you sit back and rise up.
3. Exhale as you rise to the starting position and inhale as you sit back.
d9dbd572-4e9e-4c6b-afb4-545c6f1ad0ab.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place a towel under one foot.
2. Slide the towel foot back and across behind your standing leg into a curtsy lunge position, bending both knees.
3. Push through the front foot to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
d9f32c28-1f0e-4a9c-832d-5c8b0cf01d9b.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to avoid excessive strain.
2. Engage your core to maintain balance during the slide.
3. Exhale as you return to the starting position and inhale as you lunge.
d9f32c28-1f0e-4a9c-832d-5c8b0cf01d9b.name: Curtsy Lunge Slide With Towel

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, hands on your hips or by your sides.
2. Step forward with one leg and lower your body into a lunge, keeping your front knee aligned with your toes.
3. Push through the front foot to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement on the same leg for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
da0fdefb-0243-4275-a13c-feffc13629db.tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and core engaged throughout the exercise.
2. Avoid letting your front knee extend past your toes.
3. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you lunge.
da0fdefb-0243-4275-a13c-feffc13629db.name: Lunges Same Leg Side View Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your feet in the foot cradles of the suspension trainer, knees bent, and arms by your sides.
2. Lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees, engaging your glutes and core.
3. Hold the elevated position, maintaining tension in your hips and core.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
daa866d3-c165-46a6-89eb-7b3bfa8db081.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Ensure your hips remain elevated and level throughout the exercise.
3. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
daa866d3-c165-46a6-89eb-7b3bfa8db081.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Hip Bridge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hands placed behind your head.
2. Hinge at your hips, lowering your torso towards the floor while keeping your back straight and knees slightly bent.
3. Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, ensuring your back remains flat.
4. Return to the starting position by driving your hips forward and standing upright. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
dabc00bf-8d9d-4252-9f9a-2dde0846323e.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
2. Engage your core to support your lower back throughout the movement.
3. Exhale as you rise to the starting position and inhale as you lower your torso.
dabc00bf-8d9d-4252-9f9a-2dde0846323e.name: Good Mornings

instructions: 1. Stand on an elevated surface with your heels hanging off the edge, holding onto a chair for support.
2. Lower your heels below the level of the surface to feel a stretch in your calves.
3. Raise your heels as high as possible, standing on the balls of your feet.
4. Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
dae8abbb-0e9b-4472-91a2-3138240c1858.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance throughout the exercise.
2. Avoid bouncing; perform the movement in a controlled manner.
3. Exhale as you raise your heels and inhale as you lower them.
dae8abbb-0e9b-4472-91a2-3138240c1858.name: Calf Raise From Deficit With Chair Supported

instructions: 1. Stand on a sturdy box or platform with a barbell resting across your upper back, feet hip-width apart.
2. Step back with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge until your left thigh is parallel to the ground.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position on the box.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
dc50eb68-7c96-4a63-b4ac-ef03a76234e3.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the movement.
2. Ensure the barbell is secure on your back to maintain balance.
3. Avoid letting your front knee extend past your toes during the lunge.
dc50eb68-7c96-4a63-b4ac-ef03a76234e3.name: Barbell Rear Lunge on Box

instructions: 1. Stand on the platform of the assisted pull-up machine and grasp the handles with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
2. Step onto the foot supports and allow the machine to assist you as you hang with arms fully extended.
3. Pull your body upward until your chin is above the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
4. Lower yourself back to the starting position with control, fully extending your arms.
dc5bf6b4-217b-4afe-8e88-55ec07c37f0a.tips:
1. Engage your core and upper back muscles to assist with the pull-up.
2. Exhale as you pull yourself up and inhale as you lower yourself down.
3. Avoid swinging your body or using momentum to complete the movement.
dc5bf6b4-217b-4afe-8e88-55ec07c37f0a.name: Assisted Close-Grip Underhand Chin-Up.mp4

instructions: 1. Attach a resistance band to a secure anchor point and lie face down on the floor with the band around your ankles.
2. Flex your knees, bringing your heels towards your glutes against the resistance of the band.
3. Squeeze your hamstrings at the top of the movement, then slowly extend your legs back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
dc9bb06d-4517-4097-9a1c-e23cf7067c5a.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent your lower back from arching.
2. Exhale as you curl your legs and inhale as you extend them.
3. Perform the movement with control to maximize hamstring activation.
dc9bb06d-4517-4097-9a1c-e23cf7067c5a.name: Resistance Band Leg Curl

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a weight plate against your chest.
2. Lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees, engaging your glutes and core.
3. Press the plate upwards, extending your arms fully while keeping your hips elevated.
4. Lower the plate back to your chest and then lower your hips to the starting position.
dd6f1651-bd28-401b-af49-deed17095f50.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to maintain stability throughout the exercise.
2. Exhale as you press the plate and inhale as you lower it.
3. Ensure your hips remain elevated during the chest press for maximum glute engagement.
dd6f1651-bd28-401b-af49-deed17095f50.name: Plate Glute Bridge to Chest Press

instructions: 1. Stand facing the cable machine, holding the handle with your right hand, and position your feet in a split stance with your left foot forward.
2. Lower your body into a squat by bending both knees, keeping your torso upright and the cable taut.
3. Push through your front heel to return to the standing position, maintaining tension in the cable.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
ddd532d1-9256-4abc-8c5e-ef1da9943c98.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to stabilize your body during the movement.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes as you squat.
3. Maintain a firm grip on the handle to control the cable tension.
ddd532d1-9256-4abc-8c5e-ef1da9943c98.name: Cable Split Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball at chest level with both hands.
2. Lower into a squat, keeping your chest up and back straight, until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
3. As you rise from the squat, extend your arms to raise the medicine ball overhead.
4. Lower the ball back to chest level as you return to the squat position.
de38b128-9422-4d0d-a61a-4bd9f7599461.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back during the squat.
2. Exhale as you raise the medicine ball and inhale as you lower it.
3. Avoid letting your knees cave inward as you squat.
de38b128-9422-4d0d-a61a-4bd9f7599461.name: Med Ball Front Squat Raise

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet together, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step to the side with your right foot, lowering your body into a side lunge by bending your right knee while keeping your left leg straight.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement on the left side, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
dec5a047-7c9e-41fc-a52e-440c52c272cf.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the exercise.
2. Ensure your lunging knee does not extend past your toes.
3. Engage your core to maintain balance and stability.
dec5a047-7c9e-41fc-a52e-440c52c272cf.name: Dumbbell Side Lunge Alternating

instructions: 1. Sit on the pec deck fly machine with your back against the pad and feet flat on the floor.
2. Grasp the handles with your elbows slightly bent, keeping your arms parallel to the floor.
3. Bring the handles together in front of your chest by contracting your chest muscles.
4. Slowly return to the starting position, allowing your chest to stretch.
deef21f9-c810-427f-8f5c-29da1fd40971.tips:
1. Keep your shoulders down and back to avoid unnecessary strain.
2. Exhale as you bring the handles together and inhale as you return to the starting position.
3. Avoid locking your elbows to maintain tension on the chest muscles.
deef21f9-c810-427f-8f5c-29da1fd40971.name: Pec Deck Fly Machine Flies

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, with a barbell on the floor in front of you.
2. Bend at your hips and knees to grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, keeping your back straight and chest up.
3. Lift the barbell by extending your hips and knees, standing up straight with the barbell in front of your thighs.
4. Lower the barbell back to the floor with control by bending at your hips and knees.
df16084d-b274-41e9-9b61-aa48fe87d444.tips:
1. Keep the barbell close to your body throughout the lift.
2. Engage your core to protect your lower back.
3. Avoid rounding your back to prevent injury.
df16084d-b274-41e9-9b61-aa48fe87d444.name: Barbell Deadlift

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended overhead with palms facing forward.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your arms straight and overhead.
3. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the ground, maintaining an upright torso.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position, keeping your arms overhead.
df95efb4-39e9-482a-af8c-0dafbbff85cc.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and support your lower back.
2. Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes during the squat.
3. Avoid letting your arms drop forward as you lower into the squat.
df95efb4-39e9-482a-af8c-0dafbbff85cc.name: Bodyweight Overhead Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
2. Keep your elbows close to your body and curl the barbell towards your shoulders by contracting your biceps.
3. Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
df9ef399-4a42-4bc9-89a9-6d4835502aea.tips:
1. Keep your upper arms stationary and avoid swinging the barbell.
2. Exhale as you curl the barbell up and inhale as you lower it.
3. Maintain a firm grip on the barbell to ensure control throughout the exercise.
df9ef399-4a42-4bc9-89a9-6d4835502aea.name: Barbell Biceps Curl Normal Grip

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate in each hand at your sides.
2. Raise the plates out to the sides until your arms are parallel to the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
3. Hold briefly at the top, then slowly lower the plates back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
e01b5c29-24cd-48f5-bec9-c306ffcd6dec.tips:
1. Keep your shoulders down and back to avoid unnecessary strain.
2. Exhale as you lift the plates and inhale as you lower them.
3. Avoid using momentum to lift the plates; focus on controlled movements.
e01b5c29-24cd-48f5-bec9-c306ffcd6dec.name: Plate Lateral Raise

instructions: 1. Sit on the edge of a bench with a dumbbell resting on your lap and your upper back against the bench.
2. Extend one leg out in front of you and plant the other foot firmly on the ground.
3. Drive through your planted heel to lift your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your extended leg parallel to the ground.
4. Lower your hips back down with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
e0281446-b48e-4e1c-8d9c-9e81a5a239f5.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure your shoulders remain on the bench throughout the movement.
e0281446-b48e-4e1c-8d9c-9e81a5a239f5.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Hip Thrust

instructions: 1. Begin in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and feet hip-width apart.
2. Lift your right hand off the ground and tap your left shoulder, keeping your hips stable.
3. Return your right hand to the ground and repeat the movement with your left hand tapping your right shoulder.
4. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
e069004d-c6ce-4bff-b997-b03247c24b60.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to prevent your hips from swaying side to side.
2. Maintain a straight line from your head to your heels throughout the exercise.
3. Avoid letting your hips drop or rise; keep them level with your shoulders.
e069004d-c6ce-4bff-b997-b03247c24b60.name: Shoulder Tap

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, near a wall or sturdy surface for balance if needed.
2. Rise onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels as high as possible while keeping your knees straight.
3. Hold briefly at the top, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
e09349d3-834b-4d63-a32e-6687db7d5025.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance throughout the movement.
2. Exhale as you lift your heels and inhale as you lower them.
3. Avoid rocking forward or backward; focus on a straight vertical lift.
e09349d3-834b-4d63-a32e-6687db7d5025.name: Bodyweight Calf Raises

instructions: 1. Sit on a sturdy chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
2. Extend one leg out in front of you, keeping your foot flexed and your thigh parallel to the floor.
3. Hold the extended position briefly, squeezing your quadriceps.
4. Lower your leg back to the starting position and repeat with the other leg.
e1cfe79e-6e41-4dab-a137-d981aeaa251e.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid leaning backward during the exercise.
2. Exhale as you extend your leg and inhale as you lower it back down.
3. Focus on controlled movements to maximize quadriceps engagement.
e1cfe79e-6e41-4dab-a137-d981aeaa251e.name: Lever Leg Extension

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with one foot elevated on a bench or step and the other foot flat on the floor. Position a barbell across your hips, holding it securely with both hands.
2. Engage your core and glutes, then lift your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your elevated foot stable.
3. At the top of the movement, your body should form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
e1e4b51d-0f58-4f0b-8b5e-8d0ca3f207c2.tips:
1. Ensure the barbell is balanced and secure on your hips to prevent it from rolling.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability.
e1e4b51d-0f58-4f0b-8b5e-8d0ca3f207c2.name: Barbell Feet Elevated Single Leg Glute Bridge

instructions: 1. Stand on a rebounder with feet together, arms at your sides.
2. Jump your feet out to the sides while raising your arms overhead, similar to a jumping jack.
3. Quickly jump your feet back together while lowering your arms to the starting position.
4. Continue the in-and-out jumping motion for the desired duration or repetitions.
e1f053d1-3937-428c-aa3b-c506709f99db.tips:
1. Maintain a slight bend in your knees to absorb the impact and protect your joints.
2. Keep your core engaged to help with balance and stability.
3. Land softly on the balls of your feet to reduce stress on your ankles and knees.
e1f053d1-3937-428c-aa3b-c506709f99db.name: Rebounder in & Out Jacks

instructions: 1. Stand facing a wall with your hands placed against it at shoulder height, arms extended.
2. Step one foot back, keeping it flat on the ground, and bend your front knee to stretch the calf of the back leg.
3. Hold the stretch for a moment, feeling the tension in your calf muscle.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat with the other leg.
e2296b3e-8900-4317-8bf1-4f66e9de39cb.tips:
1. Keep your back leg straight and heel on the ground to maximize the stretch.
2. Avoid arching your back; maintain a neutral spine.
3. Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch to enhance relaxation.
e2296b3e-8900-4317-8bf1-4f66e9de39cb.name: Calf Push Stretch With Hands Against Wall V.2

instructions: 1. Stand at the start of an agility ladder with your feet together.
2. Step into the first square with both feet, then quickly step out to the sides with both feet.
3. Lift your knees high as you move in and out of each square, maintaining a quick pace.
4. Continue the in-in-out-out pattern down the length of the ladder.
e2a16953-5e44-41fb-b0b3-8d218b216446.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and coordination.
2. Use your arms to help drive the movement and maintain speed.
3. Focus on quick, light footwork to improve agility and coordination.
e2a16953-5e44-41fb-b0b3-8d218b216446.name: Agility Ladder in in Out Out With Knee Lift

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
3. As you return to standing, press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
4. Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height as you descend into the next squat.
e2b8172d-90a0-4282-8be5-ed778634133c.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to avoid undue stress on the joints.
2. Exhale as you press the dumbbells overhead and inhale as you lower them.
3. Maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise to protect your lower back.
e2b8172d-90a0-4282-8be5-ed778634133c.name: Dumbbell Press Squat

instructions: 1. Sit on the edge of a bench with your upper back resting against it, feet flat on the floor, and a dumbbell placed on your lap.
2. Slide one foot slightly forward to create a staggered stance, keeping the other foot firmly planted.
3. Engage your core and glutes, then lift your hips towards the ceiling, pressing through your heels.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
e3269be0-9e31-43cd-b94c-de95e4a336f3.tips:
1. Ensure the dumbbell is stable on your lap to prevent it from rolling off.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
e3269be0-9e31-43cd-b94c-de95e4a336f3.name: Dumbbell Staggered Hip Thrust

instructions: 1. Begin in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
2. Lift one leg off the ground, keeping it straight and in line with your body.
3. Hold briefly, then lower the leg back to the starting position.
4. Alternate legs, repeating the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
e35efc00-93dc-495d-bcda-cd5ceeb02d9d.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to prevent your hips from sagging or rotating.
2. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise to maintain focus and endurance.
3. Avoid arching your back; maintain a neutral spine to protect your lower back.
e35efc00-93dc-495d-bcda-cd5ceeb02d9d.name: Alternate Single Leg Raise Plank

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands at chest level.
2. Step one leg back and across your body into a curtsy lunge, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
3. Lower your hips until your front thigh is parallel to the floor, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement with the opposite leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
e43257b7-071b-40a8-98d7-8d08b1bfe5ab.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
2. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you lower into the lunge.
3. Maintain an upright posture to engage your core and support your lower back.
e43257b7-071b-40a8-98d7-8d08b1bfe5ab.name: Dumbbell Goblet Curtsy Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands at chest level.
2. Step one leg back and across your body into a curtsy lunge, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
3. Lower your hips until your front thigh is parallel to the floor, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement with the opposite leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
e46f8a20-4b13-43a5-8b46-fce1d002ce7f.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to prevent injury.
2. Exhale as you return to the starting position and inhale as you lower into the lunge.
3. Maintain an upright posture to engage your core and support your lower back.
e46f8a20-4b13-43a5-8b46-fce1d002ce7f.name: Plate Curtsy Lunge

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a bench and position a Smith machine barbell across your hips.
2. Plant your feet flat on the ground, shoulder-width apart, and engage your core and glutes.
3. Press through your heels to lift your hips towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
e472eb98-9141-485b-98ee-64003e97e794.tips:
1. Ensure the barbell is securely positioned on your hips to prevent it from rolling.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
e472eb98-9141-485b-98ee-64003e97e794.name: Hip-Thrust in Smith Machine

instructions: 1. Lie on your back on a flat surface with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
2. Place your hands behind your head for support, keeping your elbows wide.
3. Engage your neck muscles to lift your head and shoulders slightly off the ground, curling your neck forward.
4. Lower your head back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
e4a6d93c-32ed-4f52-a155-f16864b916f5.tips:
1. Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; use them only for support.
2. Exhale as you curl your neck forward and inhale as you lower it back down.
3. Keep the movement slow and controlled to prevent strain on the neck muscles.
e4a6d93c-32ed-4f52-a155-f16864b916f5.name: Lying Neck Curls

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell with both hands at chest level.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
3. Push through your heels to return to the standing position, maintaining the kettlebell at chest level.
4. Repeat the squat movement for the desired number of repetitions.
e4bc60dd-a374-44f2-b112-23f22e08a071.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to avoid undue stress on the joints.
2. Exhale as you stand up and inhale as you lower into the squat.
3. Maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise to protect your lower back.
e4bc60dd-a374-44f2-b112-23f22e08a071.name: Goblet Kettlebell Squats

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Step forward with one leg into a lunge, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees.
3. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
4. Alternate legs, repeating the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
e53d873a-3344-41fb-89da-6f4316c9e903.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to prevent injury.
2. Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you lower into the lunge.
3. Maintain an upright posture to engage your core and support your lower back.
e53d873a-3344-41fb-89da-6f4316c9e903.name: Barbell Lunges on the Spot

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart in front of a bench, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back until you lightly touch the bench with your glutes.
3. Push through your heels to return to the standing position, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
4. Repeat the squat movement for the desired number of repetitions.
e596cade-26c8-443b-8808-c748bb9ca252.tips:
1. Ensure the bench is positioned at a height that allows for a natural squat depth.
2. Exhale as you stand up and inhale as you lower into the squat.
3. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to avoid undue stress on the joints.
e596cade-26c8-443b-8808-c748bb9ca252.name: Barbell Bench Squats

instructions: 1. Stand with your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart and a few inches away from the wall.
2. Slide down the wall by bending your knees until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your back flat against the wall.
3. Hold this position for a brief pause, engaging your quadriceps and core.
4. Push through your heels to slide back up the wall to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
e5e45e37-fa6d-4bb5-b608-91b2b90e707f.tips:
1. Keep your knees aligned with your toes to avoid unnecessary strain.
2. Maintain a flat back against the wall throughout the exercise.
3. Breathe steadily, exhaling as you slide down and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
e5e45e37-fa6d-4bb5-b608-91b2b90e707f.name: Wall Squat With Pause Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Stand upright with a dumbbell in each hand, feet together.
2. Step to the side with your left foot, bending your left knee and keeping your right leg straight as you lower your hips.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement on the right side. Alternate sides for the desired number of repetitions.
e6242277-ca64-4287-b19d-5655c4eb6cea.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement.
2. Ensure your knee does not extend past your toes during the lunge.
3. Inhale as you step out and exhale as you push back to the starting position.
e6242277-ca64-4287-b19d-5655c4eb6cea.name: Dumbbell Side Lunge Left N Right

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Step one foot back into a split stance, lowering your hips until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
3. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
e74b77fc-d7db-4040-865b-dce5cdcc0db7.tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and core engaged throughout the exercise.
2. Ensure your front knee stays aligned with your toes.
3. Breathe in as you lower and exhale as you push back up.
e74b77fc-d7db-4040-865b-dce5cdcc0db7.name: Barbell Single Leg Split Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
3. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor or as far as your flexibility allows.
4. Push through your heels to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
e751f2c6-da99-4ac9-8cf6-2225128347c5.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not cave inward.
3. Inhale as you lower and exhale as you rise.
e751f2c6-da99-4ac9-8cf6-2225128347c5.name: Barbell Full Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the end of a barbell secured in a landmine attachment with both hands.
2. Step to the side with your left foot, bending your left knee and keeping your right leg straight as you lower your hips.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement on the right side. Alternate sides for the desired number of repetitions.
e77c893e-51c1-4a06-a663-8982d2f9212a.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement.
2. Ensure your knee does not extend past your toes during the lunge.
3. Inhale as you step out and exhale as you push back to the starting position.
e77c893e-51c1-4a06-a663-8982d2f9212a.name: Landmine Lateral Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate against your chest with both hands.
2. Hinge at your hips, keeping your back straight and knees slightly bent, lowering your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor.
3. Engage your hamstrings and glutes to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
e8af0468-285c-4b68-b73e-67509e060148.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain a neutral spine.
2. Avoid rounding your back as you hinge forward.
3. Inhale as you lower and exhale as you return to the starting position.
e8af0468-285c-4b68-b73e-67509e060148.name: Plate Good Morning Anterior

instructions: 1. Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat on the floor in front of you, holding the end of a barbell in a landmine attachment with one hand.
2. Press the barbell overhead, extending your arm fully while keeping your core engaged.
3. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching arms.
e90f10e1-9867-4b3e-8ad3-368d1d324024.tips:
