1. Keep your core tight to stabilize your torso during the press.
2. Avoid arching your back as you press the barbell overhead.
3. Exhale as you press up and inhale as you lower the barbell.
e90f10e1-9867-4b3e-8ad3-368d1d324024.name: Landmine Half Kneeling Single Arm Overhead Press

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands at arm's length in front of you.
2. Rotate the plate to the left as if steering a car, keeping your arms extended.
3. Rotate the plate to the right, maintaining control and tension in your shoulders.
4. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
e91726b6-b48d-44e7-a55d-e27986e5e2df.tips:
1. Keep your shoulders down and relaxed to avoid unnecessary tension.
2. Engage your core to stabilize your torso during the movement.
3. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, maintaining control.
e91726b6-b48d-44e7-a55d-e27986e5e2df.name: Plate Car Driver

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, hands on your hips or in front of you for balance.
2. Step your right foot behind and across your left leg, bending both knees to lower your hips into a lunge.
3. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement on the opposite side. Alternate sides for the desired number of repetitions.
e932f2a6-be99-429d-98de-7f3dcd01107f.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement.
2. Ensure your front knee stays aligned with your toes.
3. Inhale as you lower and exhale as you return to the starting position.
e932f2a6-be99-429d-98de-7f3dcd01107f.name: Curtsy Lunge Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Place a resistance band around your legs just above your knees and stand with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Bend your knees slightly and lower your hips into a half-squat position.
3. Step to the side with your left foot, followed by your right foot, keeping tension on the band.
4. Continue stepping sideways for the desired number of repetitions, then switch directions.
e934ad6d-b76c-4d3d-acd3-55c26f8586f1.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged and back straight to maintain stability.
2. Ensure constant tension on the band to maximize muscle activation.
3. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, maintaining control.
e934ad6d-b76c-4d3d-acd3-55c26f8586f1.name: Lateral Band Walks

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, sitting back onto the bench.
3. Pause briefly as you touch the bench, then push through your heels to stand back up.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
e9b231a8-c67c-4553-88ee-38b45d18d566.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement.
2. Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not cave inward.
3. Inhale as you lower and exhale as you stand back up.
e9b231a8-c67c-4553-88ee-38b45d18d566.name: Dumbbell Bench Squat

instructions: 1. Sit on a leg press machine and place one foot on the platform with your heel hanging off the edge.
2. Push the platform away by extending your ankle, lifting your heel as high as possible.
3. Lower your heel back down below the platform level with control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
e9b3c3a3-f6c4-4d1b-9970-74f33e678e02.tips:
1. Keep your knee slightly bent to avoid locking it during the movement.
2. Focus on using your calf muscles to lift and lower your heel.
3. Exhale as you press up and inhale as you lower your heel.
e9b3c3a3-f6c4-4d1b-9970-74f33e678e02.name: Single Leg Calf Raise Leg Press Machine

instructions: 1. Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
2. Lower your body into a squat on the standing leg, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Push through your heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
ea72931b-1cb7-45ca-add7-b722514e0f80.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Ensure your knee stays aligned with your toes during the squat.
3. Inhale as you lower and exhale as you return to the starting position.
ea72931b-1cb7-45ca-add7-b722514e0f80.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Squat With Support (Pistol)

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a sturdy box or platform with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Lower into a squat position, then explosively jump onto the box, landing softly with both feet.
3. Stand up fully on the box, then step or jump back down to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
eab7928d-9459-47e8-8bf0-f72df8a673f8.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged and back straight throughout the movement.
2. Land softly on the box to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Exhale as you jump and inhale as you return to the starting position.
eab7928d-9459-47e8-8bf0-f72df8a673f8.name: Box Jump Squats

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Step back with one foot, lowering your hips until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
3. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
eac7146c-d447-43be-a371-6903a6612737.tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and core engaged throughout the exercise.
2. Ensure your front knee stays aligned with your toes.
3. Inhale as you lower and exhale as you push back up.
eac7146c-d447-43be-a371-6903a6612737.name: Barbell Rear Lunges

instructions: 1. Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell overhead with both hands, arms fully extended.
2. Step forward with your right foot into a lunge position, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at about a 90-degree angle.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement with your left leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
eac8dcb8-4667-401f-8b6a-c71e07d4bc43.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
3. Maintain a neutral spine and avoid arching your back.
eac8dcb8-4667-401f-8b6a-c71e07d4bc43.name: Barbell Overhead Lunges

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a plate in each hand with your arms hanging down in front of you, palms facing each other.
2. Bend slightly at the hips and knees, keeping your back straight and chest up.
3. Raise the plates outward and upward to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in your elbows and internally rotating your shoulders.
4. Slowly lower the plates back to the starting position with control.
eadc0301-40a5-4e57-b924-2be8d7ed987b.tips:
1. Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
2. Keep your core engaged to avoid swinging your body.
3. Exhale as you lift the plates and inhale as you lower them.
eadc0301-40a5-4e57-b924-2be8d7ed987b.name: Plate Internally Rotated Rear Delt Fly

instructions: 1. Stand facing a wall, about an arm's length away, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height and walk your feet back slightly, hinging at the hips to lean forward.
3. Lower your chest towards the floor while keeping your arms straight, feeling a stretch along your lats and back.
4. Hold the stretch for the desired duration, then slowly return to the starting position.
eafb028f-6032-4034-9508-f1ff97d7543c.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
2. Breathe deeply and relax into the stretch to enhance flexibility.
3. Ensure your feet remain flat on the floor for stability.
eafb028f-6032-4034-9508-f1ff97d7543c.name: Lats Stretch on Wall

instructions: 1. Stand on the edge of a step or platform with the balls of your feet, allowing your heels to hang off the edge.
2. Keep your legs straight and your core engaged as you raise your heels as high as possible, standing on your toes.
3. Slowly lower your heels back down below the level of the step to feel a stretch in your calves.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
eb310391-3cb5-4f3e-b449-f08e0bc2a7f3.tips:
1. Maintain a slow and controlled motion to maximize calf engagement.
2. Avoid bouncing at the bottom of the movement to prevent strain.
3. Keep your core tight to maintain balance and stability.
eb310391-3cb5-4f3e-b449-f08e0bc2a7f3.name: Elevated Standing Calf Raise

instructions: 1. Lie face down on the floor with your legs extended and arms at your sides.
2. Bend your knees and bring your heels towards your glutes, keeping your thighs on the ground.
3. Squeeze your hamstrings at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your feet back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
ebcb671b-bda2-448d-9bcc-7f13a5705377.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Avoid lifting your thighs off the ground to maintain proper form.
3. Perform the movement slowly to enhance hamstring activation.
ebcb671b-bda2-448d-9bcc-7f13a5705377.name: Bodyweight Lying Leg Curl

instructions: 1. Attach an ankle strap to a low cable pulley and secure it around your ankle.
2. Stand facing the machine, holding onto it for support, with your feet hip-width apart.
3. Bend your knee to curl your heel towards your glutes, keeping your thigh stationary.
4. Slowly extend your leg back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
ec90e850-59a4-4bd8-967d-34dc5022362a.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Avoid swinging your leg to ensure controlled movement.
3. Exhale as you curl your leg and inhale as you extend it back.
ec90e850-59a4-4bd8-967d-34dc5022362a.name: Cable Hamstring Curl

instructions: 1. Lie face down on a bench with your head hanging off the edge and your arms at your sides.
2. Keep your neck in a neutral position and slowly lift your head upwards, extending your neck.
3. Hold the position briefly, then slowly lower your head back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
ecff3a5a-fdb5-48fe-8f82-da87db3ad53f.tips:
1. Keep your movements slow and controlled to avoid strain on the neck.
2. Maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on the muscles in your neck.
ecff3a5a-fdb5-48fe-8f82-da87db3ad53f.name: Lying Neck Extension

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the end of a barbell secured in a landmine attachment with both hands at chest level.
2. Step your right leg behind your left leg into a curtsy lunge, lowering your hips until your left thigh is parallel to the floor.
3. Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement with your left leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
ed8e5059-282a-45fa-ac97-eed191c569e8.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to protect your joints.
3. Maintain a steady pace and controlled movement throughout the exercise.
ed8e5059-282a-45fa-ac97-eed191c569e8.name: Landmine Curtsy Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a plate with both hands in front of your thighs, arms fully extended.
2. Keeping your arms straight, raise the plate in front of you until it reaches shoulder height.
3. Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower the plate back to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
ed966933-57fc-41d7-973f-de4a0f279f71.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent leaning back.
2. Avoid locking your elbows; maintain a slight bend.
3. Exhale as you lift the plate and inhale as you lower it.
ed966933-57fc-41d7-973f-de4a0f279f71.name: Plate Full Front Raise

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip, arms fully extended.
2. Bend at the hips and knees to lower the barbell to just above your knees, keeping your back straight and chest up.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees to pull the barbell up, shrugging your shoulders and catching the barbell in a front rack position at shoulder height.
4. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
ede0541b-87b5-40c2-a780-c75fab1d26c6.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to protect your lower back.
2. Use your legs and hips to generate power, not just your arms.
3. Ensure a firm grip on the barbell to maintain control throughout the movement.
ede0541b-87b5-40c2-a780-c75fab1d26c6.name: Barbell Hang Clean

instructions: 1. Stand at the beginning of an agility ladder with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Hop forward with both feet into the first square, landing softly on the balls of your feet.
3. Continue hopping forward through each square, maintaining a quick and controlled pace.
4. Repeat the sequence for the desired number of repetitions or time.
ee3fdf42-d624-4f61-ad03-975d6876ae0c.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control.
2. Land softly to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Focus on quick footwork and precise movements to enhance agility.
ee3fdf42-d624-4f61-ad03-975d6876ae0c.name: Agility Ladder Advanced Hop Position

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a rebounder with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Bend your knees slightly and place your hands on the rebounder for support.
3. Push your knees forward to bounce lightly off the rebounder, maintaining a controlled motion.
4. Repeat the knee pushes for the desired number of repetitions or time.
f0587d92-7e0b-4661-a134-9ad20bafa5e2.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
2. Avoid locking your knees to prevent strain.
3. Use a controlled motion to ensure safety and effectiveness.
f0587d92-7e0b-4661-a134-9ad20bafa5e2.name: Rebounder Knee Pushes

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your back straight, legs bent, and feet flat on the ground, placing a resistance band around your thighs just above your knees.
2. Keep your feet together and open your knees outward against the resistance of the band.
3. Hold the position briefly, then slowly bring your knees back together to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
f198d05c-38b1-4b7e-827f-f66be09fd269.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
2. Avoid letting the band snap back; control the movement.
3. Focus on squeezing your glutes as you open your knees.
f198d05c-38b1-4b7e-827f-f66be09fd269.name: Resistance Band Seated Bent Knee Abduction

instructions: 1. Lie face down on a bench with your chest supported and feet firmly on the ground, holding a barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing down).
2. Pull the barbell towards your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades together, keeping your elbows close to your body.
3. Pause briefly at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
f26033ba-aac2-4038-9478-25cb826ee437.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability on the bench.
2. Avoid using momentum; focus on controlled movements.
3. Exhale as you pull the barbell up and inhale as you lower it.
f26033ba-aac2-4038-9478-25cb826ee437.name: Prone Bench Row Barbell Pronated Grip

instructions: 1. Stand in front of a rebounder with your feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent.
2. Jump onto the rebounder, landing softly on the balls of your feet with your knees slightly bent.
3. Immediately jump off the rebounder, landing back on the ground in the starting position.
4. Repeat the jumps for the desired number of repetitions or time.
f2ac6a6d-2d18-4562-b34a-1064df5eb9f3.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control.
2. Land softly to reduce impact on your joints.
3. Use your arms to help generate momentum for the jumps.
f2ac6a6d-2d18-4562-b34a-1064df5eb9f3.name: Rebounder Knee Jumps

instructions: 1. Stand facing a wall, about an arm's length away, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Place your elbows on the wall at shoulder height, keeping your forearms parallel to each other.
3. Lean your torso forward, allowing your chest to move towards the wall, feeling a stretch in your lats and shoulders.
4. Hold the stretch for the desired duration, then slowly return to the starting position.
f2da291f-0db7-44a8-9f70-dc58e6bf971d.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back during the stretch.
2. Avoid arching your back excessively as you lean forward.
3. Breathe deeply and evenly throughout the stretch to enhance relaxation.
f2da291f-0db7-44a8-9f70-dc58e6bf971d.name: Lats Stretch Elbow on Wall

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended by your sides.
2. Curl the right dumbbell towards your shoulder while keeping your elbow close to your body.
3. Lower the right dumbbell back to the starting position with control, then curl the left dumbbell towards your shoulder.
4. Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
f3630c8c-e91f-4cba-b080-38a76b4a299f.tips:
1. Keep your upper arms stationary and avoid swinging them during the curls.
2. Exhale as you curl the dumbbell upwards and inhale as you lower it back down.
3. Maintain a slight bend in your knees to support your lower back.
f3630c8c-e91f-4cba-b080-38a76b4a299f.name: Alternate Biceps Curl Standing Dumbbells

instructions: 1. Stand beside a sturdy box or platform with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Bend your knees slightly and jump laterally onto the box, landing softly with both feet.
3. Step or jump down to the starting side and immediately repeat the jump to the opposite side.
4. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
f3f63ca1-86b7-49a1-a537-bae165e87b32.tips:
1. Focus on landing softly to minimize impact on your joints.
2. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance during the jumps.
3. Use your arms to help generate momentum and control your movement.
f3f63ca1-86b7-49a1-a537-bae165e87b32.name: Lateral Box Jump

instructions: 1. Stand with a kettlebell in your right hand, feet hip-width apart, and shift your weight onto your left leg.
2. Hinge at the hips, extending your right leg straight behind you while lowering the kettlebell towards the floor.
3. Keep your back straight and your left knee slightly bent as you lower the kettlebell.
4. Return to the starting position by driving through your left heel and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
f4157591-8d34-4da5-ab0c-344adb1de1cb.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control throughout the movement.
2. Avoid rounding your back as you lower the kettlebell.
3. Focus on a slow and controlled movement to enhance stability and muscle engagement.
f4157591-8d34-4da5-ab0c-344adb1de1cb.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Romanian Deadlifts

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you and your feet together.
2. Reach forward with both hands, aiming to touch your toes while keeping your back straight.
3. Hold the stretch at the point of mild discomfort, ensuring your knees remain slightly bent if necessary.
4. Maintain the stretch for the desired duration, then slowly return to the starting position.
f43d0031-5666-4da3-bb44-ed6bbfb47f5d.tips:
1. Avoid bouncing or jerking movements to reach further into the stretch.
2. Breathe deeply and evenly to help relax your muscles.
3. Focus on keeping your back straight to prevent strain.
f43d0031-5666-4da3-bb44-ed6bbfb47f5d.name: Seated Toe Touch Hamstrings Stretch

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper chest with an overhand grip.
2. Dip your knees slightly and then explosively drive the barbell overhead while splitting your legs into a lunge position.
3. Lock out your arms overhead, ensuring your front knee is directly above your ankle.
4. Return to the starting position by bringing your feet back together and lowering the barbell to your chest.
f467ada1-a43a-4217-bb10-4380e722e162.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Exhale as you drive the barbell overhead and inhale as you return to the starting position.
3. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to avoid strain.
f467ada1-a43a-4217-bb10-4380e722e162.name: Barbell Split Jerk

instructions: 1. Stand beside a box or platform with a barbell resting across your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Step laterally onto the box with your right foot, driving through your heel to lift your body up.
3. Bring your left foot up to meet your right, standing fully on the box.
4. Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
f5831024-fde5-4c59-90f0-0a9c2f766bfe.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control during the movement.
2. Ensure the barbell is securely positioned on your upper back to avoid strain.
3. Focus on a controlled step to minimize impact on your joints.
f5831024-fde5-4c59-90f0-0a9c2f766bfe.name: Barbell Side Step Up

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing away from the anchor point of a resistance band secured at hip height.
2. Hold the ends of the band between your legs with both hands, keeping your arms straight.
3. Hinge at the hips, pushing your glutes back while maintaining a straight back and slight bend in your knees.
4. Return to the starting position by driving your hips forward and squeezing your glutes, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
f5b63d1c-f5ab-4a2b-9dd8-70f066ba45a2.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back throughout the exercise.
2. Avoid rounding your back as you hinge at the hips.
3. Focus on a slow and controlled movement to maximize muscle engagement.
f5b63d1c-f5ab-4a2b-9dd8-70f066ba45a2.name: Band Pullthrough

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended in front of you at shoulder height.
2. Pull your shoulder blades together and down, retracting your scapulae without moving your arms.
3. Hold the retracted position for a moment, feeling the contraction in your upper back muscles.
4. Release the contraction and return to the starting position, repeating for the desired number of repetitions.
f68b5c55-e5ef-4595-a90e-7319bc09e246.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain posture and stability.
2. Focus on the movement of your shoulder blades rather than your arms.
3. Avoid shrugging your shoulders during the exercise.
f68b5c55-e5ef-4595-a90e-7319bc09e246.name: Theraband Scapula Retraction

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper chest with an overhand grip.
2. Perform a clean and jerk by explosively lifting the barbell overhead while splitting your legs into a lunge position.
3. Lower your back knee towards the ground, performing a split squat while keeping the barbell overhead.
4. Return to the starting position by bringing your feet back together and lowering the barbell to your chest.
f6ac18ec-58fd-4237-a517-b60c88534215.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Exhale as you lift the barbell overhead and inhale as you lower it back down.
3. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to avoid strain.
f6ac18ec-58fd-4237-a517-b60c88534215.name: Barbell Clean and Jerk Split Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands in front of your thighs.
2. Hinge at the hips, lowering the plate towards the floor while keeping your back straight and knees slightly bent.
3. Drive through your heels to return to the starting position, lifting the plate back to the front of your thighs.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
f717a83e-a020-4655-a132-d80d556cdd1b.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back throughout the exercise.
2. Avoid rounding your back as you lower the plate.
3. Focus on a slow and controlled movement to maximize muscle engagement.
f717a83e-a020-4655-a132-d80d556cdd1b.name: Plate Deadlift

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, toes under the barbell, and shins close to the bar.
2. Bend at the hips and knees to grip the barbell with an overhand or mixed grip, keeping your back straight.
3. Lift the barbell by extending your hips and knees, keeping the bar close to your body as you stand up straight.
4. Lower the barbell back to the ground with control, maintaining a straight back, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
f72649c6-f24c-4bf7-9173-83ccbb1197a4.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to support your lower back throughout the lift.
2. Exhale as you lift the barbell and inhale as you lower it back down.
3. Ensure your shoulders are over the bar and your back is straight before lifting.
f72649c6-f24c-4bf7-9173-83ccbb1197a4.name: Barbell Deadlift (Front Pov)

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
2. Cross your right ankle over your left knee, forming a figure-four position.
3. Use your left hand to gently pull your left knee towards your chest, feeling a stretch in your right glute.
4. Hold the stretch for the desired duration, then switch sides and repeat.
f7dc75bb-bb39-48e0-9ca8-c1b374695fe7.tips:
1. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor to avoid tension.
2. Breathe deeply and evenly to help relax your muscles during the stretch.
3. Avoid pulling too hard on your knee to prevent strain.
f7dc75bb-bb39-48e0-9ca8-c1b374695fe7.name: Lying Bent Knee Cross Glutes Stretch

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips or by your sides.
2. Step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge until your right thigh is parallel to the floor.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement with your left leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
f7e658af-3bcf-4f6c-95f3-9f30912fe794.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability.
2. Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to avoid strain.
3. Maintain an upright torso throughout the movement.
f7e658af-3bcf-4f6c-95f3-9f30912fe794.name: Bodyweight Forward Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands at chest level.
2. Step laterally to the right, bending your right knee while keeping your left leg straight, lowering your body into a lateral lunge.
3. Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement on the left side, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
f833bbb4-3b7a-4800-96d1-1b547d3c2798.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and control during the movement.
2. Ensure your bent knee does not extend past your toes to avoid strain.
3. Maintain an upright torso and avoid leaning forward excessively.
f833bbb4-3b7a-4800-96d1-1b547d3c2798.name: Plate Lateral Lunge

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip, elbows pointing forward.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Drive through your heels to stand up explosively, pressing the barbell overhead in one fluid motion.
4. Lower the barbell back to shoulder height as you return to the squat position and repeat.
f859018a-aa91-41cb-a259-42d7c5172cee.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the movement to maintain balance and control.
2. Exhale as you press the barbell overhead and inhale as you lower into the squat.
3. Avoid arching your back excessively when pressing the barbell overhead.
f859018a-aa91-41cb-a259-42d7c5172cee.name: Barbell Thruster

instructions: 1. Begin in a pike position with your hands and feet on the floor, hips elevated, and body forming an inverted V shape.
2. Shift your weight onto one arm and reach the opposite arm forward, keeping your core engaged.
3. Return the reaching arm to the starting position and switch to the other arm.
4. Continue alternating arm reaches for the desired number of repetitions.
f872e3be-f762-4308-937d-d11aa06d883f.tips:
1. Keep your core tight to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging.
2. Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you reach forward.
3. Avoid rotating your hips or shoulders excessively during the arm reach.
f872e3be-f762-4308-937d-d11aa06d883f.name: Pike Individual Alternating Arm Reaches

instructions: 1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips or by your sides.
2. Step forward with one leg, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees.
3. Pause briefly at the bottom of the lunge, ensuring your front knee is aligned with your ankle.
4. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position and alternate legs.
f879fd7c-a4d9-4963-97c9-d80fedef6ea5.tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Inhale as you step forward and exhale as you push back to the starting position.
3. Avoid letting your front knee extend past your toes to prevent strain on the knee joint.
f879fd7c-a4d9-4963-97c9-d80fedef6ea5.name: Lunges Alternate Leg With Pause Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Sit on the leg press machine with your back flat against the pad and feet placed shoulder-width apart on the platform.
2. Release the safety handles and extend your legs to push the platform away, without locking your knees.
3. Lower the platform by bending your knees until they form approximately a 90-degree angle.
4. Press through your heels to return to the starting position and repeat.
f895dc89-696a-4f08-8fb4-abda467f7477.tips:
1. Keep your feet flat on the platform to ensure even distribution of force.
2. Exhale as you press the platform away and inhale as you lower it back down.
3. Avoid locking your knees at the top of the movement to prevent joint strain.
f895dc89-696a-4f08-8fb4-abda467f7477.name: Leg Press Machine Normal Stance

instructions: 1. Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
2. Keeping your knee bent, lift one leg towards the ceiling, engaging your glutes.
3. Lower the leg back to the starting position with control, without touching the floor.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the other leg.
f8e18d4f-93d0-4ffe-b384-718495af35d5.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent arching your lower back.
2. Exhale as you lift your leg and inhale as you lower it back down.
3. Avoid swinging your leg; use controlled movements to maximize glute activation.
f8e18d4f-93d0-4ffe-b384-718495af35d5.name: Donkey Kicks Bodyweight

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate at chest level with both hands.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Drive through your heels to stand up explosively, pressing the plate overhead in one fluid motion.
4. Lower the plate back to chest level as you return to the squat position and repeat.
f8f5831a-3888-4716-8e1e-88e5feafb856.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the movement to maintain balance and control.
2. Exhale as you press the plate overhead and inhale as you lower into the squat.
3. Avoid arching your back excessively when pressing the plate overhead.
f8f5831a-3888-4716-8e1e-88e5feafb856.name: Plate Thruster

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart on the middle of a resistance band, holding the ends in each hand.
2. Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, keeping your knees straight and core engaged.
3. Pause briefly at the top of the movement, feeling the contraction in your calves.
4. Lower your heels back to the starting position with control and repeat.
fa006dee-5ede-4dc6-a622-04ca8e1d955b.tips:
1. Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize calf activation.
2. Exhale as you lift your heels and inhale as you lower them back down.
3. Ensure the resistance band is securely placed under your feet to prevent slipping.
fa006dee-5ede-4dc6-a622-04ca8e1d955b.name: Standing Calf Raise Resistance Band

instructions: 1. Stand facing a cable pulley machine, attach a handle to the low pulley, and hold it in one hand.
2. Shift your weight onto one leg, keeping a slight bend in the knee, and hinge at the hips to lower the handle towards the floor.
3. Engage your core and glutes to return to the upright position, keeping your back straight.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the other leg.
fa0659dc-892b-4016-a6d2-46829dd4c6af.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and prevent rounding your back.
2. Exhale as you return to the upright position and inhale as you lower the handle.
3. Avoid locking your standing knee to maintain stability and control.
fa0659dc-892b-4016-a6d2-46829dd4c6af.name: Cable Single Leg Deadlift

instructions: 1. Stand facing a cable pulley machine with a handle attached at knee height, holding the handle with both hands.
2. Sit back into a chair-like position, keeping your knees behind your toes and back straight.
3. Engage your quadriceps and glutes to stand up, pulling the handle towards your chest.
4. Lower back into the chair position with control and repeat.
fa605186-8c96-42a2-b057-d2e03b0b08b9.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Exhale as you stand up and inhale as you lower back down.
3. Avoid letting your knees extend past your toes to prevent strain on the knee joints.
fa605186-8c96-42a2-b057-d2e03b0b08b9.name: Cable Narrow Chair Stand-Up

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand by your sides.
2. With your arms straight, shrug your shoulders upwards towards your ears, squeezing your trapezius muscles.
3. Pause briefly at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your shoulders back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
faa0f2ec-51cd-4090-9d80-6db95ad8fee8.tips:
1. Keep your arms straight and avoid bending your elbows during the movement.
2. Exhale as you shrug your shoulders and inhale as you lower them back down.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on controlled movements to engage the trapezius effectively.
faa0f2ec-51cd-4090-9d80-6db95ad8fee8.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Shrugs

instructions: 1. Stand facing a cable pulley machine with an ankle strap attached to the low pulley and secured around one ankle.
2. Shift your weight onto the opposite leg and lift the strapped leg forward, keeping it straight.
3. Engage your hip flexors to lift the leg as high as comfortable, then lower it back to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the other leg.
fb0471ac-5741-49fa-8a33-311cf3a45f11.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and prevent leaning back.
2. Exhale as you lift your leg and inhale as you lower it back down.
3. Avoid swinging your leg; use controlled movements to target the hip flexors effectively.
fb0471ac-5741-49fa-8a33-311cf3a45f11.name: Standing Cable Hip Flexion

instructions: 1. Stand facing a wall, placing one hand on the wall at shoulder height for support.
2. Extend the opposite arm straight out to the side at shoulder height, palm facing forward.
3. Rotate your torso away from the wall to feel a stretch in the biceps and shoulder.
4. Hold the stretch for the desired duration, then switch to the other arm.
fb0f29dd-1ac9-48be-88df-a02e8bfe60cb.tips:
1. Keep your arm straight to maximize the stretch in the biceps.
2. Breathe deeply and relax into the stretch to enhance flexibility.
3. Avoid forcing the stretch; rotate only as far as comfortable to prevent strain.
fb0f29dd-1ac9-48be-88df-a02e8bfe60cb.name: Single Arm on Wall Side Biceps Stretch

instructions: 1. Stand on one leg, holding a kettlebell in the opposite hand with your arm extended down.
2. Hinge at the hips to lower the kettlebell towards the floor, keeping your back straight and the non-weight-bearing leg extended behind you.
3. Engage your core and glutes to return to the upright position, keeping the kettlebell close to your body.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the other leg.
fb73b3c7-1a03-420a-9aff-83553e2230c8.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and prevent rounding your back.
2. Exhale as you return to the upright position and inhale as you lower the kettlebell.
3. Avoid locking your standing knee to maintain stability and control.
fb73b3c7-1a03-420a-9aff-83553e2230c8.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a bench, feet flat on the ground, and a kettlebell placed on your hips.
2. Drive through your heels to lift your hips towards the ceiling, engaging your glutes and core.
3. Pause briefly at the top of the movement, ensuring your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat.
fb9e6943-fabe-4030-9524-d6995f8a5b66.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them back down.
3. Avoid arching your back excessively at the top of the movement to prevent strain.
fb9e6943-fabe-4030-9524-d6995f8a5b66.name: Kettlebell Hip Thrusts With Bench

instructions: 1. Stand facing a bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand by your sides.
2. Place one foot on the bench and step up, driving through your heel to lift your body onto the bench.
3. Bring your trailing leg up to stand fully on the bench, then step back down with control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the other leg.
fc105d4f-67ed-4035-8d19-5c2f05390996.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core engaged to maintain balance and control.
2. Exhale as you step up and inhale as you step down.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on controlled movements to engage the quadriceps effectively.
fc105d4f-67ed-4035-8d19-5c2f05390996.name: Dumbbell Step Up on Bench

instructions: 1. Begin by gripping the gymnastic rings firmly, with your arms fully extended and your body suspended off the ground.
2. Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your torso upright and your elbows close to your body until your shoulders are below your elbows.
3. Press through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
fc299697-859f-4bd7-b6fa-a6981177ca58.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability.
2. Avoid letting your elbows flare out to prevent shoulder strain.
3. Control the movement to avoid swinging and ensure proper form.
fc299697-859f-4bd7-b6fa-a6981177ca58.name: Ring Dips

instructions: 1. Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a bench, knees bent, and feet flat on the ground. Place a resistance band across your hips, securing it under your feet.
2. Engage your core and glutes, then thrust your hips upward until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
3. Hold the top position briefly, squeezing your glutes, then lower your hips back to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
fc996de3-49c5-418f-aaa1-0d687f0ab74a.tips:
1. Keep your chin tucked to maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise.
2. Exhale as you thrust your hips upward and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure the resistance band is securely positioned to prevent it from slipping.
fc996de3-49c5-418f-aaa1-0d687f0ab74a.name: Resistance Band Hip Thrust (Version 2)

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, stepping on the middle of a resistance band, and hold the ends of the band with both hands at shoulder height.
2. With a slight bend in your knees, hinge at your hips to lower your torso forward, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
3. Lower until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, then return to the starting position by extending your hips and standing upright.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
fcfbf1ff-81c0-47c0-ae95-ef6998804452.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders during the movement.
2. Engage your core to protect your lower back.
3. Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize hamstring engagement.
fcfbf1ff-81c0-47c0-ae95-ef6998804452.name: Good Mornings Resistance Band

instructions: 1. Sit on a horizontal leg press machine, placing your feet on the platform with your toes pointing forward and heels slightly off the edge.
2. Extend your legs to press the platform away, keeping a slight bend in your knees.
3. Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible, engaging your calves.
4. Lower your heels back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
fd434fd9-5b0d-468c-b422-843239c956db.tips:
1. Keep your movements controlled to avoid bouncing and ensure full calf engagement.
2. Exhale as you raise your heels and inhale as you lower them.
3. Avoid locking your knees at the top of the leg press to maintain tension on the calves.
fd434fd9-5b0d-468c-b422-843239c956db.name: Horizontal Leg Press Calf Raise

instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with one foot flat on the floor and the other foot elevated on your toes, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a hammer grip.
2. Place the dumbbell on the knee of the elevated leg, keeping your core engaged and back straight.
3. Raise your heel as high as possible by pushing through the ball of your foot, engaging your calf muscle.
4. Lower your heel back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
fd77ef8d-7986-41e2-bb32-048ebf2540b6.tips:
1. Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize calf engagement.
2. Exhale as you lift your heel and inhale as you lower it.
3. Ensure your upper body remains stable and avoid using momentum to lift the weight.
fd77ef8d-7986-41e2-bb32-048ebf2540b6.name: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise Hammer Grip

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Shift your weight to one leg, bending the knee and lowering your hips into a side lunge while keeping the other leg straight.
3. Push through the heel of the bent leg to return to the starting position, maintaining an upright torso.
4. Repeat the movement on the opposite side and continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
fde2dfc6-19ab-448e-92db-4ddeac965209.tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the exercise.
2. Engage your core to maintain balance and stability.
3. Avoid letting your knees extend beyond your toes to protect your joints.
fde2dfc6-19ab-448e-92db-4ddeac965209.name: Barbell Side Split Squat

instructions: 1. Stand with your feet close together, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended by your sides.
2. Hinge at your hips and slightly bend your knees to lower the dumbbells towards the floor, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
3. Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then return to the starting position by extending your hips and standing upright.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
fe539830-252c-46dc-b7d8-dc9b9673803a.tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders during the movement.
2. Engage your core to protect your lower back.
3. Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize lower back engagement.
fe539830-252c-46dc-b7d8-dc9b9673803a.name: Dumbbell Close Legs Deadlift

instructions: 1. Stand a few feet in front of a bench, facing away, and place one foot on the bench behind you.
2. Lower your hips into a lunge position by bending your front knee, keeping your torso upright and core engaged.
3. Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position, maintaining balance.
4. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
feb9e85d-f32e-4feb-9c0c-7850ba4bb894.tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to avoid strain.
2. Engage your core for stability and balance throughout the exercise.
3. Avoid letting your front knee extend beyond your toes to protect your joints.
feb9e85d-f32e-4feb-9c0c-7850ba4bb894.name: Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat

instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your feet elevated on a bench and a barbell placed across your hips, holding it securely with both hands.
2. Bend your knees and place your feet in a figure four position, with one ankle resting on the opposite knee.
3. Engage your glutes and core, then lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
4. Lower your hips back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
ffbf575e-9a3c-48fd-91b2-b6628adeeb35.tips:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
2. Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
3. Ensure the barbell is securely positioned to prevent it from rolling during the exercise.
ffbf575e-9a3c-48fd-91b2-b6628adeeb35.name: Barbell Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge
